We work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product, and Engineering so every customer has a smooth path from signed contract to live revenue. Our best Onboarding Specialists are customer-obsessed, technically curious, and strong project leaders. As Senior Onboarding Specialist, APAC, you'll be the first point of contact for new Klaviyo customers in the region. You'll guide them through their first 30 to 90 days, from sale to a successful go-live, and help them launch the first customer experiences that drive revenue. You'll join as a founding member of our Singapore team, so this role is both hands-on and foundational. Alongside owning a portfolio of onboardings, you'll help shape how Klaviyo onboards customers across APAC: what great looks like, which processes scale, and where the product and onboarding experience need to improve for this market. Our customers vary widely in size, maturity, and technical setup. This role suits someone who enjoys solving unique problems creatively, thrives in challenging situations, and can move easily between technical troubleshooting and strategic marketing advice. How you'll make an impact. Own new customer relationships from sale through successful go-live, acting as their trusted guide and advocate throughout onboarding. Lead the implementation phase for each customer, including scope definition, project plans, resourcing, and timelines. Give proactive, strategic advice on Klaviyo best practices so customers hit their initial business goals and build their first campaigns and flows with confidence. Support customers on technical and non-technical questions, including integrations, data setup, marketing strategy, and wider ecommerce configuration. Explain complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical users across a wide range of technologies and platforms. Diagnose software issues, resolve customer concerns through established processes, and escalate appropriately when needed. Review customer dashboards proactively, address open issues early, and keep messaging consistent across every touchpoint. Monitor onboarding health, including time to first KAV, across your portfolio and act as a point of escalation when customers are at risk. Set priorities and build technical health plans for open problems so issues are resolved quickly. Run onboarding post-mortems, identify what worked and what didn't, and turn lessons learned into documented best practices. Document troubleshooting and resolution steps to build a shared knowledge base for the growing APAC team. Act as a product expert and bring customer insights to Product and Engineering to improve integrations, setup, UI, and anything else slowing customers down. Surface, coordinate, and drive new ideas to improve onboarding processes as a founding member of the Singapore team. Contribute to a team culture of collaboration, customer empathy, equality, and inclusion. What success looks like. New customers reach go-live on time and achieve their first KAV quickly, with strong early engagement on the platform. Customers finish onboarding with a clear strategy, working integrations, and live campaigns and flows that drive revenue. High customer satisfaction and confidence at the end of onboarding, with smooth handoffs to Customer Success. Issues are spotted early, escalated appropriately, and resolved efficiently, with few surprises for customers or internal teams. A growing library of documented best practices, playbooks, and troubleshooting guides tailored to APAC customers. Measurable improvements in onboarding processes and time to value, driven by your post-mortems and feedback. Product and Engineering see you as a credible source of customer insight that shapes real improvements. Customers and internal stakeholders view you as a trusted, proactive operator who can manage complex implementations without heavy manager involvement. Who you are. 4+ years of customer onboarding, implementation, or related customer-facing SaaS experience, with a track record of building relationships with multiple stakeholders on an account. Strong project manager with excellent organization skills and experience running several implementations at once. Clear, thoughtful communicator across phone, video, and email, able to adapt to technical and non-technical audiences. Experience helping end users reach key business goals with software. A track record of creative problem-solving for customers. Experience in marketing or advising customers on marketing strategy is a plus. Experience with email marketing and ecommerce platforms is a plus. Foundational knowledge of APIs is advantageous. Comfortable managing customer relationships in Salesforce or a similar CRM, and proficient with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Google Sheets. AI fluent and comfortable using AI responsibly to improve productivity, sharpen thinking, and model modern ways of working. Curious, eager to learn, and able to adapt in a fast-changing environment. Collaborative by nature, thriving in cross-functional teams. Proactive, accountable, and solutions-oriented; you own outcomes, raise issues early, and improve how work gets done. Fluency in Business Mandarin is required given the customer base across the region. Full authorisation to work in Singapore without restrictions is required. Why this role is compelling. APAC is a high-growth region for Klaviyo, and onboarding is where every long-term customer relationship begins. As a founding member of our Singapore team, you'll directly shape how customers across the region experience Klaviyo from day one, build the playbooks others will follow, and have a visible impact on customer growth and retention. If you're excited by helping businesses grow, solving hard customer problems, and building a team from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you. Klaviyo's Personalization & Analytics pillar builds the intelligence layer that helps marketers understand their customers, personalize every interaction, and prove the impact of their work. Our Personalization SKU - which includes Audience Optimization and our personalization engine - is one of Klaviyo's highest-growth paid products and a cornerstone of our Marketing Analytics & Personalization offering. The Personalization SKU is ML-powered, which means the value it delivers is real and differentiated - but it also means customers need to understand what it's doing before they trust it, and trust it before they pay for it. That gap between "this exists" and "I can't imagine working without this" is where this role lives. About the Role. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who is obsessed with one question above all others: why do customers adopt - or fail to adopt - a product that would genuinely help them?. This isn't a traditional growth PM role. We're not looking for someone who runs A/B tests on button colors and calls it a day. We're looking for someone who understands that sustainable SKU growth comes from product quality and value clarity first - and that the best conversion and retention lever is an experience so good that customers can't explain their business performance without it. Your primary mandate is the adoption, retention, and trial conversion of the Personalization SKU. That means owning the in-product experiences that help customers discover Personalization features, understand what they're doing, trust the results, and build habits around them. It means making the ROI of Personalization impossible to miss - not through marketing copy, but through product design. And it means owning the analytics surfaces that make that value visible: the dashboards, metrics, and reporting experiences that connect Personalization usage to business outcomes customers care about. This role sits at the intersection of product intuition, customer empathy, and growth strategy. You'll work closely with the Personalization engineering teams, data science, go-to-market, and customer success to ensure every touchpoint in the Personalization customer journey - from trial activation through long-term retention - is designed with intention and measured with rigor. How You'll Make a Difference. Own the end-to-end in-product experience for Personalization SKU trial and adoption - from first contact with an Audience Optimization or personalization feature through the moment a customer builds a sustained usage habit. Define and track what real adoption looks like for each Personalization feature - not surface engagement, but the behaviors that actually predict retention and expansion. Own the in-product analytics and reporting surfaces that make Personalization ROI visible to customers - the dashboards, performance summaries, and impact metrics that answer "what is this doing for my business?". Design and iterate on the trial conversion experience: make it unmistakably clear what customers get with Personalization, reduce the distance between signup and first value moment, and build in-product signals that accelerate the path from trial to paid. Identify and close the gaps in the Personalization customer journey where value is unclear, trust breaks down, or usage falls off - and build the product experiences that fix them. Build and maintain a rigorous measurement framework for Personalization SKU health: adoption depth, retention rates, trial conversion, expansion signals, and churn indicators. Partner with go-to-market, customer success, and data science to ensure the Personalization SKU can convert and retain customers through both self-serve and sales-assisted motions - and that the product experience works for both. Synthesize customer feedback, usage data, and market signals into a clear point of view on what Personalization customers need next - and turn that into a sequenced roadmap that shipping teams can execute. Who You Are. You have 3-5+ years of PM experience, with a demonstrable track record of driving product adoption, retention, or trial conversion for a paid B2B SaaS product - not just shipping features. You think about growth as a product quality problem: the most durable conversion and retention motion is a product experience so good that customers understand the value without being told. You have strong UX instincts, especially for products where the underlying complexity is high - you've taken something hard to understand and made it feel intuitive, trustworthy, and worth paying for. You know how to define and measure real adoption: you've questioned inherited engagement metrics, replaced them with something that actually predicts retention, and gotten stakeholders to buy in. You've owned a trial-to-paid conversion motion and can speak to what you changed in the product - not the marketing or lifecycle emails, but the actual in-product experience. You have genuine customer empathy: you talk to customers regularly, know how to synthesize what you hear into product decisions, and can advocate for the customer POV in a room full of people looking at dashboards. You can hold a PLG motion and a sales-assisted motion simultaneously - you understand that the product has to work for both and you've navigated the design tradeoffs that creates. You're data-literate: you can define your own success metrics, pull and interpret data to inform decisions, and build a measurement framework for a product area you've never owned before. Nice to Have. Experience with ML-driven or AI-powered features where value is inherently probabilistic and takes time to materialize - and you've solved the "trust gap" problem before. Background in martech, CDP, or ecommerce - you understand how marketers think about personalization, segmentation, and campaign performance. Experience building PLG or self-serve growth motions at a company that also runs a sales-assisted or enterprise motion. Exposure to analytics or reporting product surfaces - you've owned a dashboard or performance reporting experience and thought hard about what makes data actually actionable. Familiarity with SKU or packaging strategy - you understand how in-product experience and commercial motion interact. Massachusetts Applicants:. description: At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny. . About the Team. Klaviyo's AI & Analytics pillar builds the intelligence layer that helps marketers understand their customers, personalize every interaction, and prove the impact of their work. Two of our highest-leverage products live at the center of this: Product Recommendations and Audience Optimization. Both are ML-powered. Both exist for one reason: to help brands running autonomous marketing get a real, measurable lift in performance and revenue. Klaviyo runs like an ecosystem of startups. Every team owns real outcomes, and the people who succeed here are builders who pull in the partners they need, even when those partners don't report to them. This role is a clear example of that model in action. About the Role. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the product and model strategy for two connected feature areas: Product Recommendations and Message Prioritization, with room to take on additional ML-powered feature pods as the portfolio grows. Product Recommendations spans multiple model types, deep familiarity with product catalog data structures, and enterprise-grade customization: filters, guardrails, exclusions, and the business rules brands need layered on top of a model before they'll trust it in production. Message prioritization decides who receives a message, which message they receive, and when. Any given profile might be eligible for several messages in a short window. This feature caps how many they actually get and picks the ones most likely to convert, so the model has to optimize for revenue and conversion at the same time it respects frequency limits. Across both areas, this PM owns the full outcome: not just what ships, but whether it delivers positive lift for the brands using it. That means you're accountable for model performance the same way you're accountable for the product experience wrapped around it. How You'll Make a Difference. Own the roadmap for Product Recommendations, including model type selection, catalog data structure decisions, and enterprise-grade customization such as filters, guardrails, and exclusions. Own the roadmap for Message Prioritization, defining how the model balances message frequency limits against conversion and revenue outcomes. Define what model success looks like for each feature area and build the frameworks to measure lift, conversion improvement, and revenue impact over time. Partner closely with ML modeling teams and software engineering teams to translate model capability into features customers actually trust and adopt. Design product experiences that make ML-driven decisions understandable and explainable to marketers, so the model never feels like a black box. Influence teams beyond your direct authority to align on priorities and deliver feature outcomes, consistent with how Klaviyo's product orgs operate. Take full ownership of model and feature performance after launch. Shipping is the start of the job, not the end of it. Build a clear point of view on why brands choose to pay for ML-powered personalization features, and use that to shape what gets built next. Grow into ownership of additional ML-powered feature pods as Klaviyo's personalization portfolio expands. Who You Are. 3-5+ years of PM experience owning ML-powered or data-driven product features in a production environment, not just AI-adjacent products. Direct experience evaluating and tracking ML model performance: you understand lift measurement, experiment design, and what good model quality tracking looks like. Comfortable partnering with both software engineering and ML modeling or data science teams. You speak enough of both languages to make good calls without needing everything explained to you. Genuine customer obsession: you understand why a brand decides to pay for an ML feature, and you translate that understanding directly into roadmap decisions. Strong instincts for human behavior and UX: you know how to design trust, clarity, and adoption into a feature that could otherwise feel opaque or unpredictable. Comfortable working with complex data structures, like product catalogs, and turning that complexity into simple, understandable customer-facing controls. High agency: you take ownership of outcomes, not just deliverables, and you pull in the partners you need even when they don't report to you. A track record of driving cross-functional alignment and shipping through ambiguity, without relying on direct authority to get it done. Nice to Have. Experience with recommendation systems or catalog-driven ML products. Experience with message optimization, cadence, or frequency-capping problems. Background in martech, ecommerce, or CDP products. Experience building enterprise-grade customization layers (filters, guardrails, business rules) on top of ML models. Experience as an embedded PM partner to a data science or ML engineering team. Technical Generalist: You are comfortable working across the stack. Whether it is debugging a React component in an E2E test or optimizing a Python integration test, you are ready to dive in. Klaviyo's Growth, Billing & Monetization team is responsible for making it easier for businesses to discover, adopt, and grow with Klaviyo. We build the product experiences that connect customer value to sustainable business growth, spanning onboarding, activation, self-service purchasing, subscriptions, billing, and monetization. As Klaviyo continues to expand its platform and introduce new products and AI-powered capabilities, our team plays a critical role in helping customers realize value quickly, understand the full breadth of what Klaviyo offers, and seamlessly grow their investment over time. We believe the best growth strategies are built into the product itself. By combining customer empathy, thoughtful design, experimentation, and data-driven decision-making, we create intuitive experiences that drive adoption, conversion, retention, and long-term customer success. About the Role. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to help define and accelerate Klaviyo's product-led growth strategy, with a focus on creating seamless, high-converting customer experiences across the entire product lifecycle. This role sits at the intersection of product experience, growth, and monetization. You'll own key initiatives that help customers move from initial signup to activation, discover and adopt additional capabilities, and expand their relationship with Klaviyo through intuitive self-service experiences. This isn't just about optimizing conversion funnels or running experiments. We're looking for someone who understands that sustainable growth comes from delivering meaningful customer value, removing friction, and building experiences that make it easy for customers to get started, see results, and grow. You'll partner closely with engineering, design, analytics, marketing, finance, and go-to-market teams to identify growth opportunities, shape product strategy, and deliver measurable business impact. You can influence cross-functional stakeholders, communicate a clear product vision, and align teams around measurable outcomes. You think like a builder, with the curiosity, creativity, and ownership mindset to challenge assumptions, experiment with new approaches, and continuously improve the customer experience. Experience building onboarding, activation, or expansion experiences for complex, multi-product SaaS platforms. Background in martech, ecommerce, CRM, or other data-driven SaaS products. Our Engineering team builds the AI systems that power how brands run their businesses on Klaviyo. We move fast, ship in production, and hold a high bar for what "AI-native" actually means: systems that make real judgment calls, not demos. The Customer Agent team is one of the newest and most ambitious groups in that org, based in Boston and working in-office: we're building a conversational AI system that lets brands serve their own customers at a scale no human support team could match. We're still small enough that a single senior engineer can shape how the whole platform evolves. We're past the demo stage: the team ships changes against live customer traffic, measures quality with real evaluation frameworks, and treats reliability as a product feature, not an afterthought. About the Role:. As Senior Staff Engineer, you'll set technical and product direction for Customer Agent end to end, building a 0-to-1 agentic product with the speed and ownership of a startup, backed by the scale and resources of one of the most innovative tech companies on the East Coast, while staying hands-on with the hardest problems yourself. This is a principal-caliber individual contributor role: we're looking for an engineer who has personally architected, built, scaled, and supported a production agentic system through everything that comes after the demo, and who acts as a force multiplier across the org through the strength of their technical judgment. How You'll Make an Impact:. Set the technical and product direction for Customer Agent's core platform, from architecture through production. Take on the platform's hardest technical problems personally: orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, memory & context, self-healing/improving and failure handling for non-deterministic systems. Write and ship code, review designs, and make the calls other engineers can't make alone. Build architecture and frameworks that other engineers and teams adopt, and mentor through design reviews rather than direct management. Partner with product, design, data science, and go-to-market leaders to shape the roadmap, not just execute against it. Evaluate emerging AI technologies and bring the ones worth betting on into production. What We're Looking For:. You've architected, built, scaled, and supported a production agentic system end to end, not just prototyped one: real orchestration, evals, guardrails, and non-deterministic failure handling. You've owned it through launch, scale, incidents, and the years of operational reality after the demo. You've learned the hard lessons that only come from running agents in production: securing them against misuse and abuse, and the operational scar tissue of keeping a non-deterministic system reliable as usage grows. You've set technical and product direction for an entire product area before, not just your own component, and you can point to something you designed and championed that shipped and that other teams built on. You've stayed hands-on through all of it: still writing code, reviewing your own architecture decisions, and debugging production issues yourself, not delegating the hardest problems away. Your past architecture and frameworks got reused by other teams, and you've unblocked multiple teams at once, not just your own. You communicate complex technical trade-offs clearly across engineering, product, and executive audiences, and you can turn an undefined problem into a plan others rally behind. Nice to Haves:. Experience running a multi-tenant agent platform at production scale, where external customers configure their own agent behavior on shared infrastructure. description: Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly's edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers' applications as close to their end-users as possible - at the edge of the Internet. Posting Open Date: Sep 21st, 2026. Anticipated Posting Close Date*: Nov 30, 2026. *Job posting may close early due to the volume of applicants. Senior Technical Product Manager, API Traffic and Enforcement. APIs are how software talks to software, and the volume and variety of that traffic is growing rapidly. AI agents now discover and call APIs directly, and MCP servers are a new kind of endpoint with the same questions attached: what exists, what it's supposed to do, and who is allowed to call it. Enterprises are challenged to respond to those questions. This role owns Fastly's answer. As a Senior Technical Product Manager on Fastly's Core Infrastructure Product Management team, you will own how Fastly defines what traffic is allowed and how traffic is held to that definition. That means our customers' API surface end to end - discovery and inventory of the APIs they actually run, the schemas that describe intended behavior, and the API gateway itself - and the enforcement primitives underneath it, including ACLs, allowlists, rate limiting, and the request-path controls that turn a declared model into something the platform actually enforces. Much of security is about detecting the bad. Your charter is the other half: defining what good looks like and enforcing it. Customer APIs are the first and largest surface for the positive model, and the primitives you own are the ones other products adopt as that model extends across the platform. This role reports to the Director of Core Infrastructure Product Management and has real latitude to set direction. What You'll Do:. Own the positive model end to end: drive the strategy and roadmap for defining what traffic is allowed. You will take customers from not knowing what APIs they run, to describing intended behavior precisely, to enforcing it in the request path. Make API discovery tell customers something they didn't know: own discovery and inventory across the API surfaces customers actually operate. Discovery is where most customers start, and how good it is determines whether they trust anything built on top of it. Turn schemas into enforceable contracts: own schema definition, generation, and validation. When customers can't hand you an accurate spec for their own APIs, the product has to produce one worth enforcing against, then keep it accurate as their APIs change. Own enforcement in the request path: ACLs, allowlists, rate limiting, and the controls that turn a declared model into something the platform enforces, along with the gateway that applies them. Build these as primitives other products can adopt, not features scoped to one surface. Make agents first-class: agents calling APIs are a new kind of client, and MCP servers are a new kind of endpoint. Define how Fastly identifies them, authorizes them, and holds them to allowed behavior. Take and defend clear positions: bring evidence-based points of view on how traffic should be described and constrained, and drive them to decisions across engineering, product, and partner teams. You will bring structure to ambiguous problems and move decisions forward earlier. What We're Looking For:. Experience: 5+ years in product management or technical product leadership, ideally on API, security, or platform infrastructure products. API and request-path fluency: you understand how API traffic is described, validated, and constrained - schemas and specs, gateway behavior, and the difference between allowlist models and detection-based ones. You can reason about where each fits and what it costs to run. Platform thinking: a track record of building capabilities that serve more than one product or team. Shared primitives, enforcement points, or controls others build on, rather than features scoped to a single surface. Execution focus: a demonstrated bias for shipping. You are hands-on and comfortable owning outcomes in ambiguous, fast-moving conditions rather than waiting for perfect clarity. Conviction and influence: the ability to form clear, evidence-based positions and defend them across engineering and product partners, including pushing back constructively. You build alignment without relying on authority. Communication and presentation: a clear communicator who can move between deep technical discussion with engineers and crisp framing for customers and executives, with genuine curiosity about the "why" behind a customer's problem. You can stand up in front of a room, make a case, and hold it under questioning. We'll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these:. Hands-on work with API gateways and OpenAPI-driven validation: schema generation from live traffic, drift detection as APIs change, and the gap between the spec a team publishes and what their API actually does. The agentic traffic stack - workload and agent identity (SPIFFE/WIMSE, mTLS), OAuth 2.1 for delegated agent authorization, and agent protocols like MCP and its authorization spec. Request-path enforcement at scale: WASM filters, eBPF, or policy engines like OPA and Rego. Startup or 0-to-1 experience building API, security, or infrastructure products in a fast-moving environment. Work Hours: This position will require you to be available during core business hours. Fastly's edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers' applications as close to their end-users as possible - at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly's customers include many of the world's most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue. We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.. Strategic Sales Account Manager - Mumbai based. Summary:. Fastly is looking for a Senior Strategic Sales Account Manager based in Mumbai, India to join the team, nurture strong commercial and strategic business relationships with a major telco partner in the region. This role blends enterprise account management, partner enablement and product commercialization for CDN/edge infrastructure delivered via a carrier/partner model. The ideal candidate has experience working with telcos or large platform partners to launch and scale CDN or edge services and can enable sales teams and product partners to drive net‑new logos, renewals, upsell and cross‑sell. The SStrategic Sales Account Manager will be managing a portfolio of Enterprise customer relationships from C-Level down, you'll have a proven track record in building high value and impact relationships, and have experience running upsell and cross sell opportunities. You'll develop account health and lead customer advocacy across Fastly's Enterprise , partnering with our Sales, Customer Support, Product and Technical teams. You will bring a growth mindset to the role and drive deeper, wider relationships to secure and grow revenue and drive product adoption. You will need to be highly organized, experienced at delivering business reviews and an expert in building and executing on successful account strategies. Success in this role directly ties to the value we provide our customers. This is a great opportunity for someone with the skills, energy and confidence to work autonomously in the region - and ultimately to define great account management and customer success practices in the region. Role Context (JioCDN):. JioCDN is Jio Platforms' carrier‑grade content delivery service that provides low‑latency, high‑scale content and application delivery across India for both Jio's internal businesses and external enterprise customers. Fastly is the strategic infrastructure partner powering JioCDN's edge delivery capabilities while Jio Platforms commercializes and operates the service. The Senior Customer Success Manager will serve as the primary commercial interface between Fastly and Jio Platforms' group companies and their customers - enabling joint go‑to‑market execution, driving adoption of the JioCDN offering, and coordinating cross‑functional efforts to win new logos and expand existing accounts. What You'll Do:. Own and grow a portfolio of strategic telco partner and subsidiary accounts; drive new bookings, revenue, renewals and contract expansion. Act as the primary commercial contact for partner stakeholders and their internal customer organizations; monitor account health and secure executive sponsorship. Enable partner enterprise sales teams and channel stakeholders to position, sell and adopt JioCDN‑powered solutions; lead enablement activities, workshops, roundtables and speaking engagements. Develop account strategies and executive engagement plans; run Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews to measure adoption, highlight new initiatives, and surface growth opportunities. Translate customer and partner business needs into adoption plans; coordinate cross‑functional Fastly resources (sales, solutions engineering, professional services, product, engineering, support, finance) to unblock deployments and commercial progress. Identify, qualify and drive upsell, cross‑sell and net‑new business opportunities in collaboration with Fastly Sales and Solutions teams; cross‑sell Fastly solutions to increase usage. Advocate telco partner and customer feedback into Fastly product and go‑to‑market planning; collaborate with product, marketing and sales to improve ongoing customer support. Manage complex, multi‑threaded commercial programs and timelines across organizations; engage customers both remotely and in person and bring in subject matter experts as needed. Travel across India as required for partner and customer engagement. What We're Looking For:. 10+ years enterprise account management / customer success, partner/alliances management, or strategic sales experience with carrier, telco, or platform partners in India. Direct experience launching, commercializing, or scaling CDN, edge, or related infrastructure services (CDN/PAAS/web delivery/cloud/networking/security) with telcos or large partners. Proven track record driving revenue via new‑logo acquisition, renewals, upsell and cross‑sell motions. Strong stakeholder management and executive engagement; comfortable presenting to technical and business audiences and running customer meetings/demos. Technical fluency across web/app security, CDN, networking, cloud infrastructure or related technologies, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value. Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross‑functional teams and manage complex, multi‑threaded programs to successful outcomes. Exceptional customer‑facing, presentation and project management skills; high attention to detail and ability to prioritize in a fast‑moving, multitasking environment. Self‑starter, independent, disciplined, highly organized, with excellent verbal and written communication in English (local language skills a plus). Work Hours:. Core business hours: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM IST. Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements:. This position is a remote role and open to candidates residing in the following locations:. Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (*required*). Regular travel across India as required by your role and requested by your manager. Benefits:. We care about you. title: Threat Detection Analyst (Japanese Speaking desirable)
description: Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly's edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers' applications as close to their end-users as possible - at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly's customers include many of the world's most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue. We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.. Threat Detection Analyst - (Japanese speaking desirable). Fastly is seeking a Threat Detection Analyst to join our dedicated Customer Security Operations Centre. In this role, you will be a frontline defender for Fastly's global enterprise customers. You will leverage our edge cloud platform and an array of security products in monitoring traffic, detect sophisticated anomalies, and deploy real-time mitigations against DDoS, Bot, and Web Application attacks. This is a high-impact role where you act as a strategic partner for our Managed Security Service (MSS) clients, providing the expert visibility and rapid response necessary to address internet-scale threats. What you'll Do :. Active Incident Response: Lead the identification and mitigation of high-impact security events. You will analyze sophisticated traffic patterns and implement precise countermeasures, including rate limiting and custom WAF & Security rules to neutralize threats in real-time. Managed Security Delivery: Serve as a primary security consultant for MSS Customers. This involves continuous tuning and refining of security policies to optimize detection accuracy and maintaining a hardened security posture tailored to each client's unique environment. Advanced Threat Hunting: Conduct data-driven investigations using log analysis to uncover potential threats and hardenings opportunities. Security Intelligence & Reporting: Author comprehensive After Action Reports (AARs) and monthly security summaries. You will translate complex telemetry and attack data into high-level actionable insights for customer stakeholders. Strategic Communication: Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) during active security incidents. You will provide clear, calm, and professional guidance via real-time communication channels, ensuring customers are informed and confident in our defensive strategy. What we are looking for :. Web Security Expertise : Comprehensive understanding of the OWASP Top 10 and advanced attack vectors (e.g., Credential Stuffing, API Abuse, and Layer 7 DDoS). You can interpret raw payloads to distinguish between malicious intent and legitimate traffic. Protocol Proficiency: Deep technical knowledge of the internet stack, specifically HTTP/S, TCP/IP, DNS, and TLS. You should be comfortable analyzing handshake processes, header structures, and status codes. Analytical Rigor : A methodical approach to digital forensics and incident response. You possess the ability to correlate disparate data points within JSON or CSV logs to reconstruct an attack narrative. Communication Excellence: The ability to distill complex technical findings into concise, professional, and empathetic communications for both technical and non-technical audiences. title: Device Engineer II (RF/EMC)
description: POSITION OVERVIEW. A rapidly expanding, entrepreneurial technology company, Alarm.com , is seeking an ambitious and talented RF/EMC Engineer. Very few small companies innovate and develop across such a broad range of technologies as Alarm.com . The RF/EMC Engineer position is ideal for candidates who want to work hands-on with technologies such as cellular networks (LTE, Cat-M, NB-IoT, RedCap, eRedCap), WiFi, Bluetooth, LoRa and mesh/star sub-GHz networks. Opportunities include testing, validating, and certifying the performance of cutting-edge security devices, innovative sensing applications, and life-safety devices. This is a lab-focused role for an engineer who enjoys owning test execution end-to-end - from bench measurement through external certification - while contributing to the RF and EMC quality of in-house hardware designs. RESPONSIBILITIES:. Independently plan and perform RF performance and EMC pre-compliance testing in accordance with product specifications and applicable regulatory requirements (FCC, ISED, CE/RED). title: Embedded Software Engineer I
description: Embedded Software Engineer I. Alarm.com is a rapidly expanding technology company developing innovative cloud and device solutions across a wide range of cutting-edge technologies that provide a unified, connected service to millions of residential and commercial properties in the US and abroad. We are looking for a talented and passionate embedded software engineer for the Device Engineering team to help us define the future of the Internet-of-Things for residential and commercial properties by creating and integrating devices that connect with our robust cloud using next-gen communication stacks. You will be working with a team of talented engineers across a diverse set of technological backgrounds to design devices, build and manufacture hardware, architect and implement software, and collaborate in an agile and fast-paced environment. Required Skills:. Bachelor's degree in computer science, Electrical/Computer engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience. 0-2 years of professional experience; internships, co-ops, research, capstone, or personal projects involving embedded or systems software are welcome in place of industry experience. Proficiency in C and/or C++, with an understanding of software architecture and design principles. Proficiency in Linux and comfort working from the command line. Exposure to microcontrollers or single-board computers (e.g., STM32, ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, BeagleBone) and hardware peripherals such as UART, SPI, I2C, and ADC. Foundational understanding of electronics and the ability to read circuit schematics. Familiarity with version control systems such as Git. Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity about how hardware and software meet, and eagerness to learn from code review and mentorship. Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to collaborate on a team. Preferred Skills:. Experience with C++ in bare-metal and RTOS-based environments (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, ThreadX, or similar). Experience with glibc, musl or bionic. Experience in threading, processes and other Linux Systems knowledge. Experience in Asynchronous and Messaging based designs (e.g., protobuf/nanopb). Experience in building Linux kernels, device drivers, kernel modules, U-Boot, etc. Experience with cross-compilation and build frameworks such as Yocto, Buildroot, OpenWRT, or Android. Functional knowledge of security standards and protocols, such as TLS/SSL, OpenSSH, ECDSA/ECDH, AES256, HMAC, SHA256. Experience with designing firmware for video pipeline systems, image signal processing, or streaming protocols (RTSP, H.264/H.265) is a strong plus. Experience with running AI models on embedded device. Responsibilities:. Work alongside senior engineers to develop and maintain embedded Linux applications, platform frameworks, and board support packages using C/C++. Implement, test, and debug well-scoped features and bug fixes on real hardware, growing toward independent ownership. Support device bring-up and validation with electrical and mechanical engineers. Contribute to features that connect our devices to the cloud, working with software engineers across teams. title: Engineering Manager - Embedded Firmware
description: . Engineering Manager - Embedded Firmware. Alarm.com is seeking an Engineering Manager to lead an embedded software team focused on MCU firmware for the security gateways and sensors at the heart of millions of connected properties. This is firmware where reliability truly matters: bare-metal and RTOS systems that run for years on a battery, communicate over cellular and short-range radios, and protect people and property every day. It's a player-coach role - you'll set the direction for the team and grow its engineers while staying deep in the technology: reviewing designs and code, and helping crack the hardest problems. Device Engineering spans many offices, and this role works across all of them - keeping your team, peer teams, and stakeholders in alignment.. Responsibilities:. Lead an embedded software team building MCU-based (bare-metal / RTOS) security gateways and sensors, owning both day-to-day execution and the team's long-term growth. Own the team's delivery: sprint commitments, project plans, and resource allocation across concurrent projects. Stay hands-on: lead design and architecture reviews, review code, and help the team work through its hardest technical problems. Partner with hardware, product management, quality, and operations teams to take products from concept through mass production. Oversee manufacturing test software and production integration with contract manufacturers (CMs). Coach and develop team members through effective 1:1s and clear feedback; hire as the team grows. Manage across the many offices Device Engineering participates in - communicating plans, status, and risks proactively and keeping distributed teams and senior management in alignment. Other duties as assigned. Required Technical Skills:. B.S. or M.S. in Electrical, Computer, or Software Engineering, or equivalent demonstrable experience. 2+ years managing or leading an engineering team; 5+ years developing embedded firmware. Deep microcontroller experience: C, bare-metal and RTOS environments, and hardware-level debugging (JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes). Experience with low-power, battery-operated devices and wireless connectivity (cellular LTE Cat-M / NB-IoT and short-range radios). Sound technical judgment: knows when to move fast and when to build for robustness, and can thoroughly vet the team's designs and implementations. Strong communicator who operates well in a distributed organization and keeps remote stakeholders aligned. Nice to Haves:. Manufacturing test software, production automation, and contract manufacturer coordination. Designing to UL, EN, and NFA2P life-safety requirements. Home automation protocols (Z-Wave, Zigbee), USB, Ethernet, sensors, and power management. M.S. in Engineering Management or similar. title: Manager, Corporate Accounting
description: Manager, Corporate Accounting & Reporting. About Us. We are a high-growth SaaS company at the forefront of innovation in the Internet of Things (IoT) space, delivering connected solutions that transform how people interact with their environments. Over the past several years, we've experienced steady, healthy growth and built a high-performing accounting team that plays a key role in sustaining our success. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Accounting, the Accounting Manager supports execution of the month-end and quarter-end close across our multi-entity structure and assigned financial statement areas, compiles the monthly Flash reporting package and quarterly flux analysis, and serves as the accounting team's day-to-day owner of our finance systems including Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains), Coupa, Expensify, and Power BI, using them to standardize and automate how the team works. With a migration to a modern cloud ERP ahead, this role will be a key contributor to that implementation and the process redesign that comes with it. The Manager will combine solid technical accounting knowledge with hands-on execution, a continuous-improvement mindset, and supervisory responsibility, including supervising and developing the Senior and Staff Accountants, performing first-level review of their work under US GAAP, and escalating complex or judgmental matters to accounting leadership. The successful candidate will thrive in a highly collaborative, team-oriented environment and bring a humble, hands-on approach to their work. This role is best suited for someone who enjoys being in the office and working closely with teammates in support of the broader team goals. Key Responsibilities. Close Execution & Support. Execute assigned month-end and quarter-end close activities within the timelines and quality standards set by accounting leadership. Administer the monthly close calendar and close checklist, distribute the calendar and monthly FX rates, and track reconciliation completion and sign-off status. Review consolidated unposted entries and completeness reporting in Great Plains / Management Reporter to ensure the ledger is complete before close is finalized. Management Reporting & Analytics. Compile and analyze recurring management reporting for assigned areas, including the monthly Flash reporting package and quarterly flux analysis, developing clear explanations of variance drivers for review and distribution to Finance leadership. Build and maintain reports that support Flash, flux, and other recurring management reporting. Prepare supporting schedules and data inputs for the corporate reporting package and for audit and external reporting requests. Accounting Review & Oversight. Serve as first-level reviewer of journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting schedules prepared by staff, confirming accuracy, completeness, and GAAP compliance. Own or review the financial statement areas assigned to this role, which may include revenue and deferred revenue, accounts receivable, inventory and cost of sales, prepaid and other assets, fixed assets and depreciation, accruals and other liabilities, intercompany activity and consolidation eliminations, payroll and benefits, and equity and stock-based compensation. Review complex and judgmental accounts within assigned areas such as payroll and benefits accounts including ESPP, accrued vacation, accrued incentive compensation, and accrued sales commissions. Prepare select corporate reconciliations, including deferred transaction costs, and administer corporate credit card fee activity with the card program team. Perform assigned monthly control activities within the internal control framework, including reconciliation and chart of accounts maintenance. Accounting Systems Administration & Process Standardization. Serve as the accounting team's day-to-day owner and subject matter expert for core finance systems, including Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains), Coupa, Expensify, and Power BI. Partner with IT, Finance Transformation, and Procurement on ERP configuration, data integrity, and system upgrades or enhancements, serving as the accounting workstream lead on assigned system initiatives. Identify, design, and implement process improvements that standardize and automate recurring accounting activities across entities, within the systems and automation roadmap set by accounting leadership. Document standardized procedures and system workflows, and train the accounting team on new tools and processes. Leadership & Business Partnership. Supervise, coach, and develop the Senior and Staff Accountants supporting assigned areas, while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Serve as a day-to-day contact for cross-functional teams on systems, expense, and procure-to-pay matters, and fulfill audit requests for owned areas, escalating significant or judgmental matters to accounting leadership. Assume responsibility for additional or different entities and financial statement areas as assigned, as business and organizational needs evolve. Lead or participate in ad hoc projects and other duties, as assigned, to support evolving business priorities. Other duties as assigned. Required Qualifications. Bachelor's degree in Accounting; Active CPA required. 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including public accounting (Big Four firm preferred), close and consolidation (public company preferred). Strong knowledge of US GAAP, financial close, and multi-entity consolidation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail. Proven project management, organizational and time management skills. Hands-on experience across a range of financial statement areas, such as revenue, receivables, inventory and cost of sales, prepaids, fixed assets, accruals, intercompany and consolidation eliminations, payroll and benefits, equity, and debt. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and hands-on experience with a major ERP; Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains) and/or a modern cloud ERP such as Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations strongly preferred. Experience improving processes through technology and automation. Experience building management reporting and analytics, including monthly flash and quarterly flux reporting. Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop staff. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications. Prior work in SaaS or subscription/technology industries. Experience with international/multi-currency consolidation. Experience in a SOX-compliant, publicly traded environment. Power BI report and dashboard development, or comparable BI/data visualization experience. Experience participating in an ERP implementation or migration, system upgrade, or finance process automation initiative. Core Competencies. Analytical Thinking - Ability to interpret complex transactions and data to make sound accounting determinations. Attention to Detail - Precision and accuracy in reconciliations, consolidation, and reporting. Leadership - Develops staff and drives accountability across the close. Collaboration - Works effectively across teams and communicates complex concepts clearly. Systems Orientation - Leverages technology to eliminate manual effort and scale accounting operations. Ownership Mentality - Proactively takes responsibility for deliverables and drives process improvements. Why Join Us. This is a unique opportunity to join a high-performance finance team in a fast-growing, publicly traded SaaS & IoT leader. You'll work on complex accounting matters, contribute to process improvements that scale with our growth, and gain exposure to cross-functional operations that directly impact our success. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative culture where your contributions are valued. title: Manager of Financial Reporting & Technical Accounting
description: Manager of Financial Reporting and Technical Accounting. About the Role. The Manager of Financial Reporting and Technical Accounting will assist in preparing technical accounting memos on issues relevant to Alarm.com and researching authoritative accounting guidance under U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles ("GAAP"), under the direction of the Director of Financial Reporting and Technical Accounting. The position will also support the implementation of new accounting standards. The role is also responsible for preparing the Form 10-Ks, 10-Qs and related financial schedules supporting the financial statement disclosures, along with other Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") filings (e.g., 8-Ks), and for the completion and review of eXtensible Business Reporting Language ("XBRL") on a quarterly basis. Additional responsibilities include assessing the accounting for and tracking of development projects eligible for capitalization, calculating credit losses under the Current Expected Credit Losses model, assisting with due diligence and purchase accounting procedures for acquisitions, coordinating with third-party valuation experts on intangible asset valuations, reviewing customer and vendor contracts as well as lease contracts to assess proper accounting treatment, and performing financial reporting and process controls on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis, as necessary. The Manager will also assist in gathering support for external auditors and responding to questions related to tests of controls, interim procedures, quarterly reviews and year-end audits, helping ensure support schedules are accurate and provided to auditors on a timely basis. This role is best suited for someone who enjoys being in the office and working closely with teammates and cross-functional partners in support of the broader organization and team goals. Key Responsibilities. Technical Accounting & Financial Reporting. Research technical accounting issues and draft memorandums summarizing the applicable guidance and its impact on operations and financial statement disclosures. Draft 10-Ks and 10-Qs and related financial schedules in accordance with presentation and disclosure requirements. Prepare other SEC filings (e.g., 8-Ks) and complete and review XBRL on a quarterly basis. Assist with the implementation of new accounting standards. Analyze development projects for capitalization and calculate the amount of costs eligible for capitalization. Calculate the credit loss percentage to be applied to outstanding receivables on a quarterly basis. Contract Review. Analyze customer and vendor contracts and determine the proper accounting treatment. Analyze lease contracts, identify lease and non-lease components and determine the proper accounting treatment. Mergers & Acquisitions Support. Perform due diligence and purchase accounting procedures for acquisitions, including creating and executing work plans and drafting memos summarizing findings and technical accounting issues. Coordinate with third-party valuation experts for intangible asset valuations and review valuation reports. Audit Support & Process Controls. Assist in gathering support for external auditors and answer questions related to tests of controls, interim procedures, quarterly reviews and year-end audits. Perform financial reporting and other process controls on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis, as necessary. Required Qualifications. A. in Accounting; active CPA required. 6+ years of progressive experience in public accounting (Big Four accounting experience preferred) and/or corporate financial reporting at a publicly traded company. Experience performing technical accounting research, including drafting memorandums that summarize accounting guidance and its impact on operations and financial statement disclosures. Experience drafting or reviewing 10-Qs and 10-Ks of a publicly traded company. In-depth knowledge of U.S. GAAP guidelines and SEC reporting requirements. Ability to summarize complex accounting issues in a technical memorandum. Strong background and experience with audit methodologies and techniques. Strong project management, time management and organizational skills. Ability to work effectively within a team to complete projects, as well as independently. Core Competencies. Technical Accounting Acumen - Solid knowledge of GAAP guidelines, SEC reporting requirements and auditor methodologies. Research & Analysis - Strong ability to research, assess the impact of, and document technical accounting issues. Project & Time Management - Strong project management, time management and organizational skills, with a strong work ethic. Communication - Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills. System Savvy - Experience with Enterprise Resource Planning systems and financial reporting tools, along with a curiosity and intent to evolve as AI tools become available. Collaboration - Ability to work independently and collaboratively, with a desire to work primarily in the office and build relationships with peers and teammates. Performance Objectives. Ensure appropriate accounting for technical accounting issues and new accounting standards. Ensure timely and accurate SEC filings. Meet monthly, quarterly and yearly review and audit requirements. Ensure appropriate accounting for acquisitions. title: Manufacturing Quality Engineer
description: . Summary. Alarm.com is seeking someone as a Senior Manufacturing Quality Engineer to apply his/her experience and technical knowhow on manufacturing quality engagement strategies from product development through sustaining operations ranging from stand-alone test stations to multi-station production lines. As part of a small, hardworking and accomplished team of experts, deep technical understanding of manufacturing processes and practical experience in quality issue investigations, QA/QC practices, and supplier quality management are essential for success. In this role, you will act as the key interface regarding all aspects of the quality between the product development engineering teams and our manufacturing value-added partners. You will lead the quality requirements and manufacturing processes, ensuring the manufactured products meet the design intent as well as working with various cross-functional teams jointly responsible for the overall quality program throughout the entire product lifecycle. Duties to be Performed. Lead the overall manufacturing quality management program, including the review of processes and SIPs for IQC, IPQC, OQC and FAI, the development of processes and SIPs for GRR, OBA and ORT, and the quality validations of procedures and SOPs for SMT, DIP and FATP. Work directly with manufacturing partners, Supply Chain Management Team, and Product Development Engineering Teams to develop product specific qualify inspection, monitoring, and verification procedures and processes. Review SCARs for component suppliers and 8Ds from manufacturing partners, implement quality training programs and/or additional quality requirements based on 8Ds, and track SCARs and 8D for continuous component and manufacturing quality improvement. Coordinate with Product Managers to review RMA claims from customers, to conduct root-cause analysis with the manufacturing partners, and to drive the corrective resolutions as part of the overall improvement plan. Work with Manufacturing Test Engineers and Production Engineers to validate and to ensure the manufacturing environment and production setup across the entire production system at all manufacturing sites are established and maintained according to the same quality standards. Team up with Production Engineers and manufacturing partners to monitor on-going production quality and to continuously improve manufacturing quality including that of product assembly, test setup, and testing environment. Support Production Engineers on manufacturing process simplification, optimization and standardization to achieve stable production lines with high quality yields. Participate in strategic sourcing discussions, in component sourcing, and in manufacturing partner selections based on their component reliability and manufacturing quality. Basic Qualifications. BS or MS degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electronic Engineering or related engineering degrees with a track record of relevant working experience. 10+ years of hands-on manufacturing quality experience with high-volume manufacturing of consumer and commercial electronic products. Professional written, verbal, and presentation skills in English and in Chinese with the ability to effectively communicate with the stakeholders. Ability for as needed pan-Asian and US travel. Requirements for this Position. Proven records of understanding the quality issues associated with materials, assembly and testing of consumer and commercial electronic products from the early prototype builds to the mass production builds. Established engineering capabilities in debugging production and product quality issues with effective engineering fixes for resolving/improving the issues. Established 5+ years of manufacturing quality management experience in camera related products. Experienced in all aspects of manufacturing processes including assembly and testing requirements, especially those for camera products, wireless communications products and gateway/bridge products. General understanding of the potential manufacturing quality issues associated with the design of assembly jigs and testing fixtures for consumer and commercial electronic products. Skilled in various application software such as Excel and PowerPoint for effective communication on subject matters with various stakeholders. Proficient in ISO-9001 and ISO-14001 requirements. . title: Marketing Program Manager
description: POSITION OVERVIEW. OpenEye, The Cloud Video Platform, an innovator in the design and development of cloud-centric software solutions for commercial video management systems, is seeking a Marketing Program Manager to join our growing Marketing team in the Liberty Lake, WA office. We are looking for an experienced marketing professional to lead OpenEye's program sponsorships, content syndication campaigns, and third-party partnerships to drive brand awareness, lead generation, and revenue growth for OpenEye. In addition to managing marketing programs, this role will provide hands-on support for ongoing website management in WordPress, helping ensure our website content, campaign landing pages, and digital experiences remain current, accurate, and aligned with marketing initiatives. This creative and team-oriented person will be a key member of OpenEye's marketing department and will play a leading role in implementing our marketing initiatives through our media sponsorship and website efforts. This individual contributor role reports directly to the Digital Marketing Manager.. RESPONSIBILITIES. Develop and execute strategy for marketing programs, including content syndication programs and sponsored webinars to support OpenEye's Marketing Qualified Lead (MQL) generation and revenue growth goals, including identification of new sponsorship vendors and evaluation of program ROI. Collaborate with the Marketing, Product, and Sales teams to develop marketing messaging, collateral and digital experiences as needed to support campaign development. Work with the event and content teams to identify areas of media sponsorship synergy at our OpenEye sponsored events to help elevate our brand awareness and event presence. Manage the budget tied to OpenEye's program sponsorships, as well as manage relationships with sponsorship vendors, and partner associations. Support ongoing website management in WordPress, including updating and publishing content, building or modifying campaign landing pages, coordinating site enhancements, and ensuring website content aligns with current marketing programs and branding guidelines. Partner with the Digital Marketing team to help maintain website accuracy, performance, and usability, and assist with troubleshooting or coordinating updates as needed. Other duties as assigned. title: Principal Network Security Engineer
description: . The Principal Network & Security Engineer is responsible for the management, lifecycle operations, and security of the organization's Cisco-based networking infrastructure. This individual will be expected to lead the administration, configuration, monitoring, and ongoing optimization of core network systems and platforms, as well as apply best practices in security management. The role combines technical operational management of critical Cisco platforms with broad information security responsibilities across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments. Responsibilities :. The Engineer's primary job responsibilities include:. Administer, monitor, and optimize Cisco portfolio infrastructure, including firewalls, identity, and network analytics platforms. Execute routine software/firmware upgrades, patching, and configuration updates on network and security appliances. Ensure effective network segmentation and secure access by configuring and enforcing network access controls. Manage and maintain secure remote access solutions for users and devices. Deploy, configure, and tune next-generation network perimeter and detection tools to ensure consistent policy enforcement. Oversee application delivery and web application security solutions, assisting with WAF configuration and incident response. Monitor network telemetry and activity for anomalous behavior or security events. Respond to and investigate network, security, or operational incidents in both on-premises and cloud environments. Support DDoS and threat protection systems, maintaining readiness and reporting suspicious activity. Collaborate with infrastructure and app teams to design and implement secure, compliant architectures across cloud and datacenter. Participate in vulnerability management processes, remediating identified exposures across managed platforms. Contribute to security operations, including event and log analysis, and improving detection capabilities. Develop and maintain infrastructure documentation, runbooks, and operational standards. Enable automation for repeatable network and security processes using scripting and modern tools. Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior staff on security best practices and platform operations. Other duties as assigned. REQUIREMENTS. Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field. Minimum 7 years of experience with enterprise networking and security, with significant hands-on Cisco platform management. Strong understanding of network firewalls, perimeter defense, and intrusion detection/prevention. Direct experience configuring and troubleshooting network access control systems and policies. Familiarity with cloud platform security fundamentals (AWS, Azure, or GCP) in hybrid enterprise environments. Practical knowledge of software, firmware, and patch management for large-scale infrastructure. Proficiency in troubleshooting layer 2/3 networking, VPNs, and secure remote access solutions. Experience with application delivery controllers and web application security. Ability to analyze network/endpoint telemetry and investigate security events or performance issues. Demonstrated skills using scripting or automation to streamline network/security management. Hands-on experience supporting vulnerability management and compliance requirements. High attention to detail, documentation, and change management practices. Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills. Willingness to stay current on evolving security threats and industry best practices. Relevant certifications (e.g., CCNP Security, CISSP, cloud security, or equivalent) are strongly preferred. title: Principal Software Engineer
description: Principal Software Engineer - emPower. Do you love working with connected devices, automation, and real-world systems? Have you automated your own home, built integrations across smart devices, or thought deeply about how cloud software should control physical systems reliably?. Alarm.com is looking for a versatile Principal Software Engineer to help lead architecture and engineering for our emPower team, which builds software for IoT, smart home automation, energy management, HVAC, water, and connected-device control experiences. This role is an IC role that sits at the intersection of cloud services, physical devices, mobile and web applications, automation logic, data processing, and customer-facing product experiences. As a Principal Software Engineer, you will provide hands-on technical leadership across teams. You will help define architecture, guide major design decisions, mentor engineers, and lead the evolution of systems that must be reliable, scalable, maintainable, and adaptable as our connected-device platform continues to grow. Alarm.com combines the product breadth and technical scale of a mature connected-device platform with the collaborative culture of a smaller engineering organization. This role is ideal for someone who wants to work across software, hardware, data, and product domains while helping shape systems used by millions of customers. What You'll Do. As a Principal Software Engineer on the emPower team, you will help design and evolve systems that coordinate physical devices, cloud services, mobile and web applications, automation engines, partner integrations, and data pipelines. You will work across product, firmware, platform, operations, and application engineering teams to turn ambiguous business and technical needs into reliable, scalable, and maintainable software systems. You will be expected to lead through technical depth, sound judgment, and influence. You will own important architecture decisions, guide implementation strategy, and help engineers across multiple teams build better systems. Day-to-Day Responsibilities. Provide hands-on technical leadership for systems spanning IoT device control, smart home automation, energy, HVAC, water, and connected-device experiences. Lead architecture and design for major software components, services, APIs, data flows, and integration patterns. Help evolve existing monolithic systems into more modular, scalable, reliable, and maintainable systems. Partner with product, firmware, platform, operations, and application teams to turn ambiguous needs into clear technical direction. Mentor engineers at multiple levels and help raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and reusable patterns. Drive cross-team collaboration and execution across multiple technical domains. Evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and methodologies where they can materially improve product capabilities or engineering outcomes. Reason across the full product stack, including backend services, databases, APIs, web and mobile experiences, device integrations, automation logic, and operational tooling. Be an expert on system architecture, functionality, data flows, operational processes, and the tools needed to operate production systems effectively. Provide technical thought leadership for major software components, systems, and features, earning alignment and driving adoption across teams. Exercise strong engineering judgment: know when to move quickly, when to invest in a robust platform capability, and when to avoid unnecessary complexity. Bring your ideas. We want our engineers to collaborate on product development, not blindly build to a spec. Other duties as assigned. What You Need. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 15+ years of professional software development experience. Proven experience designing, building, and delivering complex software systems. Strong object-oriented programming skills; experience with C#/.NET or a similar object-oriented language is required; direct C# and .NET experience would be a major plus. Significant database design, performance, and development experience. Experience leading technical direction across teams and influencing architecture beyond a single project or codebase. Experience mentoring engineers and helping develop people, practices, and reusable technical solutions. Ability to select appropriate frameworks, architecture patterns, and technical approaches, then educate teams and drive adoption. Strong analytical skills and a practical problem-solving mindset. Ability to lead and influence across teams without relying solely on reporting authority. Ability to reason across the full product stack, including backend services, data stores, APIs, device integrations, and web/mobile user experiences. Strong understanding of object-oriented design, software development lifecycles, and long-term maintainability concerns. Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, product owners, and business stakeholders. Experience That Would Be a Major Plus. Experience with IoT, smart home, energy management, HVAC, water, automation, or connected-device systems. Experience working with physical systems, hardware devices, firmware teams, or embedded-device integrations. Experience with event-driven systems, device telemetry, automation/rules engines, or distributed systems. Experience in modernizing monolithic systems or decomposing systems into modular services. Experience designing systems where cloud software interacts with deployed physical devices and must account for latency, reliability, compatibility, and operational visibility. Why This Role Matters. The emPower team works on software that connects the digital and physical world: devices, homes, energy systems, water systems, HVAC systems, automation logic, and customer-facing control experiences. The systems we build must be reliable, understandable, scalable, and adaptable as new devices, integrations, and product capabilities are added. As a Principal Software Engineer, you will help shape the architecture behind these experiences. Your work will influence multiple teams, improve the systems engineers build on, and help Alarm.com continue delivering connected-device products that are useful, reliable, and easy for customers to trust. title: Product Manager
description: Are you a creative self-starter who enjoys solving complex problems and turning ideas into real-world products? As a Product Manager at Alarm.com, you'll help define, build, and launch a new commercial product at the intersection of software, IoT, and AI-enabled development. This is not a traditional PM role focused only on customer discovery and requirements writing. We are looking for a technically minded, execution-oriented person who is excited to use AI tools as part of their daily work-to accelerate research, prototype ideas, analyze information, and contribute directly to the product's technical development. You'll work closely with engineering, design, quality, and business stakeholders to bring a new offering to market while building strong product, technical, and AI fluency along the way. WHY THIS ROLE. This role is a chance to help shape a new product offering from an early stage, with real influence over its direction, workflows, and execution. Rather than stepping into a mature product, you'll help define what gets built and how the team builds it. It's also a unique opportunity to go beyond traditional product management. In this role, you'll use AI tools as a core part of your workflow-not just to support planning and analysis, but to prototype, automate, and contribute directly to technical execution. If you're excited by ownership, technical problem-solving, and building something new with modern tools, this role offers an unusually hands-on start to a product management career. RESPONSIBILITIES. Collaborate with Quality and Beta teams to test, validate, and streamline functionality to ensure a high-value release. Go beyond traditional PM boundaries by using AI-assisted development tools to contribute directly to the code stack, internal tools, prototypes, or test assets-thriving in a hands-on, implementation-focused environment. Stakeholder Alignment & Enablement: Communicate and support alignment on product direction and priorities across teams. Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and Support to build excitement, create training materials, and support go-to-market strategies. Product Lifecycle Optimization: Assist in tracking product adoption, usage metrics, and customer feedback to support future prioritization decisions. Partner with Customer Support and Operations to triage and resolve issues, ensuring an outstanding end-to-end customer experience. About You. Extreme Ownership: You take complete accountability for moving work forward, proactively stepping in to resolve challenges and keep the product on track. Continuous Learner: You possess a growth mindset and are eager to build deep expertise in our product, the market, and your own technical and AI fluency. Cross-Functional Collaborator: You possess exceptional communication skills and excel at bridging the gap between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, keeping everyone aligned and excited about the product vision.
