What We Look For. 4+ years of experience in application security, software engineering, security engineering, vulnerability management, penetration testing, security operations, or equivalent practical experience.. Foundational programming ability in one or more languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Kotlin, or similar.. Comfort reading, navigating, and reasoning about code, even in unfamiliar codebases.. Experience using Git and GitHub or similar version-control workflows, including branches, commits, pull requests, code review, issues, or project tracking.. Some hands-on experience building, testing, breaking, or securing software. This could include professional experience, internships, security labs, CTFs, bug bounty work, open-source contributions, personal projects, automation scripts, internal tools, or coursework.. Ability to write clear, maintainable scripts or small programs to solve practical problems, automate manual workflows, analyze data, validate findings, or improve security processes.. Foundational understanding of common web, API, mobile, cloud, and application security risks, such as OWASP Top 10 issues, authentication and authorization flaws, injection, insecure design, secrets exposure, dependency risks, and data protection concerns.. Interest in offensive security, such as studying for or completing security certifications, practicing web/API testing, learning exploit development fundamentals, using tools like Burp Suite, or participating in labs and capture-the-flag environments.. Exposure to vulnerability management concepts, including triage, severity assessment, remediation tracking, false-positive analysis, compensating controls, and risk-based prioritization.. Ability to reason about risk and tradeoffs, not just identify issues. You can explain what could go wrong, how likely it is, what impact it may have, and what options exist to reduce risk.. Strong product and engineering empathy. You seek to understand launch goals, technical constraints, user impact, and business priorities before recommending a path forward.. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain security findings in practical, actionable terms.. A collaborative mindset and comfort working across product, engineering, compliance, risk, infrastructure, and security teams.. Curiosity, humility, and a growth mindset. You proactively seek feedback, ask good questions, and continue building your technical depth.. Secure-by-design judgment, including the ability to spot patterns, recommend simple controls, and balance launch velocity with meaningful risk reduction.. . Base Pay Grade - L. Equity Grade - 5. On the ML Fraud team, you'll build and improve machine learning systems that make real-time transaction decisions, protecting consumers and merchants while balancing fraud loss, customer experience, and conversion. You'll work closely with experienced ML engineers, platform partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to take models from idea to prototype to production, and to keep them healthy with strong measurement and monitoring as fraud patterns evolve.. . What you'll do. - You will lead development of new fraud prediction models using a mix of approaches for tabular, graph, and behavioral data. - You will build and scale feature pipelines and training datasets from proprietary and third-party signals, partnering with data and platform teams when needed. - You will prototype new modeling ideas and features, run offline experiments, and drive the best-performing approaches into production with appropriate risk controls. - You productionize models: integrate into batch and/or real-time decision systems, and improve reliability, latency, and operational robustness. - You will instrument and monitor model and data health, and help define retraining/backtesting workflows as fraud patterns evolve. - Identify and implement foundational improvements to how the team builds models. - You will collaborate across Engineering, Fraud Analytics, Product, and ML Platform to define requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and communicate results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. . description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter-giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk. About The Role. Affirm is building a de novo bank, and this role will help establish and scale its operating foundation. You will own the Finxact core and digital banking experience platforms, lead deposit and lending operations strategy, and partner with servicing teams to build resilient, well-controlled processes that deliver transparent, reliable financial products. What You'll Do. Own the implementation, configuration, and ongoing administration of Finxact as the Bank's core system of record, including product structures, rates and fees, transaction and posting rules, account parameters, general-ledger mappings, user entitlements, environments, and controlled production changes. Own the operational delivery and ongoing management of Savana and the Bank's integrated digital account-opening, online and mobile banking experiences. Direct lending operations by validating underwriting and eligibility results against Bank guidelines; approving or declining funding within delegated authority; creating and approving funding wires with appropriate segregation of duties; validating loan boarding and journal-entry bookings; and reconciling funding, settlement, daily loan activity, and exceptions. Oversee loan purchase and sale operations, including seasoning and eligibility validation, loan-tape and documentation quality control, approval and settlement, confirmation of funds received, accurate sold status and sold-date updates, boarding validation, and completion of purchase and sale audits. Build and maintain the Bank's operational control environment in accordance with Bank-approved policies and independent governance. Own documented procedures, maker-checker controls, reconciliations, access reviews, exception aging, quality assurance, records and evidence, root-cause analysis, issue remediation, and audit and examination readiness; partner with Compliance on BSA/AML, OFAC, consumer-protection, privacy, funds-availability, payments, complaint, and other applicable requirements. Maintain Bank decision rights, data ownership, service levels, audit and remediation rights, and escalation paths; monitor performance, capacity, releases, incidents, and control reports; coordinate root-cause reviews; and maintain tested business-continuity, disaster-recovery, transition, and manual-workaround capabilities. Lead and develop a high-performing Bank Operations team through clear decision rights, capacity planning, cross-training, performance management, succession planning, and escalation coverage. Establish metrics for processing timeliness and completeness, reconciliations, exceptions, failed boarding, operational losses, customer-impacting incidents, vendor performance, and control effectiveness, and provide clear reporting and recommendations to Bank leadership. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Accounting, Finance, Treasury, Lending, Compliance, Risk, Information Security, Fraud, Customer Care, Internal Audit, and third parties to design scalable workflows, automate controls, resolve systemic issues, and deliver safe, reliable customer experiences. What We Look For. 8+ years of relevant experience in banking operations, digital banking, financial technology, or core-platform delivery, including meaningful experience leading teams and operating in a regulated financial institution. Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, converting, or administering a core banking platform; experience with Finxact or another modern cloud-native, API-first core is strongly preferred. Experience owning digital account-opening and online or mobile banking platforms and coordinating integrations, user-acceptance testing, releases, production support, and vendor-driven change. Deep working knowledge of deposit and lending operations, including ACH, wires, checks and in-clearing, account funding, reconciliations, general-ledger impacts, exception management, loan funding and boarding, and loan purchase or sale settlement. Demonstrated ability to design and operate effective controls, including segregation of duties, approval authorities, reconciliations, access management, quality assurance, issue management, recordkeeping, and audit or regulatory-examination support. Strong understanding of bank regulatory and risk expectations applicable to deposit, lending, payments, third-party, consumer-protection, privacy, business-continuity, and operational-resilience activities. Proven success managing critical technology and operations vendors, service levels, incidents, root-cause analysis, remediation commitments, and executive escalations. The International Consumer product team is responsible for building and scaling Affirm's direct-to-consumer products and experiences across international markets. This includes our apps, wallets, marketplace, and related offerings that help consumers discover, use, and manage Affirm. In this role, you will work closely with a broad set of cross functional teams across the entire business, as well as a number of engineering teams. Effective stakeholder management and ability to successfully navigate organizational dynamics are a must for success. You should be commercially minded, be high agency with a bias towards action, and comfortable having technical conversations (and opinions). . What You'll Do. Take Affirm's direct-to-consumer products and adapt them for international markets by understanding consumer needs, analyzing performance data, and iterating on the product's features and capabilities. Collaborate with stakeholders (such as Design, Research, Analytics, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, Credit, Fraud, etc.) to shape your product roadmap and incorporate legal, governance, and regulatory oversight into your products. About the Role. Affirm is building its own bank - and this role sits in the engineering team that runs it. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a deliberately small, AI-native team that owns the systems behind Affirm's bank: vendor-integrated banking infrastructure, durable workflows, data platform, and the operational tooling that holds it all together. You'll work alongside other senior engineers, with direct exposure to senior bank and Affirm leadership, to launch the bank's deposit product, drive loan originations through the bank entity, and bring card issuing online in time. This is a rare opportunity to shape a new business from its very first systems - a startup-like build inside an established company. You'll be one of the first engineers on Affirm's bank, moving with the speed, autonomy, and ownership of an early-stage team while leveraging Affirm's brand, distribution, and consumer reach. The systems you build and the standards you set will directly determine what the bank becomes. What You'll Do. Own bank systems end-to-end. Design, build, integrate, operate, and own incident response for the bank's core technical surfaces: cloud infrastructure, data platform, durable workflow orchestration, core banking configuration, CI/CD, networking, and the Bank ↔ Affirm Inc integration. Own the operational posture of your work. Set up monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and the practices that keep the bank's systems reliable, observable, and audit-ready. Comfortable in ambiguity - you move fast, ask hard questions, and take ownership before being asked, while balancing speed with engineering judgment. The Card Loan Platform team builds the high-throughput decision engine at the heart of Affirm's card products. Unlike traditional cards, every pay-later transaction is backed by its own unique loan, and our system is the "invisible piping" that makes this complex model work at scale. Every swipe triggers our platform to solve a hard problem in milliseconds: matching messy, fragmented payment network data to the correct loan to drive real-time approvals, origination, and refunds. As Affirm experiences explosive growth, our team's contributions are a key enabler. This isn't just another backend role; you'll be building the "financial brain" for our flagship card products, with your work on the critical path for every single swipe. We're tackling a unique, high-stakes distributed systems challenge that demands exceptional correctness and massive scale. You will partner closely with product, data science, and engineering teams to design and build the future of our industry-leading money movement platform. If you are passionate about making foundational design decisions and building a beloved, lasting financial brand-come join us. It's going to be an amazing ride!. What you'll do. Drive technical strategy by leading the planning, prioritization, and execution of projects, ensuring alignment with product, technical, and business goals. Lead the end-to-end system design and development of large-scale, high-availability services. This includes building robust APIs and data models for our micro-service and event-driven architectures. Collaborate across functions with partners in Product, Analytics, Design, Legal, and Accounting and to define requirements and execute our card loan attribution and lifecycle strategy. Ensure system health and performance by analyzing and troubleshooting complex technical issues, optimizing existing code, and driving solutions that focus on long-term robustness and scalability. Mentor and grow the team by guiding junior engineers, leading technical discussions and design reviews, and championing best practices through code review. What we look for. 5+ years of experience in software development or engineering, with a deep understanding of system design and architecture. Motivated leader, inspiring team growth and fostering a culture of continuous learning. Excellent communicator, adept at sharing complex ideas with diverse audiences. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a creative and solution-oriented mindset. Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python, Kotlin, or similar. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). Knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL), web frameworks, and RESTful API development. title: Senior Software Engineer, backend (Online Storage)
description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter-giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.. The Data and Storage Services team is responsible for Affirm's data infrastructure across OLTP and OLAP systems, spanning critical online checkout databases, batch orchestration, streaming infrastructure, event-driven frameworks, BI, analytics tooling, large-scale data platforms, and agentic data tools such as semantic layers and internal platform data applications. Our mission is to provide trustworthy, intuitive, and cost-efficient solutions for Affirmers to secure, store, analyze, and transform data at exceptional scale. The Online Storage team provides a set of managed databases as a platform, used to persist data for all Affirm services. Our platform enables self-service access to OLTP storage systems, including Relational DB(MySQL), KV(DynamoDB), Distributed SQL(TiDB) and Cache(Redis). As a team, we are responsible for various data and access patterns, including but not limited to mission-critical financial transactional data, data science models, and any new persistence use case. These responsibilities require us to learn and gain deep expertise in various database systems. We are looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer who can architect, build and scale Relational and Distributed SQL Databases identifying opportunities to improve how we build, productionize, operate and improve this mission-critical infrastructure to unlock substantial value within our business. You'll have the opportunity to directly influence your team's roadmap in close collaboration with your peers, share your knowledge and expertise with others and learn from some of the best on our shared mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives. What you'll do. You will build and operate the control plane for large-scale distributed SQL databases such as MySQL and TiDB, automating provisioning, failover, backups and upgrades end to end. You will design and execute reliability-focused schema and data migrations across multi-tenant database clusters, with zero downtime for the products that depend on them. You will own the networking stack that connects services to storage on Kubernetes, including connection proxies such as ProxySQL, and tune it for latency, resilience and failover. You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery. You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs. You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them. You will support the operations and availability of your team's artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting "keep the lights on" & on-call efforts. You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks. You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example. What we look for. You have a total of 5+ years of experience as a software engineer. You are experienced in designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale technologies like Python, Kotlin, AWS, MySQL, Terraform and Kubernetes. You have in-depth, hands-on experience with large-scale database deployments in a production environment. You have expertise in distributed databases and database technologies such as MySQL(Preferred), TiDB(Preferred), Postgres, Spanner, Vitess, CockroachDB etc. Solid understanding of distributed database architecture, data modeling, and performance tuning. Particularly, expertise in SQL tuning and performance optimization techniques. You have expertise in database benchmarking, load testing, and capacity planning. You are familiar with connection poolers and proxies such as ProxySQL, RDS Proxy, Pg Bouncer, PgDog etc. You have built control-plane or automation tooling for databases, such as provisioning, failover, upgrades or schema migrations, ideally on Kubernetes. You have executed zero-downtime migrations and major version upgrades on production databases, and have built CLI tooling or runbooks to make those procedures repeatable. You understand Kubernetes networking, service discovery and TLS well enough to debug connection and failover problems between services and databases. You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others. You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely. Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders. You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team. This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field. This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan. As a Senior Technical Account Manager (Senior TAM, L6) at Affirm, you will own the operational aspect of technical account management across Affirm's strategic alliance portfolio-alerting, monitoring, troubleshooting, delivering against SLAs, fielding technical inquiries, and performing investigations and analysis, while also driving technical initiatives that translate merchant business objectives into technical strategies and product optimizations. Senior TAMs are part of the Engineering team and collaborate closely with Affirm's Product, Engineering, Operations, Customer Success, and Frontline Technical Support teams. This is an operations-heavy role to start. Expect the majority of your early focus to be on keeping merchant integrations healthy-monitoring, triage, troubleshooting, and SLA delivery-while you progressively take on more custom solutioning and cross-functional initiatives. Over your first 6-12 months, as you build operational mastery, you will grow into owning your own book of accounts and carrying it through to end-to-end account ownership. A Senior TAM independently owns operational health across the strategic alliance portfolio, designs custom integration solutions grounded in Affirm's standard integrations, drives cross-team collaboration on initiatives, acts as a technical lead on team projects, and mentors less-experienced members of the team. What You'll Do. Own the operational aspect of technical account management across Affirm's strategic alliance portfolio-alerting, monitoring, troubleshooting, and fielding technical inquiries-so integrations stay healthy and issues are resolved quickly.. Deliver against SLAs, proactively surfacing technical risks before they become customer-impacting and responding with urgency to merchant issues.. Perform in-depth investigations and root-cause analysis across logs, queries, and integration data, owning resolution end to end and escalating to cross-functional partners or executives when needed.. Drive technical initiatives and partner with internal and merchant stakeholders on launch initiatives-expansions, promotions, new product adoption, and integration optimizations-that grow the value of the accounts after launch.. Design and deliver high-scope, often-custom integration solutions grounded in Affirm's standard integrations-combining, extending, and tailoring them to complex, open-ended problems while balancing speed, quality, maintainability, reliability, and scalability.. Act as a technical lead for internal projects, defining and delivering well-scoped milestones and executing the project roadmap.. Operationalize best practices by creating and updating playbooks, runbooks, alerting, and UAT certification plans across the strategic alliance portfolio and continuously reduce keep-the-lights-on (KTLO) work.. Partner with Product and Engineering leads to identify, plan, and prioritize projects based on team goals and resources, acting as the voice of the merchant to influence the roadmap.. Mentor and level up less-experienced TAMs, share learnings from your integrations and investigations, and contribute to interviewing and team development.. Over your first 6-12 months, grow into owning a dedicated book of strategic alliance accounts-carrying operational ownership through to end-to-end account ownership.. What We Look For. Professional Background: at least six years in a technical, external-facing role such as Technical Account Management, Solutions/Partner Engineering, or Solutions Architecture-ideally within FinTech, payments, or SaaS-with a demonstrated track record of owning the operational health of technical accounts and delivering against SLAs.. Operational Ownership: proven ability to run alerting, monitoring, troubleshooting, and technical inquiries across a set of accounts, balancing reactive operational work with proactive initiatives.. Ownership & Autonomy: proven ability to independently scope and deliver complex, open-ended technical work, and to partner with stakeholders on launch initiatives, with strong project management and follow-through.. API Expertise: deep understanding of RESTful APIs, webhooks, and the HTTP protocol, with hands-on experience using tools like Postman to debug and validate integrations.. Architecture Fluency: Experience in API integrations and the ability to design custom solutions on top of them to solve complex merchant challenges.. Coding & Code Fluency: ability to read and understand production-level code (HTML, JavaScript, SQL, and ideally one server-side language such as Python) and to author new, novel queries to diagnose merchant or system issues.. Troubleshooting Acumen: ability to diagnose issues using browser developer consoles, log analysis and observability platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Chronosphere), and ticketing systems (e.g., Jira, Notion).. Technical Communication: excellent verbal and written communication; able to tailor explanations to both non-technical leaders and technical teams, read a room and adjust in real time, and synthesize technical challenges back to internal teams.. Relationship Management: ability to discover and develop relationships with technical decision-makers, secure written consensus on integration milestones, and drive cross-team collaboration.. Leadership & Mentorship: demonstrated ability to mentor teammates, set best practices, and lead technical initiatives; a growth mindset with self-awareness and a habit of seeking and acting on feedback.. . title: Software Engineer II, Backend (Online Storage)
description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter-giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.. The Data and Storage Services team is responsible for Affirm's data infrastructure across OLTP and OLAP systems, spanning critical online checkout databases, batch orchestration, streaming infrastructure, event-driven frameworks, BI, analytics tooling, large-scale data platforms, and agentic data tools such as semantic layers and internal platform data applications. Our mission is to provide trustworthy, intuitive, and cost-efficient solutions for Affirmers to secure, store, analyze, and transform data at exceptional scale. The Online Storage team provides a set of managed databases as a platform, used to persist data for all Affirm services. Our platform enables self-service access to OLTP storage systems, including Relational DB(MySQL), KV(DynamoDB), Distributed SQL(TiDB) and Cache(Redis). As a team, we are responsible for various data and access patterns, including but not limited to mission-critical financial transactional data, data science models, and any new persistence use case. These responsibilities require us to learn and gain deep expertise in various database systems. We are looking for a talented Software Engineer who can build and scale Cache Services (Redis and Valkey) identifying opportunities to improve how we migrate, productionize, operate, self-service and improve this mission-critical infrastructure to unlock substantial value within our business. You'll have the opportunity to directly influence your team's roadmap in close collaboration with your peers, share your knowledge and expertise with others and learn from some of the best on our shared mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives. What you'll do. Build and scale Affirm's Cache Services on Redis and Valkey, owning cluster migrations end to end and delivering them in phases against agreed outcomes. Productionize cache clusters: capacity and shard planning, failover and replication setup, upgrades, and staged rollouts with rollback paths. Replace manual cache requests (provisioning, config changes, access) with automated, audited self-service workflows. Operate the fleet in production: define SLOs, build alerting for hot keys, memory pressure and replication lag, and use on-call findings to reduce KTLO. Partner with client teams on caching strategy (key design, TTLs, consistency, client timeouts) and feed fleet data into the team's roadmap. Familiar with the building blocks of distributed systems, and the technologies like AWS, MySQL, Redis/Valkey, Terraform and Kubernetes. Have worked on Redis, Valkey or a comparable in-memory store in production and understand replication, persistence, cluster mode, eviction, and their failure modes. Can reason about a caching workload end to end: hit rates, tail latency, hot keys, stampedes, and consistency with the source of truth. Experience automating infrastructure operations with Terraform, Kubernetes and Python, and prefer tested playbooks over manual runbooks. Experience carrying on-call for a stateful service and can take an incident from metrics to root cause to a durable fix. Set up the measurement foundation for loyalty, including holdouts, incrementality testing and long-run LTV, then tune earn and burn rates and tier thresholds off what the data says. Partner with Risk, Credit, Legal, Compliance, Finance and Marketing to design rewards that are compliant and clearly disclosed, with no hidden fees or fine print that surprises people. Align senior stakeholders and pull together dependencies across Card, Shopping, Servicing and Marketing, leading embedded engineering and design pods through a lot of ambiguity. What we look for. 8+ years in Product Management, with a track record in consumer mobile apps, fintech, or neobanks. Built or scaled a loyalty, rewards or engagement program: card rewards, points, tiers, subscription benefits, or something equivalent. You know earn and burn mechanics and what makes a program pay for itself. History of launching products from scratch, not just optimizing what already exists. Owned repeat usage, cohort retention or share of wallet as a primary metric, and know which levers actually move them. Comfortable building the financial model yourself and defending reward cost, funding mix and payback to Finance and leadership. Strong UX instincts and a high bar for design. title: Staff Security Engineer, Enterprise AI
description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter-giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.. The InfoSec team protects Affirm's systems and data from evolving threats. We manage security risk, monitor vulnerabilities, and enforce protective controls across the company. The team leads incident response, compliance, identity and access management, and employee training. Our goal is to ensure that security is built into every system and decision at Affirm. We maintain a secure, trustworthy environment so the business can operate and grow with confidence. In this role, you'll build and run Affirm's end-to-end security review process for enterprise AI/LLM systems evaluating architecture, prioritizing AI-specific risks, and designing the controls and guardrails that let Affirm adopt AI safely, partnering across Security, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, IT, and Engineering to make it scalable and repeatable. What you'll do. You will lead and continuously improve Affirm's enterprise AI security review process evaluating the architecture, data flows, permissions, and design of internal AI tools, agentic/MCP-based systems, and AI features - and embed security requirements into the design phase. You will threat model AI/LLM-based systems and their data flows for risks such as prompt injection, insecure output handling, excessive agency, tool-permission abuse, data poisoning, and sensitive-data exposure, and drive remediation. You will review source code, system prompts, agent configurations, and tool/permission manifests (e.g., MCP definitions), and help tool owners build security-focused test cases and red-team/eval scenarios to verify requirements before launch. You will design and build security guardrails and tooling for AI systems permission boundaries, authn/authz for agentic tools and MCP servers, data-handling controls, logging/monitoring, and policy-as-code (Python, IaC) - to enforce and automate AI security. You will evaluate the AI capabilities of third-party SaaS vendors (e.g., Notion, Slack, Google Workspace) as part of vendor and SaaS security reviews and drive risk-based adoption decisions. You will identify emerging classes of AI/agentic security vulnerabilities, develop mitigations before they become incidents, and contribute to AI-specific incident response playbooks as a senior escalation point. You will lead cross-functional AI security initiatives to closure, advise technical and executive stakeholders as an internal point of expertise, and stay current on the AI security landscape (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS) to translate new research into practical controls. What we look for. You are a seasoned security engineer with hands-on experience designing, evaluating, and maintaining security architecture for AI/LLM-based systems, plus deep expertise in enterprise security systems, processes, and controls. You have practical experience threat modeling and reviewing AI/LLM applications (e.g., against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and securing agentic systems and tool-calling frameworks - MCP servers/clients, tool-permission models, and agent-to-tool trust boundaries. You have built AI governance artifacts (acceptable use policy, data-handling standards, vendor/model risk assessments) and evaluated AI capabilities within SaaS platforms (e.g., Notion AI, Slack AI, Google Workspace AI, GitHub Copilot) as part of vendor reviews. You have experience with enterprise tools for AI visibility and control (e.g., CASB, IDP/Okta) and familiarity with the corporate systems where AI is adopted (OpenAI, Anthropic, GitHub, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Jira). You can build security tooling, guardrails, and detections with Python or similar, and deploy cloud services and policy-as-code using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar); familiarity with Kubernetes and AWS. You understand how LLMs and agentic systems are built (RAG, embeddings, fine-tuning, tool use) and authn/authz models (OAuth2, SAML, service-account/non-human identities) for agentic and machine-to-machine access, with strong application-architecture and threat-modeling fundamentals. You can lead cross-functional initiatives across Security, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance and drive them to closure, and communicate effectively with technical and executive audiences. Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, PCI DSS) and applying IAM to non-human/agent identities is a plus.. Base Pay Grade - P. Equity Grade - 13. title: Staff Software Engineer, Affirm Bank
description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter-giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.. About the Role. Affirm is building its own bank - and this role is one of the most senior individual-contributor seats on the engineering team that runs it. We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be a technical anchor for a deliberately small, AI-native team that owns the systems behind Affirm's bank: vendor-integrated banking infrastructure, the data platform, and the operational tooling that holds it all together. You'll set technical direction across that surface area, own the hardest problems on the team - including the Bank ↔ Affirm Inc integration boundary - and operate with direct exposure to senior bank and Affirm leadership. This is a rare opportunity to shape a new business from its very first systems - a startup-like build inside an established company - at a level of ownership that goes beyond delivering your own projects. As a Staff engineer here you set the bar: the architecture, the standards, and the technical strategy that the rest of the team builds against. The team is small and AI-native, the surface area is broad, and the decisions you make carry far - every system you ship serves real customers under a real bank charter, and the patterns you establish determine what the bank becomes. What You'll Do. Set technical direction across the bank's systems. Own the medium-to-long-term technical strategy for the bank's core surfaces - cloud infrastructure, data platform, core banking configuration, CI/CD, networking, and the Bank ↔ Affirm Inc integration - and make the architecture calls the rest of the team builds against. Generalist breadth is expected; you go deep where the risk is highest. Own the hardest problems end-to-end. Personally design, build, integrate, and operate the most ambiguous and highest-stakes pieces of the stack, and own incident response for them. You take the problems no one else can fully scope and turn them into well-defined systems with clear failure domains, monitoring, and runbooks. Be the force multiplier on a small team. Set and hold the bar for code review, design review, and examiner-readable documentation. Establish the patterns and standards that let a deliberately small team punch far above its size, and level up every engineer who joins after you. Ship AI-first, and push the frontier of it. Treat AI tools and agentic workflows as a load-bearing capability for code, design review, runbook generation, and operations - and actively push yourself and the team on what an AI-leveraged engineering function can deliver in place of additional headcount. Lead vendor selection and ownership. Drive evaluation, integration, and ongoing oversight of the bank's third-party platforms across the core, data, identity, observability, and card-processing stacks. Carry the bank's most critical vendor relationships end-to-end: integration, operations, escalation, and audit. Define the integration boundary with Affirm Inc. Set the domain edges, data flows, and integration patterns between the bank and Affirm Inc so the bank's products work seamlessly inside the Affirm ecosystem while preserving the legal and regulatory separation the charter requires. Drive this across Affirm Inc engineering teams whose systems integrate with the bank's. Build for examiners. Partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, BSA/AML, Finance, and Internal Audit so compliance is a property of the product from day one. The systems you design are the artifacts FDIC and state examiners will inspect - design and document them to a standard that holds up under examination and audit review. Own the operational posture of the bank's systems. Set the reliability, observability, alerting, runbook, incident-response, and disaster-recovery practices that keep the bank standalone-operable and audit-ready, while keeping the operational footprint intentionally small. You will support the operations and availability of your team's artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting "keep the lights on" & on-call efforts. Influence up and across the organization. Communicate technical strategy, tradeoffs, and constraints with clarity to bank executives, the Bank Board, Compliance, Risk - and to engineers outside the bank across the broader Affirm org. The relationships you build beyond the team shape how cleanly the integration boundary works. Help grow the team and the bar. As engineers join, they inherit a function whose architecture, practices, and standards you helped set. Mentor peers, provide high-signal feedback, contribute to hiring, and lead by example. What We Look For. 8+ years of software engineering experience, with staff-level, hands-on builder credentials and a track record of owning ambiguous, high-stakes systems end-to-end through launch and operations. Comfortable owning ambiguity at the largest scale on the team - you move fast, make the tough prioritization calls, take ownership before being asked, and balance speed with the engineering judgment the hardest decisions require. Hungry to leverage AI to drive outcomes - fluent with AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Cursor, Codex, agentic workflows) and actively pushing yourself and your team to use them as a multiplier for code quality, velocity, and what a deliberately small team can ship. Bias toward simplicity - experience building toward a small, lean engineering culture that rewards "buy over build", a default-deny posture, and standalone-operability over an abundance of tooling. A track record of setting technical direction - you've defined architecture and multi-quarter technical strategy for systems beyond your own projects, and led the execution of it across engineers and teams without needing a management title to do so. Deep systems thinking across public cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), and cloud data platforms (Snowflake or comparable) - you understand their failure modes and tradeoffs, not just their surface APIs. Regulated-environment experience - direct work in banking, payments, securities, healthcare, or another setting subject to external examination, where the work involves examiner-facing documentation and decisions. Direct experience selecting, integrating, and operating meaningful third-party platforms under operational ownership after launch. Comfortable as the technical face of the work to non-engineering stakeholders - bank executives, the Board, Compliance, Risk, Finance, and examiners - and able to document decisions so they hold up under audit review. Exceptional written and verbal communication - you can distill complex technical, regulatory, and operational concepts into clear narratives for executives, boards, and non-engineering audiences. This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field. Nice to have. Prior work inside a bank, neobank, Banking-as-a-Service provider, card issuer/processor, or fintech with a chartered bank subsidiary. Direct experience with a de novo bank launch, an early-stage bank buildout, or a greenfield regulated platform. Hands-on experience with a bank core, card processing / issuer processor integration, or digital bank experience integration. Hands-on experience standing up a greenfield cloud organization - fresh cloud org, IAM model, and data platform - under a tight, default-deny security posture. Familiarity with the regulatory framework that shapes the work: FDIC examinations, GLBA / Reg P (affiliate data sharing), BSA/AML, Reg E, Reg DD, Reg Z, model risk, and third-party risk management. The Capacity Modeling team ensures Affirm can safely handle forecasted traffic-especially during peak sales events-by translating demand forecasts into concrete, testable capacity plans. They build and maintain statistical capacity models that map traffic inputs (e.g., checkout volume, app opens, batch/job activity) to resource outputs (CPU, memory, connections) and then convert those forecasts into recommended capacity settings such as pod counts, HPA ranges, and/or infrastructure sizing changes across regions and environments.. The coverage of infrastructure resources includes not only Compute but also infrastructure such as ElasticCache, DynamoDB, AuroraDB, and more.. What You'll Do. You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects. You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed. You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes. You take ownership of your team's operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, policies, testing and alerting in place to support "keep the lights on" & on-call efforts. You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks. You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.. . What We Look For. You have 8+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin. You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Spark and Kubernetes. You have experience supporting scale up and down of large scale sales event such as Prime Day, Black Friday Cyber Monday, or other sales holidays. You have tuned autoscaling, CPU/Memory, and multi-threading for compute type workloads. You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others. You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work. Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers. You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team. Pay Grade - P. Equity Grade - 7. Engineering owns cost visibility and optimization across Affirm's cloud and AI infrastructure. We treat cost anomalies with the same rigor as production incidents: we've built a severity framework (mirroring Affirm's SEV0-3 incident model but mapped to dollar impact) with defined detection sources, TTD/TTR metrics, and escalation paths, and we operate a clear RACI with partner orgs - we own visibility and alerting, and partner teams own remediation (at times we may dig in deep and own remediation too!), so accountability never gets diffuse. As a Staff Cost Engineer, you'll operate at the intersection of finance, infrastructure, and data engineering - designing the tooling, automation, and processes that scale cost governance across a fast-growing multi-cloud and multi-AI-vendor footprint. You'll set technical direction for the team, influence cost strategy with infra and platform leaders across the org, and turn ambiguous "why did spend spike" questions into durable systems and self-service tooling. We're a small, high-leverage team - you'll have outsized influence on how Affirm thinks about cost.. You'll have the opportunity to directly influence your team's roadmap in close collaboration with your peers, share your knowledge and expertise with others and learn from some of the best on our shared mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives.. Founded in 1986 and headquartered in New York City, the firm has 400+ employees across New York, London, Hong Kong, Tokyo, Dublin and Singapore and serves institutional, wealth and individual investors around the world. Assist with developing and maintaining portfolio level data in a manner that's easily accessible to the accounting and investment teams. Drive the semi-annual budgeting and reforecast process for CNSREIT. Leverage AI, automation, and advanced analytics tools to improve forecasting, reporting, and decision-support processes. Expertise in Active Directory and core Windows services. VMware vSphere experience (ESXi, vCenter, HA/DRS, networking) and an understanding of enterprise compute and SAN storage. Experience designing and operating Azure infrastructure - virtual machines, storage, backup and site recovery. Upstart's centralized Affidavit Support function is a sub team within the Recovery Operations department. As the ALM Manager, you will own the Bank's first-line asset and liability management and interest rate risk management framework. Reporting to the Bank Treasurer, you will lead implementation and ongoing operation of the Bank's ALM platform, develop and govern key behavioral assumptions, analyze net interest income and economic value sensitivity, and translate model results into balance sheet and risk-management recommendations. Design and evaluate parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, ramps, curve twists, and business-plan scenarios; identify key drivers of risk, monitor limits and early warning indicators, and explain period-over-period changes in the Bank's interest rate risk profile. Recommend balance sheet, product pricing, funding, investment, and hedging actions to manage interest rate risk within approved appetite and limits, and partner with business leaders to assess the ALM implications of new products and changes in balance sheet strategy. Hands-on experience operating an ALM platform and producing net interest income and economic value sensitivity analyses under multiple rate and balance sheet scenarios. Experience developing and governing model assumptions, reconciling source data to model inputs, analyzing model results, monitoring policy limits, and preparing ALM or IRR reporting for senior management or an Asset and Liability Committee. Preferred Qualifications. Experience presenting ALM and interest rate risk analyses to an Asset and Liability Committee, executive management, a Board or Board committee, auditors, and bank regulators. Knowledge of applicable bank regulatory guidance for interest rate risk and model risk management, including OCC, Federal Reserve, and FDIC supervisory expectations. Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills; proficiency with SQL or similar data tools; and familiarity with ALM platforms such as Empyrean, QRM, BancWare, Moody's Analytics, or similar systems. Upstart's Secured Lending Fraud Oversight function is the Bank's first-line fraud detection, investigation, and monitoring across the HELOC and Auto Lending business lines. As a business unit function, the team owns fraud risk identification, investigation of suspected fraudulent activity, referral package preparation, and fraud trend analysis and reporting. The fraud function operates with direct access to loan files, origination data, and dealer and channel relationships - enabling the depth and speed of investigation that the Bank's fraud risk profile demands. The team works in close coordination with the Secured Lending Quality Control function: QC analysts escalate fraud indicators identified during file reviews, and fraud analysts provide fraud-focused review support during lower-volume periods, consistent with a documented cross-utilization protocol and independence safeguards. As a Fraud Analyst, you will own day-to-day fraud detection and investigation for your assigned product line(s). You will investigate suspected fraud across the entire loan life cycle from application through loan servicing; identify and document emerging typologies and fraud patterns; prepare escalation and SAR referral packages for review; and partner with Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Legal to strengthen fraud controls across the business. This is an opportunity for an experienced fraud professional who is energized by building investigation programs in a fast-paced, technology-driven lending environment - and who wants to operate at the intersection of fraud, compliance, and AI-powered risk controls. Own first-line fraud detection and investigation across your assigned secured lending product line(s), monitoring for suspicious activity and fraud indicators across application, origination, and servicing. Investigate key fraud risks and emerging typologies, including application fraud, identity fraud (true-name and synthetic), income and employment misrepresentation, collateral fraud, and Auto dealer-related fraud patterns. Investigate product specific fraud typologies including occupancy misrepresentation, valuation inflation, and undisclosed liabilities or loan stacking. Prepare comprehensive fraud escalation and SAR referral packages for review - documenting facts, evidence, typology, and recommendations. Conduct early payment default (EPD) fraud file reviews - performing fraud indicator review on loans reaching 60+ days past due within 90 days of origination. Integrate closely with the Secured Lending QC team - triage fraud-related alerts surfaced by the QC Engine's daily monitoring output; provide typology and red flag feedback to improve detection rules and origination controls. Coordinate across Operations, Compliance, Legal, and Risk on fraud control enhancements, law enforcement information requests, and regulatory response support. Proactively identify regulatory risks related to fraud in your product line(s) and adjacent areas, including obligations under OCC Bulletin 2019-37, FFIEC BSA/AML Manual, Red Flags Rule (12 CFR Part 41, Subpart J), 12 CFR 21.11, and product-specific fraud risk requirements. Experience preparing fraud investigation case documentation - fact and evidence assembly, typology analysis, and written escalation packages for compliance or legal review. Familiarity with SAR referral processes, 12 CFR 21.11 SAR thresholds and timelines. Working knowledge of BSA/AML program requirements applicable to consumer lending, including CIP/CDD, OFAC screening, suspicious activity monitoring, and Red Flags Rule obligations. Working knowledge of OCC enterprise fraud risk management and FFIEC BSA/AML Manual requirements relevant to fraud investigation and suspicious activity reporting. Experience with fraud trend analysis - application fraud rate monitoring, typology identification, channel and geographic concentration analysis. Ability to manage own workload, meet deadlines, and proactively communicate risk to timelines with minimal supervision. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills - able to work effectively with Operations, Compliance, Legal, and Risk on fraud escalation and control improvement initiatives. Preferred Qualifications. Experience investigating dealer channel fraud, including power booking, ghost down payments, straw purchases, VIN cloning, title washing, and F&I product abuse. Bernstein Private Wealth Associates are client service professionals who exhibit drive, ambition, and exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, and who, in collaboration with Financial Advisors, help propel the growth of our Private Wealth Management Platform. This is an exciting and challenging opportunity to partner with Advisors to provide asset allocation recommendations, capital markets positioning, portfolio analytics, and wealth and legacy planning for high-net-worth individuals and families.. An Associate will:. Collaborate and network with senior professionals throughout the firm to fuel career success. Partner with Financial Advisors to build their business and provide service and support functions such as portfolio analysis, account creation and maintenance, and client/prospect meeting preparation. Build relationships with clients and prospective clients to understand and support all aspects of their servicing needs. Strive to provide a world-class level of customer service and support. Our Comprehensive Development Program. . Associates will participate in a robust and comprehensive training program - The Associate Development Program (ADP). After years of heavy financial investment and input from industry leaders, ADP is a one-of-a-kind opportunity. The Program is designed to build a foundation of investment knowledge and develop the quantitative and qualitative skills needed to achieve long-term stability and success, regardless of your incoming background.. Components of the Associate Development Program (ADP) Include:. In-depth industry training on proprietary investments, services, policies and procedures. Advanced training on trusts & estates, wealth planning, investment management philosophies, and financial management strategies. A focus on client service excellence, partnership and sales training in order to provide an exceptional client experience. Behavioral training geared toward the development of communication, leadership, and other professional skills. Career management, one-on-one coaching, and specialized skills training to achieve success beyond the Associate role. Associates have a myriad of opportunities to continue their career with us as a client service professional or in areas including Leadership, Wealth Strategies, Investment Strategies, and building their own business as an Advisor. We take all of our Associates' development seriously, and we focus on understanding each individual's strengths and aspirations, personalizing a roadmap with the success of each team member in mind. As Associates progress in the role, and as milestones are achieved and core competencies are exhibited (typically over the course of ~3 years), we celebrate the opportunity to advance team members on to other exciting opportunities at Bernstein Private Wealth Management.. Job Qualifications. . We Are Seeking:. People who possess strong analytical and communication skills (both written and verbal) and an ability to build relationships. Accomplished team players who thrive in a rigorous and challenging environment. Individuals who are client-focused and detail-oriented with a strong ability to multi-task and work under pressure in a fast-paced atmosphere. Individuals who have a bachelor's degree with excellence in academics and strong leadership experience. Proficiency in Word and Excel are required. Desired Qualifications. 1-2 years client service experience, financial services industry experience a plus. The Firm will sponsor required series exams, including SIE, Series 7, and Series 63, but candidates with licenses are a plus. Company Overview. Bernstein Private Wealth Management advises high-net-worth clients on planning for-and living with-the complexities that come with wealth. We specialize in addressing challenges that extend well beyond wealth management by offering a vast network of resources customized to clients' values and needs.. Bernstein is distinguished among major wealth managers by its holistic approach, flexible process, innovative research, sophisticated modeling, and cutting-edge investment solutions. Our people are our advantage. Our collaborative culture means each client is supported by a team of specialists aligned with a shared sense of purpose.. Bernstein is a business unit of AllianceBernstein, which ranks among the largest investment managers in the world, with 4,400 employees across 51 locations in 25 countries and over $700 billion in assets under management.. Join us in pursuing insights that unlock opportunities. Learn more at http://www.Bernstein.com. . To learn more about Our Purpose and What We Stand for, visit us at http://www.bernstein.com/our-story/overview.html. . Their backgrounds are as varied as our clients. Bernstein is distinguished among major wealth managers by its holistic approach, flexible process, innovative research, sophisticated modeling, and cutting-edge investment solutions. Our people are our advantage. Our collaborative culture means each client is supported by a team of specialists aligned with a shared sense of purpose. . Bernstein is a business unit of AllianceBernstein, which ranks among the largest investment managers in the world, with over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions. At AB our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work.. Our culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration creates an environment where you can thrive and do your best work. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you. If you're ready to challenge your limits and empower your career, join us!. What We Stand For:. TRUSTWORTHINESS-We are accountable. Integrity, transparency and reliability are core to our business model. INNOVATION-We're always working for you, looking for new opportunities. Our high-conviction approach aims to deliver investment clarity and better outcomes. TEAMWORK-We succeed together. An uncommonly collaborative culture helps us deliver exceptional personalized service. EQUITY-We are committed to building a culture of diverse perspectives - one where all employees feel valued and are treated fairly. COMMUNITY-We open doors. Leveraging our connections and mission aligned resources to build communities of likeminded individuals. RESPONSIBILITY-We are responsible citizens. We empower our people to make a positive impact for our clients, society, and the world around us.. Our Market-Leading Training Program:. We do not take our success for granted. The firm's culture is deeply rooted in lifelong learning, innovation, inclusion and never settling for the status quo. Because our hiring profile is unique among our industry peers, we strive to recruit top decile professionals and provide them with the best-in-class training. Every Advisor completes our immersive 13-week training program, which is designed to cover critical areas and provide the knowledge and skills necessary for a foundation of exponential success. The program is facilitated by the brightest minds at Bernstein including portfolio managers, wealth strategists, top senior Advisors and senior management. Training doesn't stop there. We support our advisors with continuing education and ongoing professional development throughout their careers.. title: Data Scientist
description: . About the team. As a Data Scientist within the Zillow Home Loans (ZHL) Data Science & Analytics team, you'll work across the entire home buying customer journey - from a home shopper's first touchpoint on Zillow.com through to a funded loan. The team works closely with ZHL's mortgage and product leadership to uncover opportunities, measure impact, and build a best-in-class integrated financing experience for Zillow customers. You'll contribute to that mission across the entire funnel, from web-scale A/B tests to deep-funnel mortgage operations analyses. About the role. At Zillow, Data Scientists develop insights and models that shape products and services, balancing rigor and speed to drive methodologically sound outputs that directly impact key decision points. You own scoped projects end-to-end: you translate business questions into analysis plans, execute independently, and communicate results clearly to stakeholders. This is an opportunity to grow your craft while working on problems that directly affect how millions of people find, buy, and finance their next home. . You Will Get To. Design, implement, and read out causal analyses across the Zillow.com-to-ZHL funnel - from web-scale experiments to deep-funnel small-population tests - using a variety of inference methods to achieve appropriate statistical rigor. Apply statistical modeling and advanced analytics to predict customer behavior, explain the impact of product and operational changes, and surface opportunities in the digital mortgage experience. Partner with product and engineering teams to define measurement frameworks, pull relevant data, and translate findings into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences. Prototype analytical pipelines for high-impact analyses and see them through to hardened, production-grade data sources used across the company - partnering with shared infrastructure teams and contributing to team standards along the way. Collaborate with fellow Data Scientists and the Data Analyst on the team to improve tooling, documentation, and analytical quality. . This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events. . In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. . Who you are. You are a consistent and effective individual contributor who can own scoped projects end-to-end, build stakeholder trust by connecting technical work to business impact, and operate with increasing independence across your toolkit and domain. You bias toward simple, proven methods and complete understanding over novelty. You communicate clearly, ask good clarifying questions, and bring a genuine curiosity about the business problems behind the data. . Basic Qualifications. . Strong proficiency in SQL and Python. Demonstrated experience with statistical modeling and inference; ability to choose simple, proven methods when appropriate. Experience delivering analyses or models that are used repeatedly by the business over months. Ability to communicate clearly and work cross-functionally with technical and non-technical partners. . Preferred Qualifications. . BS +5 or more years, MS +3 or more years, or PhD +1 or more years of industry experience in data science, statistics, applied science, or a related quantitative field. Experience with A/B testing and experimentation design, including power analysis and understanding of multiple testing considerations. Experience with causal inference methods in business settings (e.g., diff-in-diff, synthetic controls, propensity score matching, uplift modeling, or similar quasi-experimental designs). Exposure to customer-facing web or app analytics (e.g., clickstream, funnel analysis, engagement metrics). Familiarity with statistical or ML modeling packages and how to apply them to business problems (e.g., regression, classification, clustering, forecasting). Experience with data engineering pipelines and scheduling tools (Airflow, dbt, Spark, or similar). Exposure to mortgage, fintech, or ecommerce domains is a plus but not required. . Get to know us. At Zillow, we're reimagining how people move-through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you'll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. . How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they're most productive-enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. . Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME's America's Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. . No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry-and your career-forward, together. Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment. . If you have a disability or special need that requires reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly. . Qualified applicants will be considered for employment based on their qualifications and ability to perform the functions of the position, without discrimination and in accordance with applicable law. . Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company's reputation. description:
. About the team. The Public Cloud Foundations (PCF) team is part of Platform Engineering. We build the internal cloud platform that every Zillow engineer builds on: the self-service APIs, paved paths, and automation that turn the raw complexity of AWS into a small set of safe, reliable, well-documented product surfaces.. We treat the platform as a product. Rather than handling cloud infrastructure as a queue of tickets and one-off requests, we design software that lets teams provision accounts, networking, and shared infrastructure themselves, safe by default. Our current work shows the direction: self-service VPC connectivity, a Terraform delivery platform, container base images delivered as a managed product, and provisioning and policy capabilities exposed as APIs instead of runbooks. We partner closely with Runtime Platform, Database Engineering, Middleware Engineering, Delivery Engineering, and Security to replace manual cloud work with software.. PCF is where you help decide how Zillow uses the public cloud, and how a platform team turns operational surface area into engineered products. About the role. As a Senior Software Development Engineer on Public Cloud Foundations, you will build the services and APIs that abstract away the complexity of the public cloud, and own them as products from design through operation. . The Software Asset Management (SAM) Analyst plays a critical role in managing software assets from procurement through retirement. This person will own license compliance, software audits, vendor contract tracking, and SAM tooling-working cross-functionally to optimize software spend and build a mature SAM practice. The SAM Analyst will develop dashboards and reporting that support IT budgeting, compliance assurance, and executive visibility into software utilization across the enterprise. . As a Software Asset Management Analyst, you will:. Software Asset Lifecycle Management. Track and manage software assets from procurement through retirement. Maintain an accurate inventory of software installations and entitlements using SAM tools and CMDB systems. Support the onboarding and offboarding of software licenses. . License Compliance and Optimization. Ensure compliance with software license agreements, vendor contracts, and regulatory requirements. Identify and mitigate license overuse, underutilization, and unauthorized installations. Conduct regular audits and internal reviews of software deployments. . Vendor and Contract Management. Collaborate with procurement to analyze software agreements and renewals. Assist in negotiating license terms with software vendors to ensure favorable terms and cost efficiency. Maintain records of contracts, license keys, entitlements, true-up dates, and usage metrics. . Reporting and Metrics. Develop and present dashboards, reports, and KPIs on license usage, compliance, and cost savings. Support IT budgeting and forecasting related to software spend. . Tool and Process Management. Configure and maintain SAM tools (e.g., Flexera, ServiceNow License Manager, or similar platforms). Recommend and implement process improvements to enhance data accuracy and operational efficiency. Strong Google Sheets and reporting skills; experience with Power BI or Databricks is a plus. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills. title: Senior Product Manager, Agent Performance
description:
. About the team. Zillow's Preferred program connects customers with tens of thousands of partner agents across the country. Our team makes sure every customer is matched with the best agent for them. We decide how agent performance is measured, how that performance drives which agents customers are matched with, and how agents and their team leaders see and improve their results. We're a cross-functional team of product, data science, engineering, and design, and we work closely with legal, operations, and marketing. Our work sits where data, marketplace design, and user experience meet, and every decision we make affects millions of customers and thousands of real estate agents. About the role. We're looking for someone who enjoys tackling complex problems and delivering meaningful results. Today we measure performance for each individual agent across the whole home-buying journey. The next step is building one consistent way to measure performance that drives everything: how agents are evaluated, how buyers are matched with agents, and the coaching that helps agents get better. Much of performance management still depends on one-to-one support from our operations team, and that doesn't scale to tens of thousands of agents. This role will lead the move to products and systems that do scale. You'll own the agent performance experience end to end, along with the tools team leaders use to manage their agents.. . You Will Get To:. Define how agent performance is measured and set the roadmap for how it changes over time, including which inputs it uses and how changes reach agents, working with data science and engineering. Shape how performance drives matching, balancing agent supply with customer demand across markets so customers get great agents and strong agents get more opportunities. Build the performance experience agents see, including reports, rankings, notifications, and AI-driven coaching, so every agent knows where they stand and which step will help most. Give team leaders clear performance tools so they can manage at scale and see who needs support and what kind. Define goals and success metrics, run experiments and research with agents, and iterate based on how agents behave and how the business responds. Lead hard tradeoff decisions on fairness, transparency, and regulatory questions with legal, and align operations, marketing, and leadership on decisions that affect thousands of agents and buyers. . This role has been categorized as a Remote position. "Remote" employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions. . In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $151,700.00 - $242,300.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $144,100.00 - $230,300.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. . In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. Who you are. 5+ years managing products from concept to launch, or equivalent experience. Strong analytical skills; you build your case with data and evidence, design sound experiments, and are comfortable working hands-on with data. Marketplace thinking; you understand how supply, demand, and matching decisions affect both sides of a marketplace. Experience owning a scoring, ranking, or marketplace-quality product where the model's output directly affects users. Close partner to data science; you can dig into how a model behaves, not just its headline metric. Skilled at turning complex systems into simple, actionable experiences. Proven ability to drive decisions across product, operations, legal, and leadership through clear writing. Nice to have: real estate, lending, or two-sided marketplace experience. Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non‑traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences. . As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you'll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. . How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they're most productive-enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. . title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description: . About the team. About the team. The Developer Experience (DevEx) Delivery Engineering team builds and operates Zillow's software delivery platform. This is the paved road from commit to production that every Zillow Group engineer relies on to build, test, deploy, and ship. The platform supports org-wide delivery infrastructure at meaningful scale: CI/CD, runners, GitLab, Artifactory, Progressive Delivery, mobile build and release, and legacy migration programs. We are shifting from hands-on infrastructure operations toward secure, compliant, AI-first paved paths that improve reliability, release safety, and developer productivity. We are standing up a new India-based team to expand capacity, enable follow-the-sun coverage, and take first-class ownership of high-impact platform initiatives.
