You'll command cross-functional response efforts, lead investigations with a team from detection through post-mortem, and mentor other analysts. This role is expected to investigate, validate, remediate and communicate known details about the incident and work closely with cybersecurity leadership. . This is a senior individual contributor role. You make smart decisions under pressure without waiting for direction, and you communicate early and clearly to both technical peers and leadership stakeholders. . You Will Get To. . Incident Response Leadership. Serve as the primary technical lead on complex, high-severity security incidents, owning investigations from initial detection through containment, remediation, and post-mortem. Command cross-functional incident response efforts - establishing clear ownership, priorities, and next steps across Engineering, IT, Legal, Privacy, and other stakeholders. Independently or with a team scope and investigate security events including supply chain attacks, identity attacks, SaaS platform attacks, cloud intrusions, and other threats as needed. Lead incident response in cloud environments- scoping attacker access, driving containment across multi-account infrastructure, and investigating EC2, IAM, S3, and supply chain events. Participate in on-call response for critical security incidents, making timely and sound decisions without requiring escalation for direction. Conduct forensic analysis of compromised systems across Linux, macOS, Windows, and cloud environments, preserving evidence and documenting decisions. Perform deep-dive investigations across host, network, identity, and cloud evidence sources. Mentor and upskill junior and mid-level analysts through coaching, tabletop exercises, and collaborative incident response work. Own and maintain incident response playbooks, runbooks, and response procedures, keeping them current with the evolving threat landscape. Demonstrated history of independently leading complex, multi-day security investigations. You have been the person others called during the most difficult incidents and you drove them to resolution. Deep knowledge of attacker TTPs and proven ability to apply the MITRE ATT&CK framework to real-world investigations across the full attack lifecycle. Strong hands-on AWS security investigation expertise - including CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC Flow Logs, S3 access logs, IAM, and Lambda - with experience containing and remediating cloud-based incidents. Proficiency with EDR tools (e.g., CrowdStrike), SIEM platforms (e.g., Exabeam, Splunk), and cloud security tooling (e.g., Wiz, AWS Security Hub). Advanced understanding of Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems and their forensic artifacts - process trees, registry, logs, memory, and disk. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.. . About the role. As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you'll build and own the data models and metric definitions that stakeholders across Zillow depend on for consumer analytics, including marketing, lead generation, and site traffic. You'll build a deep understanding of multiple domains end-to-end and own the way metrics interact across them, all while setting a high bar for the team's engineering standards. You'll write transformation code, implement performant metrics as trusted data products, build data-quality tests, and document your work so people - and increasingly, AI systems can trust and build on top of the foundation you lay. . You Will Get To. Build and maintain dimensional data models and metric definitions using SQL and dbt (or equivalent) to establish metrics-as-code as an enterprise asset. Design data-quality tests, monitoring, and alerting so your data products are trusted by default. Partner with data engineering to define upstream requirements and fix data-quality issues at the source. Work directly with US-based BI analysts, data scientists, and stakeholders to understand what they actually need, not just what they wrote down. Define and evangelize semantic layer definitions that make metrics usable by BI tools, data scientists, and AI systems alike. Own multiple data domains end to end, mentor other engineers, and resolve metric governance across teams. . This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. . Who you are. 5+ years of professional data experience, with deep semantic modeling or metric ownership. Expert SQL, with thought leadership about how grain, joins, and schema evolution affect relational modeling and metric implementation. Experience with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework, plus Git and CI/CD best practices. Comfort operating across a large time-zone gap; proactive asynchronous communication, and exercising technical judgment independently. A track record of evolving how AI systems, conversational analytics tools, and machine learning workflows consume structured data. In-depth experience with cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, or similar) and BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar). title: Remote Mortgage Loan Officer (South Dakota)
description: . About the team. At Zillow Home Loans, we're at the forefront of revolutionizing the home financing experience. As part of Zillow Group's FinTech division, you'll help reshape how consumers buy, sell, and finance homes while working in a collaborative, high-energy environment. We're a team of innovators, problem solvers, and creative individuals pushing the boundaries of the mortgage industry.. Mortgage Loan Officers at Zillow Home Loans, drive their success through one of two specialized lending teams. . One team leverages a high volume, lead driven, phone-based environment for Loan Officers who excel at high-frequency conversion and scaling customer relationships quickly.. The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.. Both teams are core to our purchase-focused mission and are equally backed by Zillow's industry-leading technology, brand, centralized operations, and leadership support. Whether you find your edge in data-driven, lead-responsive execution or in nurturing a local professional network, both paths offer a high-impact career within the Zillow ecosystem. About the role. This is an opportunity to grow your career as a purchase-focused Mortgage Loan Officer originating home loans for customers introduced through Zillow's ecosystem. You'll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Based on your background and strengths, you may operate in either a high-volume, digitally driven environment or a relationship-based, market-focused model. Success in this role comes from responsiveness, execution, and performance in a structured, metrics-driven organization-supported by Zillow's brand, platform, and operational scale. . This role is "remote" with restrictions. Your designated remote location is defined as your principal place of residence, which must be physically located within the state listed above South Dakota. You may also elect to spend some time working at a company office. Please note that your employment is contingent upon remaining in this location; any future requests to relocate to another state are subject to Company review and approval and may be denied based upon business need. . You Will Get To:. Originate and manage purchase mortgage loans from application through closing while ensuring compliance with all requirements. . Convert company-provided purchase opportunities into funded loans through proactive follow-up and effective borrower consultation. . Build strong relationships with customers and, where applicable, with Zillow Preferred Agents and local partners. . Manage an active pipeline while meeting defined service levels, productivity metrics, and funding expectations. . Leverage Zillow's CRM, loan origination systems (LOS), and data-driven tools to manage pipeline health and customer engagement. . Partner with centralized processing, underwriting, and closing teams to move loans efficiently. . Deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience through phone, email, and text communication. . Stay current on market trends, lending programs, and regulatory requirements to provide tailored financing solutions. . Maintain active licensing, complete required education, and participate in ongoing professional development. . This role involves the collection, storage, and use of your voiceprints (records of speech) for operational and compliance purposes. . In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance, and location. . This role has been categorized as a Remote position. "Remote" employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions. . In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. Who you are. 3+ years of mortgage origination experience with a strong emphasis on purchase transactions, either as an active NMLS Loan Originator with state licenses or as a Loan Originator under a federal bank license. . Completion of the 20-hour CORE Pre-Licensing Education and successful passage of the SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator Test - National Component with Uniform State Content. . Physically located in and working remotely from South Dakota .. Proven success originating purchase loans in either: a high-volume, phone-based sales environment or an agent-centric referral model. . Strong client service orientation with consultative sales skills and deep understanding of the mortgage process. . Comfortable working in a structured, performance-driven environment with clearly defined KPIs. . Excellent verbal communication skills and ability to build trust quickly. . Strong time management, organization, and pipeline management skills. . Proficiency with CRM, LOS, and Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Excel). . Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred. . The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.. Both teams are core to our purchase-focused mission and are equally backed by Zillow's industry-leading technology, brand, centralized operations, and leadership support. Whether you find your edge in data-driven, lead-responsive execution or in nurturing a local professional network, both paths offer a high-impact career within the Zillow ecosystem. About the role. This is an opportunity to grow your career as a purchase-focused Mortgage Loan Officer originating home loans for customers introduced through Zillow's ecosystem. You'll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Based on your background and strengths, you may operate in either a high-volume, digitally driven environment or a relationship-based, market-focused model. Success in this role comes from responsiveness, execution, and performance in a structured, metrics-driven organization-supported by Zillow's brand, platform, and operational scale. . This role is "remote" with restrictions. Your designated remote location is defined as your principal place of residence, which must be physically located within the state listed above North Dakota. You may also elect to spend some time working at a company office. Please note that your employment is contingent upon remaining in this location; any future requests to relocate to another state are subject to Company review and approval and may be denied based upon business need. . You Will Get To:. Originate and manage purchase mortgage loans from application through closing while ensuring compliance with all requirements. . Convert company-provided purchase opportunities into funded loans through proactive follow-up and effective borrower consultation. . Build strong relationships with customers and, where applicable, with Zillow Preferred Agents and local partners. . Manage an active pipeline while meeting defined service levels, productivity metrics, and funding expectations. . Leverage Zillow's CRM, loan origination systems (LOS), and data-driven tools to manage pipeline health and customer engagement. . Partner with centralized processing, underwriting, and closing teams to move loans efficiently. . Deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience through phone, email, and text communication. . Stay current on market trends, lending programs, and regulatory requirements to provide tailored financing solutions. . Maintain active licensing, complete required education, and participate in ongoing professional development. . This role involves the collection, storage, and use of your voiceprints (records of speech) for operational and compliance purposes. . In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance, and location. . This role has been categorized as a Remote position. "Remote" employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions. . In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. Who you are. 3+ years of mortgage origination experience with a strong emphasis on purchase transactions, either as an active NMLS Loan Originator with state licenses or as a Loan Originator under a federal bank license. . Completion of the 20-hour CORE Pre-Licensing Education and successful passage of the SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator Test - National Component with Uniform State Content. . Physically located in and working remotely from North Dakota .. Proven success originating purchase loans in either: a high-volume, phone-based sales environment or an agent-centric referral model. . Strong client service orientation with consultative sales skills and deep understanding of the mortgage process. . Comfortable working in a structured, performance-driven environment with clearly defined KPIs. . Excellent verbal communication skills and ability to build trust quickly. . Strong time management, organization, and pipeline management skills. . Proficiency with CRM, LOS, and Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Excel). . Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred. . Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply if you bring transferable skills or related experience. . As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you'll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. . How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they're most productive-enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. . Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME's America's Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. . No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry-and your career-forward, together. . description:
. About the team. Join our dynamic team, leveraging a comprehensive database of over 100 million homes, transactions, and users to predict and analyze housing market trends. About the role. As an Applied Scientist you will actively participate in Collaborative Forecast Development: Work alongside other applied scientists, data scientists and economists to develop hierarchical forecasts for the housing market at various regional levels:. . Feature Extraction: Identify economic and demographic driving forces of housing market growth across regions and extract features that predict housing market trends 1 to 2 years in the future. Model Deployment: Collaborate closely with the engineering team to deploy models into production environments. Forecast Production: Contribute to monthly forecast production, communicating forecast performance and the housing market outlook to business partners and senior leadership team. Scenario Modeling: Develop scenario models that capture a wide range of housing market outcomes and contribute to a company-wide stress-testing framework. . Proficient in data cleaning, preprocessing, and feature engineering for time series data. Experience with large-scale datasets and familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark. title: Underwriting Support Specialist
description: . About the team. As an Underwriting Support Specialist within Zillow Home Loans, you'll join a growing India-based mortgage operations team focused on delivering accurate, timely, and scalable support across the underwriting lifecycle.. The team partners with U.S. Underwriters and cross-functional mortgage operations teams to complete defined review, documentation, validation, and workflow activities. As the business evolves, the team's scope may expand into additional underwriting-support functions that improve quality, reduce operational friction, and help loans progress efficiently. Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow's mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.. . About the role. As an Underwriting Support Specialist, you will support mortgage underwriting operations by reviewing loan-file information, validating documentation and data, managing assigned workflow activities, and identifying items that require further action or escalation. You will apply established procedures and checklists, maintain clear and accurate documentation, and collaborate with partners to resolve issues within your assigned authority. You Will Get To. Complete assigned underwriting-support reviews and operational activities in accordance with established policies, procedures, quality standards, and service-level expectations. Review loan-file documentation, system data, and supporting information for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and required follow-up.. Resolve routine issues within assigned authority and promptly escalate complex, high-risk, out-of-policy, or time-sensitive matters to the appropriate Underwriter, manager, or functional partner. Update relevant systems, queues, trackers, and loan-file records to ensure work is accurately reflected and progresses through the applicable workflow. Manage work in assigned queues and prioritize tasks based on established service levels, loan urgency, customer commitments, and business priorities. Partner with Underwriting, Processing, Closing, Quality Control, Credit Specialists, and other mortgage operations teams to resolve issues and improve handoffs. Participate in quality reviews, coaching, calibration, and training; apply feedback to improve accuracy, consistency, judgment, and turnaround time. Surface recurring defects, process gaps, and opportunities to improve SOPs, checklists, tools, and operating controls. Adapt to evolving processes, systems, products, and work assignments as the Underwriting Support function grows. Maintain the confidentiality and privacy of borrower, customer, and employee information at all times. . This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. You are organized, able to manage competing priorities, and successful in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment. You have strong written, and verbal communication skills. title: Senior Product Counsel, Mortgages
description:
. About the team. The Zillow Group Legal and Compliance Department is a dedicated team of skilled (and fun!) legal professionals who enjoy working in a collegial environment within an innovative, fast-paced tech, real estate, and media company. This role is part of the Business Lines Legal Team, which provides frontline legal support for Zillow's products and services, including Zillow Home Loans and our integrated mortgage and real estate offerings. About the role. We are looking for a talented attorney to serve as dedicated product counsel for Zillow Home Loans (ZHL) mortgage products. This role sits at the intersection of regulated consumer lending and product development, and is well suited for a lawyer energized by translating complex mortgage regulation into clear, practical guidance that helps product teams build and ship. You will be the day-to-day legal partner to the product and engineering teams building mortgage and integrated home-buying experiences, from affordability and pre-approval tools to AI-powered and agentic features and internal systems for ZHL's own loan officers. You will own the full legal lifecycle across the product portfolio, advise directly on complex and first-of-kind product questions, and work closely with specialized Legal and Compliance teams to support product development and launch. You will also coordinate with legal leadership on matters that present enterprise-level or cross-business-line risk. The right candidate has solid grounding in the mortgage regulatory framework, is comfortable getting hands-on with AI-enabled product features, has strong drafting, negotiation and communication skills, and the desire to grow subject matter expertise in a domain where product scope evolves and regulatory expectations shift. You are pragmatic, responsive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating autonomously within a defined scope. . In this role, you will get to:. Serve as the primary day-to-day legal point of contact for an assigned set of ZHL mortgage products, providing full lifecycle counsel from concept and design through launch and iteration. Advise product and engineering teams on the state and federal mortgage regulatory framework, including RESPA, TILA , ECOA, UDAAP, and state mortgage licensing. Partner directly with AI/ML engineering teams on compliance guardrails for AI-enabled and agentic product features, including hands-on testing of model outputs and development of evaluation criteria for legal and regulatory compliance. Provide practical, risk-calibrated guidance on product design and disclosures, including how and where mortgage content, pre-approval, and loan application experiences are surfaced across ZHL's platforms. Embed with business partners on issues of first impression, pilot programs, and other key initiatives, delivering legal risk analysis and recommendations directly to senior management. Draft, review, and negotiate the commercial and data-rights agreements that support your products, such as vendor, technology, and services agreements. Proactively partner with cross-functional teams and shared services (compliance, privacy, fair lending, marketing, and communications) to identify and resolve legal matters as they arise. Educate product, engineering, and business partners on mortgage and lending legal requirements so teams can make informed decisions while maintaining velocity. . "Remote" employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. . In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. Who you are. You are a responsive, pragmatic, and detail-oriented attorney who has:. 7+ years of relevant experience with a national or regional law firm or in-house legal department, with meaningful consumer finance, mortgage, or product counseling experience; in-house experience at a mortgage lender, fintech, or prop tech company strongly preferred. A JD with active state bar admission in at least one jurisdiction. Substantive command of the mortgage and consumer lending regulatory framework, with the depth to advise directly on the statutes above as they apply to live product decisions. Experience advising on product development, and the judgment to give practical guidance where the regulatory answer is not fully settled. Experience drafting and negotiating commercial agreements such as vendor, technology, or services agreements. General familiarity with adjacent regulatory frameworks such as GLBA and TCPA, and with emerging state and federal AI/algorithmic regulation, is a plus. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey the implications of legal issues and risk clearly to non-lawyers. Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently manage competing, time-sensitive projects. Sound judgment about when to decide, when to consult a subject matter expert, and when to elevate a matter for broader alignment. Our Zillow Mexico team will work with our US tech teams to simplify and automate the buying, selling and renting experience to make home a reality for more and more people.. - We believe that creativity, collaboration, and innovation lead to success. - We actively encourage our teams to learn about the business and share their ideas. - We value and promote a diverse and inclusive workplace!. About the role. . As a Software Development Engineer, you'll lead the delivery and ongoing support of projects from end-to-end. In addition, you will:. Contribute to the design of new features. . title: Senior Engineering Manager, Software Engineering
description: . About the team. Zillow's Core Technology organization empowers our people with the tools and platforms they need to thrive. This partners with the People Organization, Product and engineering teams in the US to build seamless, scalable solutions that support every stage of the employee journey-from recruiting and onboarding to development and retention. We manage a diverse suite of platforms focused predominately on Workday but also including third party platforms closely connected with Workday for talent management. This team works closely with teams across HR, Product, and Engineering functions to configure, implement, and maintain software applications that are used by Zillow Group employees in their day-to-day job activities. This team plays a critical role in ensuring that Zillow operates efficiently and effectively, and fosters a culture of inclusion and collaboration. Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow's mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.. . About the role. We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager of Engineering to lead a team of six analysts and developers, focused on internal employee technology. This role will focus predominately on Workday but also will support adjacent people organization systems. This role requires effectively balancing the expertise and career aspirations of your team members with the organization's objectives. A proven track record of project implementation and the ability to identify opportunities for technical enhancement and drive continuous improvement initiatives are key aspects of this position. . What You'll Do. Lead, coach, and inspire a team of Workday analysts and developers, fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, and growth. Drive execution of initiatives in support of the People Org Roadmap, ensuring that projects are delivered on time and within budget. Discover possibilities to reduce technical debt and propel ongoing improvement initiatives, guaranteeing Zillow maintains a top-tier technology infrastructure. Collaborate regularly in planning and estimating activities, offering guidance and support to team members using your previous experience and understanding of the business, and actively participate in discussions about capacity and priorities. Establish strong connections with important individuals in the Product and HR departments, serving as a reliable consultant who can provide guidance, anticipate challenges, and find innovative solutions for business issues. Represent Zillow's needs and best interests with third-party vendors, ensuring that they are accountable to expectations, service level agreements (SLAs), and contractual commitments. Constructively negotiate trade-off discussions with other senior leaders, articulating pros and cons while providing options and recommendations that align with Zillow's goals and values. Prioritize initiatives that balance short-term needs with long-term vision, ensuring consistent delivery of high-impact solutions. Be responsible for measuring the impact of the roadmap, ensuring that the changes are having the result expected. Guide the team through capacity planning, agile execution, and continuous improvement of team operations. Identify operational opportunities and come up with a plan to implement improvements, focused on a continuous improvement philosophy. Lead quarterly, mid-year and annual planning for your team. Mentor future leaders by supporting their development in strategy, collaboration, and execution. Communicate key progress, risks, opportunities and alternative options to executive audiences with clarity and confidence. . This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. . Familiar with Agile Scrum processes and associated ceremonies, and can effectively lead a team in an agile environment. Passionate about career development and multiplying the impact of your team members, providing mentoring and coaching to individual contributors. Ability to seamlessly adapt your communication style to the audience ranging from individual contributors on your team to senior leaders and executives. Strong commitment to operational excellence, constantly striving to uncover the underlying causes of problems, using data to guide your decision-making, and fostering a culture of ongoing improvement within your team. Previous experience maintaining relationships with external vendors and a solid understanding of commonly accepted approaches in the industry. Track record of successfully delivering projects through team members that report to you, and can collaborate effectively with partner teams. Willing to roll up your sleeves and dive into the details to ensure a thorough understanding of the work at hand. . Get to know us. title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
. About the team. The Data team at Zillow turns complex data into insights, models, and data products that help power smarter decisions across the business. As part of our broader Data Analytics and Insights organization, this team partners closely with product, engineering, and business leaders to solve meaningful problems, improve the quality and usability of our data, and build scalable solutions that create impact for customers and employees alike. Together, we foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where curiosity, analytical rigor, and a passion for impact help shape how Zillow works and grows. About the role. As an Analytics Engineer, you are responsible for building the trusted, governed, and scalable data models and metrics that underpin how the company measures its business and makes decisions. You translate raw data into well-structured analytical assets that serve dashboards, self-service tools, data science workflows, and increasingly, AI-powered analytics interfaces. . You will get to. . Lead the design, development, and maintenance of trusted, scalable analytical data products, including reusable data models, standardized metrics, and semantic layer components that support business intelligence, self-service analytics, data science, and AI-powered interfaces. Translate complex business requirements into well-structured data models and precise metric definitions, ensuring business logic is implemented in the appropriate layer and applied consistently across teams and analytical surfaces. Partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, Business Intelligence, Product Management, and business stakeholders to prioritize analytics engineering initiatives, define technical requirements and data contracts, and manage cross-team dependencies. Drive improvements in data quality, governance, discoverability, and documentation through automated validation, clear metadata, consistent metric definitions, and proactive resolution of data issues. Build, optimize, and operate reliable last-mile data transformation pipelines using version control, code review, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and alerting to reduce manual effort and improve maintainability. Mentor and coach teammates on data modeling and engineering best practices, contribute to analytics engineering standards and roadmap decisions, and enable stakeholders to confidently use governed data products. . This role has been categorized as a Remote position. "Remote" employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions. . This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. . In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. Who you are. Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Business, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or a closely related field, working with large datasets to develop reliable analytical data models and data products. Demonstrated experience owning analytical data products across multiple data domains end-to-end and independently solving complex data modeling and metric definition challenges. Proven ability to lead cross-functional workstreams, translate business needs into technical specifications, prioritize competing requests, and manage multiple projects and upstream dependencies in alignment with team and business goals. Deep proficiency in SQL, data transformation frameworks such as dbt or equivalent, and analytical modeling approaches, including dimensional, denormalized, and entity-relationship models, with sound judgment about granularity, aggregation, reuse, and business logic placement. Experience working in online data lakehouses like Databricks or Snowflake and proficiency in Git. Strong experience applying software engineering and operational practices to analytics workflows, including version control, CI/CD, code review, automated testing, data quality checks, monitoring, and root-cause analysis, with the ability to improve team standards and reliability. Experience designing and maintaining semantic layer components, metrics-as-code, and metadata for multiple consumers, with an understanding of data governance and how BI tools, data science workflows, and AI-powered interfaces interpret metric definitions. Ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly, align stakeholders on shared metric definitions, write concise self-service documentation, and mentor teammates on modeling and engineering best practices. Experience using AI-assisted coding tools with the judgment to validate generated SQL, transformation logic, and documentation, prevent duplicated or inconsistent business logic, and independently explain and defend your design decisions. . title: Mortgage Loan Officer (Plano, TX)
description: . About the team. At Zillow Home Loans, we're at the forefront of revolutionizing the home financing experience. As part of Zillow Group's FinTech division, you'll help reshape how consumers buy, sell, and finance homes while working in a collaborative, high-energy environment. We're a team of innovators, problem solvers, and creative individuals pushing the boundaries of the mortgage industry.. Mortgage Loan Officers at Zillow Home Loans, drive their success through one of two specialized lending teams. . One team leverages a high volume, lead driven, phone-based environment for Loan Officers who excel at high-frequency conversion and scaling customer relationships quickly.. The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.. Both teams are core to our purchase-focused mission and are equally backed by Zillow's industry-leading technology, brand, centralized operations, and leadership support. Whether you find your edge in data-driven, lead-responsive execution or in nurturing a local professional network, both paths offer a high-impact career within the Zillow ecosystem. About the role. This is an opportunity to grow your career as a purchase-focused Mortgage Loan Officer originating home loans for customers introduced through Zillow's ecosystem. You'll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Based on your background and strengths, you may operate in either a high-volume, digitally driven environment or a relationship-based, market-focused model. Success in this role comes from responsiveness, execution, and performance in a structured, metrics-driven organization-supported by Zillow's brand, platform, and operational scale. . You Will Get To:. Originate and manage purchase mortgage loans from application through closing while ensuring compliance with all requirements. . Convert company-provided purchase opportunities into funded loans through proactive follow-up and effective borrower consultation. . Build strong relationships with customers and, where applicable, with Zillow Preferred Agents and local partners. . Manage an active pipeline while meeting defined service levels, productivity metrics, and funding expectations. . Leverage Zillow's CRM, loan origination systems (LOS), and data-driven tools to manage pipeline health and customer engagement. . Partner with centralized processing, underwriting, and closing teams to move loans efficiently. . Deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience through phone, email, and text communication. . Stay current on market trends, lending programs, and regulatory requirements to provide tailored financing solutions. . Maintain active licensing, complete required education, and participate in ongoing professional development. . This role involves the collection, storage, and use of your voiceprints (records of speech) for operational and compliance purposes. . In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance, and location. . This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at an existing ZG corporate office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within reasonable commuting distance of their designated ZG office. ZG has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. . Who you are. 3+ years of mortgage origination experience with a strong emphasis on purchase transactions, either as an active NMLS Loan Originator with state licenses or as a Loan Originator under a federal bank license. . Completion of the 20-hour CORE Pre-Licensing Education and successful passage of the SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator Test - National Component with Uniform State Content. . Physically located in and working hybrid from our Plano, TX Office. . Proven success originating purchase loans in either: a high-volume, phone-based sales environment or an agent-centric referral model. . Strong client service orientation with consultative sales skills and deep understanding of the mortgage process. . Comfortable working in a structured, performance-driven environment with clearly defined KPIs. . Excellent verbal communication skills and ability to build trust quickly. . Strong time management, organization, and pipeline management skills. . Proficiency with CRM, LOS, and Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Excel). . Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred. . Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply if you bring transferable skills or related experience. . title: Director, Engineering
description: . About the team. Zillow's Enterprise Platforms & Technology (EP&T) organization runs the third-party SaaS platforms that power our business: Workday, ServiceNow, Salesforce, and the AI infrastructure that increasingly mediates how Zillow employees experience these systems. Workday powers our HR and Finance operations. ServiceNow runs IT and HR service delivery. The agentic AI layer we're building on top of these platforms is reshaping how employees get help, complete tasks, and navigate their work day.. We are building a new India-based engineering team to take end-to-end ownership of Workday HR and ServiceNow in 2026, with potential expansion to other enterprise SaaS platforms in the future. This team will own its platform stacks completely - production access, change ownership, on-call rotation, direct stakeholder relationships - not as remote staffing for US-led work, but as a peer engineering organization with its own architectural authority.. EP&T operates with an AI-native engineering culture. Modern AI coding and agent tooling is baseline practice across our existing US teams. For your India team, that means AI-augmented configuration is the daily reality: designing Workday business processes, generating ServiceNow flows, and writing platform-bounded code with AI as a partner, at a pace that traditional methods can't match. Your team's success proves and scales this operating model.. This is a team where your technical credibility matters. We are building it from scratch, and the leader who joins now will lay the engineering foundation for Zillow's enterprise-wide shift to invisible, agent-mediated platforms, and define what excellence looks like in this space for years to come. Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow's mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.. . About the role. As Director of Engineering for Enterprise SaaS Platforms (India), you'll build Zillow's India platform engineering organization from the ground up. . You will report directly to the global leader of Enterprise Platforms & Technology and be one of the first engineering directors based in India. As the sole engineering director in EP&T based in India, you'll partner with your US-based peer leaders in Engineering, Product, and Design, but will have broad latitude to shape culture, hiring practices, and operating norms for the team you build. . You will personally recruit the senior bench, allowing you to pull talent from your network. You will hold the bar on AI-native engineering practices, partner closely with US-based domain experts and product managers to translate design intent into production reality, and work with Zillow's US-based platform and agentic engineering team to deliver the integration and AI infrastructure that connects your work into the broader enterprise. . Responsibilities:. Build the team. Recruit, hire, and develop an India engineering team and management team. . Recruit your senior bench, leveraging your network and your reputation to bring in the talent you need to deliver our vision. . Coach the next layer of India leadership - managers and senior engineers who will be key to the success of your organization. . Represent Zillow's India engineering presence externally; recruit actively from the Workday and ServiceNow ecosystems. . Own the Workday platform. Drive end-to-end Workday HR delivery: business process configuration, EIB integrations, scripted custom logic, security model, reporting, and production operations. . Own and execute SOX-compliant change management across Workday in partnership with Zillow's People, Finance, and Audit organizations. . Champion AI-augmented configuration patterns as the productivity multiplier on platform engineering and configuration work. . Directly manage the Workday team and partner with the US-based platform and agentic engineering team on MCP integration and agent capabilities. . Own the ServiceNow platform. Drive end-to-end ServiceNow delivery: HR Service Delivery, IT Service Management, scoped applications, scripted REST endpoints, Integration Hub flows. . Directly manage the ServiceNow team and partner with the US-based platform and agentic engineering team on MCP integration and agent capabilities. . Establish operating norms. Set the operating cadence with US-based domain experts, product managers, and platform engineering peers, maintaining end-to-end ownership and a tight feedback loop between US-based stakeholders, design partners, and engineering build teams. . Build an engineering culture where AI is the engine of daily work: your team uses AI tooling to design and validate Workday business processes, generate ServiceNow flows, write and review platform-bounded code, and automate documentation and change evidence faster than traditional methods allow. . Set multi-year strategic direction for India's platform scope, tightly coupled to Zillow's broader business and AI roadmap. . Own budget, planning, vendor relationships, tooling, and talent decisions for the India organization. . Partner across Zillow. Engage as a peer technical voice with Zillow's HR business partners, IT customers, and engineering leadership. . Represent the India team in EP&T leadership rituals - staff meetings, planning, monthly business reviews. . Bridge time zones, cultures, and operating styles so the US-India model works as a single distributed engineering org. . . This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. . Who you are. We are looking for a builder, a leader, and a talent magnet. You bring:. . Team builder and talent magnet: you've built engineering teams from scratch. You recruit senior engineers from your network and selectively from outside, develop them into top performers, and set culture and operating norms early to grow a high-performing team from a blank page. . AI-native posture : you actively use modern AI coding and agent tooling in your own work, and you have championed AI-tooling adoption in teams you've led. You're not someone who's "open to AI", you're already practicing it. . Deep platform expertise with multi-platform breadth : deep expertise in at least one major enterprise SaaS platform (Workday HR strongly preferred), with proven breadth across two or more others (ServiceNow, Workday Financials, Salesforce, or similar). You know what excellence looks like in SaaS platform engineering and have built it more than once. . Distributed engineering leadership : you have led offshore or distributed engineering centers, you have worked closely with US-based companies and leadership teams across the US-India time gap, and you understand how to keep distributed teams in sync on culture, operations excellence, and engineering practices. . Multi-domain leadership : you have run engineering for multiple business domains simultaneously (HR, Support, Finance, Sales) and can context-switch credibly across stakeholder groups. . Engineering leadership across software development and systems administration : you have led both application engineering and platform configuration/administration functions; you understand the differences, the interfaces between them, and how to staff and manage each. Sufficient hands-on background (programming, configuration, or platform certification) to engage credibly with senior individual contributors on architectural decisions. . 15+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS platform engineering , with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles managing managers and multi-functional engineering teams. . Exceptional written and verbal English communication : you will be in rooms with senior US leadership regularly. . Additional differentiating qualifications:. Workday Studio, EIB, or scripted integration depth (5+ years). . Experience partnering closely with a US-based VP or senior executive (5+ years). . ServiceNow platform experience (2+ years). . SOX or compliance-driven environment experience (2+ years). . Workday Financials experience (1-year or more preferred). . Active in the Workday or ServiceNow ecosystem (community, conferences, certifications). . . Location. This role will be based in Bangalore, India. The role will require in-person presence at our Zillow Bangalore office and period travel to the US may be required for partnership, planning and leadership offsites. . Get to know us. title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description: . About the team. Zillow's People Technology organization builds and operates the platforms that power how Zillow employees work: Workday, ServiceNow, and the agentic AI layer connecting these systems to the surfaces employees use every day - Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, and AI tools. The India engineering team owns this platform stack end to end: production access, change ownership, on-call rotation, and direct relationships with the business teams we support. Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow's mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India. Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow's mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.. . About the role. As Sr. Technical Program Manager, you are the connective tissue of the PeopleTech delivery model. You own the sprint cadence, the handoff quality gate between Product and Engineering, and the cross-team coordination that keeps India-based engineering and US-based product and business partners in sync. You are a single, senior individual contributor - not a team of TPMs - which means you need to be decisive, organized, and confident operating across time zones without a lot of structural backup. You will work directly with the Product Managers (US-based) and the India Engineering team, and will be a key voice in how the model matures over time. This is a high-visibility role in a new operating model that is still being built; you will help define how it works, not just execute inside it.. Responsibilities. Own sprint execution end to end: create and close sprints in Jira, run grooming and planning, lead standup, track capacity and velocity, and ensure all stories are estimated and complete before each sprint closes. Serve as the handoff quality gate between Product and Engineering: review stories for build readiness before sprint commitment, flag ambiguity or missing technical context, and resolve open requirements questions in partnership with PM and Engineering before work begins. Own the US-India coordination bridge: run a daily touchpoint with the PM to carry blocker and handoff status, facilitate the overlap-window ceremonies (grooming, sprint planning, sprint demo) where PM and Engineering both need to be present, and maintain async-first practices that keep live meeting load low. Manage cross-team dependencies and risks: identify sequencing issues and resource constraints early, route blockers to the right owner (Engineering or PM), and escalate to leadership when something threatens delivery. Coordinate Unit Test logistics: manage test resources, defect tracking, and the communication between Engineering and the PM during unit testing cycles. Document the team's operational model: post-launch on-call and support structure, escalation paths, and the handoff from project delivery into business-as-usual operations. Drive continuous improvement: use retrospective findings to sharpen handoff processes, story quality, and sprint predictability over time; build and share repeatable practices that improve how the team works. Apply AI tools to program work: status synthesis, risk and dependency tracking, meeting notes and follow-ups, draft communications - and help the broader team build that fluency. . This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. . Who you are. 5-8 years of technical program or project/scrum team management experience delivering complex, cross-functional programs in enterprise SaaS or platform environments. Demonstrated ownership of programs spanning multiple teams end to end, including programs where you defined scope and goals yourself in ambiguous conditions. Strong technical fluency: you can understand and explain how Workday, ServiceNow, or comparable enterprise platforms fit together, reason about integration dependencies, and assess whether a user story is ready to build - without needing to write the code yourself. Demonstrated working knowledge of Workday HCM or ServiceNow (module configuration, integrations, annual HR cycles, security model basics). Experience operating in a distributed or offshore/nearshore engineering model, with US-based product and business partners - you understand how to design for async-first collaboration and how to use overlap hours well. Best-in-class Jira and sprint management skills: you run ceremonies cleanly, keep the board accurate, and produce sprint summaries that give leadership a clear picture without requiring a meeting. Strong communication across technical and non-technical audiences, including senior executives - you know what altitude is right for each conversation. Track record of influencing without authority, resolving blockers, and driving cross-org alignment on decisions. Fluent with AI tools for program management and able to help others build that fluency. description: . About the team. Zillow's People Technology organization builds and operates the platforms that power how Zillow employees work: Workday, ServiceNow, and the agentic AI layer connecting these systems to the surfaces employees use every day - Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, and AI tools. The India engineering team owns this platform stack end to end: production access, change ownership, on-call rotation, and direct relationships with the business teams we support. Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow's mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.. . About the role. As Sr. Technical Program Manager, you are the connective tissue of the PeopleTech delivery model. You own the sprint cadence, the handoff quality gate between Product and Engineering, and the cross-team coordination that keeps India-based engineering and US-based product and business partners in sync. You are a single, senior individual contributor - not a team of TPMs - which means you need to be decisive, organized, and confident operating across time zones without a lot of structural backup. You will work directly with the Product Managers (US-based) and the India Engineering team, and will be a key voice in how the model matures over time. This is a high-visibility role in a new operating model that is still being built; you will help define how it works, not just execute inside it. Responsibilities. Own sprint execution end to end: create and close sprints in Jira, run grooming and planning, lead standup, track capacity and velocity, and ensure all stories are estimated and complete before each sprint closes. . Serve as the handoff quality gate between Product and Engineering: review stories for build readiness before sprint commitment, flag ambiguity or missing technical context, and resolve open requirements questions in partnership with PM and Engineering before work begins. . Own the US-India coordination bridge: run a daily touchpoint with the PM to carry blocker and handoff status, facilitate the overlap-window ceremonies (grooming, sprint planning, sprint demo) where PM and Engineering both need to be present, and maintain async-first practices that keep live meeting load low. . Manage cross-team dependencies and risks: identify sequencing issues and resource constraints early, route blockers to the right owner (Engineering or PM), and escalate to leadership when something threatens delivery. . Coordinate Unit Test logistics: manage test resources, defect tracking, and the communication between Engineering and the PM during unit testing cycles. . Document the team's operational model: post-launch on-call and support structure, escalation paths, and the handoff from project delivery into business-as-usual operations. . Drive continuous improvement: use retrospective findings to sharpen handoff processes, story quality, and sprint predictability over time; build and share repeatable practices that improve how the team works. . Apply AI tools to program work: status synthesis, risk and dependency tracking, meeting notes and follow-ups, draft communications - and help the broader team build that fluency. . . This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. . Who you are. 5-8 years of technical program or project/scrum team management experience delivering complex, cross-functional programs in enterprise SaaS or platform environments. . Demonstrated ownership of programs spanning multiple teams end to end, including programs where you defined scope and goals yourself in ambiguous conditions. . Strong technical fluency: you can understand and explain how Workday, ServiceNow, or comparable enterprise platforms fit together, reason about integration dependencies, and assess whether a user story is ready to build - without needing to write the code yourself. . Demonstrated working knowledge of Workday HCM or ServiceNow (module configuration, integrations, annual HR cycles, security model basics). . Experience operating in a distributed or offshore/nearshore engineering model, with US-based product and business partners - you understand how to design for async-first collaboration and how to use overlap hours well. . Best-in-class Jira and sprint management skills: you run ceremonies cleanly, keep the board accurate, and produce sprint summaries that give leadership a clear picture without requiring a meeting. . Strong communication across technical and non-technical audiences, including senior executives - you know what altitude is right for each conversation. . Track record of influencing without authority, resolving blockers, and driving cross-org alignment on decisions. . Fluent with AI tools for program management and able to help others build that fluency. . Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. . Get to know us. At Zillow, we're reimagining how people move-through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you'll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. . Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME's America's Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. . No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry-and your career-forward, together. . Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment. . If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly. . Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law. .

title: Mortgage Loan Officer (Seattle, WA)
description: . About the team. At Zillow Home Loans, we're at the forefront of revolutionizing the home financing experience. As part of Zillow Group's FinTech division, you'll help reshape how consumers buy, sell, and finance homes while working in a collaborative, high-energy environment. We're a team of innovators, problem solvers, and creative individuals pushing the boundaries of the mortgage industry.. Mortgage Loan Officers at Zillow Home Loans, drive their success through one of two specialized lending teams. . One team leverages a high volume, lead driven, phone-based environment for Loan Officers who excel at high-frequency conversion and scaling customer relationships quickly.. The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.. Both teams are core to our purchase-focused mission and are equally backed by Zillow's industry-leading technology, brand, centralized operations, and leadership support. Whether you find your edge in data-driven, lead-responsive execution or in nurturing a local professional network, both paths offer a high-impact career within the Zillow ecosystem. About the role. This is an opportunity to grow your career as a purchase-focused Mortgage Loan Officer originating home loans for customers introduced through Zillow's ecosystem. You'll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Based on your background and strengths, you may operate in either a high-volume, digitally driven environment or a relationship-based, market-focused model. Success in this role comes from responsiveness, execution, and performance in a structured, metrics-driven organization-supported by Zillow's brand, platform, and operational scale. . You Will Get To:. Originate and manage purchase mortgage loans from application through closing while ensuring compliance with all requirements. . Convert company-provided purchase opportunities into funded loans through proactive follow-up and effective borrower consultation. . Build strong relationships with customers and, where applicable, with Zillow Preferred Agents and local partners. . Manage an active pipeline while meeting defined service levels, productivity metrics, and funding expectations. . Leverage Zillow's CRM, loan origination systems (LOS), and data-driven tools to manage pipeline health and customer engagement. . Partner with centralized processing, underwriting, and closing teams to move loans efficiently. . Deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience through phone, email, and text communication. . Stay current on market trends, lending programs, and regulatory requirements to provide tailored financing solutions. . Maintain active licensing, complete required education, and participate in ongoing professional development. . This role involves the collection, storage, and use of your voiceprints (records of speech) for operational and compliance purposes. . In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance, and location. . This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at an existing ZG corporate office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within reasonable commuting distance of their designated ZG office. ZG has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. . In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $12.00 - $25.00 hourly. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. . Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Who you are. 3+ years of mortgage origination experience with a strong emphasis on purchase transactions, either as an active NMLS Loan Originator with state licenses or as a Loan Originator under a federal bank license. . Completion of the 20-hour CORE Pre-Licensing Education and successful passage of the SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator Test - National Component with Uniform State Content. . Physically located in and working hybrid from our (Seattle, WA) Office. . Proven success originating purchase loans in either: a high-volume, phone-based sales environment or an agent-centric referral model. . Strong client service orientation with consultative sales skills and deep understanding of the mortgage process. . Comfortable working in a structured, performance-driven environment with clearly defined KPIs. . Excellent verbal communication skills and ability to build trust quickly. . Strong time management, organization, and pipeline management skills. . Proficiency with CRM, LOS, and Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Excel). . Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred. . Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply if you bring transferable skills or related experience. . Get to know us. At Zillow, we're reimagining how people move-through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you'll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. . How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they're most productive-enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. . Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME's America's Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. . No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry-and your career-forward, together. . Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly. . Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law. . Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company's reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. .

title: Employee Service Coordinator
description: . About the team. You'll be part of Zillow's HR Operations and Shared Services team, a group dedicated to delivering responsive, accurate support that helps employees navigate key moments across their Zillow journey. Working at the center of our people processes, the team partners closely with HR and business teams to coordinate transactions, improve workflows, and create a consistent, positive employee experience at scale. This is a collaborative team that values service, operational excellence, and continuous improvement in how we support our people. About the role. Zillow is searching for a collaborative individual who empathizes with the needs of employees and is proficient in resolving obstacles that may emerge. You have a steadfast dedication for delivering excellent service and are an expert in effectively prioritizing tasks while maintaining quality and attention to detail. . In this role, you'll contribute to Zillow's success by delivering a best-in-class support experience to our employees, while also providing dedicated support to Mexico employee programs. You'll tackle queries across all functional areas - HR, Compensation, Benefits, Workforce Management, and more - while ensuring our intranet remains updated. Your involvement will be pivotal in establishing scalable processes for employee support, playing a crucial role in our ongoing success. . What you'll do. . You must be based in Mexico City (CDMX) and able to work from the office as needed - at least once per month. Serve as the first point of contact for employee inquiries in ServiceNow, responding to and resolving cases within SLA on a variety of topics (onboarding, benefits, time off, payroll, company policies, Workday support, offboarding). . Partner with stakeholders from all employee support teams (Payroll, Benefits, Compensation, Talent Success, IT, Legal, etc.) to assist in answering a broad range of employee questions using a shared services support model. . Administer Mexico-specific employee programs, including meal vouchers and savings fund, and serve as a resource for related employee inquiries. . Maintain physical, on-site employee records to ensure compliance and keep records updated. This includes making sure the right teams have access to contracts, scanning new hire paperwork, and getting it to the appropriate team. (Uses discretion with confidential information). . Coordinate retrieval of company hardware from third-party legal counsel following involuntary separations, on a typically monthly cadence. . Act as an on-the-ground escalation point for Center of Expertise (COE) groups, providing local expertise and insights, and recognizing that some conversations may be best in Spanish. . Collaborate with teams like Payroll, Travel & Expense, and People Legal to improve processes for Zillow Group's Mexico employees. Provides administrative support, interacts with vendors and employees, gathers data for COE groups, and performs audits as needed. . Provide ad-hoc support for Mexico office events, such as HackWeek and housewarmings. This may include making reservations, handling logistics and communications, and working with various internal teams. . . This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events. . In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. . Who you are. You have proven experience in human resources or a related field. . You have strong organizational and time management skills. . You possess excellent written and verbal communication skills - you can deliver both good and bad news in a professional, compassionate manner. . You have outstanding problem-solving skills and a strong focus on customer satisfaction. . You have an eye for process improvement - you leave it better than you found it. . You can work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment while quickly adapting to evolving processes, policies, and technological advancements. . title: Business SOX Compliance Manager
description:
. About the team. The Zillow Group SOX Compliance Team provides business and IT control development, implementation and management across Zillow Group. Our team works closely with Finance, Product Development, IT and Security teams to help define compliance requirements for new products and features and support audit and assessment activities.
