description:
. About the team. Zillow is the top real estate website in the U.S., where millions of people come for help with their move. The hardest parts happen after the fun of browsing online, and the full process may span months. We empower home buyers by connecting them to the best professionals and tools to complete their move with confidence and ease.. The Post-Connect Engineering org owns the stretch of the journey that starts when a home buyer requests to tour a home and ends when their offer is under contract. It's all too easy for a buyer to be overwhelmed by the details and daunted by finding "the one" that fits the must-haves and the budget. Our job is to make touring and triaging homes easy to do with other people, so that buyers remain energized and able to actually move. Our systems manage appointments against real-world constraints, sustain rich conversations across disparate channels and apps, and convert a buyer's raw reactions to homes into actionable plans, with AI running throughout. About the role. You will primarily support five engineering teams and their partners in Product and Data Science on matters technical and strategic. You solve customer, business, and technical problems without authority over any team; your influence comes from the quality of your judgment and the relationships you cultivate. You will lead and mentor engineers across the organization and act as a domain expert and ambassador across Zillow Group. . You will be the primary technical steward of the backend of the Post-Connect domain; it spans multiple languages, third-party integrations, and a distributed architecture running in AWS. But we are first and foremost a product engineering team, with customers as our north star. You choose where your effort will have the most leverage. You will take on the problems that are too large or too ambiguous for a single team to absorb. The job requires self-direction with occasional top-down assignments: there is no backlog curated for you. . Success looks like framing a problem nobody has yet defined; asking tough questions to sharpen a plan; doing analysis that settles a build-versus-buy or an architecture decision; prototyping a new tool, pattern, or process yourself so the teams have a working exemplar to adopt; balancing your workload and delegating work that's not essential for you to do. description:
. About the team. The Mercury Mobile team builds Zillow Instant Messaging (ZIM) - the conversation layer where millions of movers participate in a multiplayer, integrated experience to find their next home. We own the messaging experience on both iOS and Android, from the real-time messaging core through the rich, interactive content inside every conversation. Our larger organization is responsible for turning interest in a home into a completed tour, a durable relationship with an agent, and a successful move. Right now we are rebuilding what a messaging product can be when an AI assistant is a participant in the conversation rather than a feature bolted onto it. About the role. As a Senior Software Development Engineer on Mercury Mobile, you will define how AI shows up inside ZIM on mobile - and you will do it on both platforms. This is deliberately a cross-platform role: you will work in Swift and Kotlin, and the architectural decisions you make will land on iOS and Android together rather than diverging. The problems are the interesting ones in mobile client engineering today: streaming AI responses into a live conversation without janking the UI, rendering multi-modal and richly structured content that exceeds what a message bubble was ever designed to hold, and building it all to work on a spotty connection in a driveway. You will have real ownership of the architecture, and a team that expects you to use it.. You Will Get To. Design and ship the mobile client architecture for AI in conversations - streaming responses, topic-based conversation structures, and multi-modal content rendering across iOS and Android. Own cross-platform architectural decisions for the ZIM messaging core, keeping Swift and Kotlin implementations converged rather than letting them drift. Build real-time, resilient messaging experiences that hold up on unreliable mobile networks, with observability and SLOs you define. description:

Zillow Group's Business Data organization represents the next step forward in the company's dedication to integrate an improved set of B2B agent software & advertising products for customers and partners, their clients, and the real estate industry as a whole.. We build scalable data products, infrastructure, and insights spanning data science, data engineering, platforms, and product analytics, partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to embed data-driven decision-making into go-to-market strategy and product development. Our current portfolio includes agent and broker analytics platforms, listing supply strategy and industry graph analytics, AI-enabled data practices, ML-driven sales segmentation and account prioritization, and rich media experiences. We are investing in this team, so this is an opportunity to join an organization growing in both size and influence. About the role. Broker and brokerage partnerships are a strategic focus for Zillow and one of the biggest growth opportunities in residential real estate. Brokers sit at a critical distribution level, and Zillow is investing in new products and programs to unlock the full potential of these partnerships. Robust measurement and strategic guidance will power what comes next: understanding where value is created, what's working, and where to invest. . The Business Data team is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to serve as a core analytics lead for Zillow's broker data products, measurement strategy, and enterprise ROI, turning on the lights to the depth and value of broker relationships across the Zillow Group ecosystem. You will lead the design of broker-level success metrics and the causal inference frameworks that measure product, go-to-market, and business impact at the enterprise level, and build the trusted, scalable analytical foundations that turn complex data into insights decision-makers act on. The data products you build won't just inform internal decisions; they will help Zillow deliver more value to broker partners and their customers. This is a newly formed pod with significant company investment and executive visibility: few roles offer this much influence over how a strategic priority is measured, understood, and grown. . This work is highly visible to senior leadership, and your insights will directly shape how Zillow invests in one of its biggest strategic areas. For a data scientist ready to grow, this is a rare opportunity to build a high-visibility charter from the ground up, with a clear runway to expand your scope, influence senior leaders, and sharpen your craft alongside a broad data organization working across AI-enabled analytics, data products, and measurement. You will see your work show up quickly in decisions, product direction, and the value Zillow delivers to its partners. . What you'll do. Serve as the high-context analytics owner for broker data products and go-to-market, establishing durable methodology and metric standards. . Independently scope and deliver end-to-end measurement and data science projects, from problem framing through methodology design, validation, and productionization. . Lead the design of broker-level success metrics and causal inference frameworks (e.g., matching, difference-in-differences) that quantify the impact of products, features, and go-to-market initiatives at the enterprise level. . Shapes the metrics, measurement approaches, and methodology standards that make broker data products trusted and actionable across the org. . Balances speed and rigor, making sound trade-offs in measurement, analysis, and stakeholder alignment. . title: Senior Data Scientist, Experimentation & AI Measurement
description: . About the team. The Zillow Experimentation Platform (ZEXP) team enables Zillow Group's Product, Engineering, and Data Science organizations to test bold ideas, validate strategies, and make trustworthy decisions quickly. Our mission is to make rigorous, self-service experimentation and measurement possible for anyone - regardless of their role - through powerful tools, clear guidance, and scientific rigor.. We're part of the Core Data Tech organization, partnering with engineers, data scientists, and machine learning practitioners to scale experimentation and measurement across the Zillow ecosystem. Our work fuels Zillow's Housing Super App strategy by enabling fast, safe, and accurate decision-making rooted in trustworthy data.. Learn more about what we're building at https://www.zillow.com/news/category/product-innovation/. About the role. As a Senior Data Scientist working in ZEXP, you'll deliver value through your analyses and by elevating the work of the team around you. You'll bring statistical rigor to two connected problems: making Zillow's experimentation practice more self-service and trustworthy, and measuring whether Zillow's growing investment in AI-assisted engineering and development tools creates durable, high-quality value rather than just activity. . This is an experienced individual-contributor role that blends hands-on measurement, causal inference, and applied statistics with team leadership. You'll act as a focal point for projects, mentor other scientists and analysts, and represent data science and experimentation to partner teams - advocating for sound measurement wherever decisions get made. You'll balance depth and speed in an environment of competing priorities, and you'll know when further rigor stops adding value.. You will get to. . Design, build, and validate statistically rigorous methods for experiment design and analysis - productionizing techniques such as variance-reduction and sequential testing as reusable, self-service platform capabilities. Build and improve automated guardrails that prevent the common causes of experiment restarts and manual interventions - in-flight monitoring and alerting, ramp-plan adherence, early-stopping thresholds, and cross-line-of-business guardrail-harm checks - in support of reliable and trustworthy experimentation practices. Lead experiment design reviews for high-visibility launches, catching issues like ill-suited experimental populations, misaligned hypotheses, or contradictory launch criteria, protecting Zillow's biggest decisions from flawed experimental practices. Define and scale a measurement framework for AI's impact on engineering and behavior - segmenting usage and proficiency at the team and org level, and connecting adoption to behavioral change, productivity, quality, and financial outcomes. Pair velocity signals with lagging quality measures (reverts, change-failure rate, MTTR, defects, maintainability) so that speed gains are never mistaken for net value. Apply causal-inference thinking to AI product and tooling measurement - establishing sound, defensible methods for measuring whether AI investments deliver real value. Turn complex analyses into leadership-ready narratives and self-service insight experiences that partners can explore on their own. Mentor junior scientists and analysts on the core data science toolkit, share best practices across the team, and lead workstreams end to end. . This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events. . In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. . Who you are. Strong applied background in online experimentation and causal inference - frequentist and Bayesian methods, experimental and quasi-experimental designs, and the judgment to know which methods are best suited to answer a given question. Familiar with the common failure modes of experimentation platforms (e.g., sample ratio mismatch, experiment interference, temporal exposure bias, multiple comparisons) and the expertise to detect, diagnose, and design the platform around them. Experienced with measuring productivity or product quality from telemetry - comfortable defining metrics, documenting their limitations, and resisting the urge to over-claim causality from cross-sectional observational data. A clear communicator who tells a persuasive story with data and tailors the level of technical detail to the audience, from engineers to executives. Proficient in Python and SQL, with relevant libraries (e.g., NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn); comfortable moving between different tools, codebases, and data sources. A trusted mentor and partner who raises the bar on best practices and advocates for data science across disciplines without alienating others. Curious about AI/ML measurement - LLM-assisted analysis, agentic tools, and how to evaluate them rigorously - a strong plus.. Qualifications. . PhD and 2+ years, MS and 4+ years, or BS and 6+ years of experience in Statistics, Econometrics, Data Science, Machine Learning, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field. Demonstrated track record of owning analyses end to end and turning them into decisions that partners trust. . Transferable Skills. . title: Manager, Rentals Collections
description:

You'll lead a team spanning onshore specialists and offshore partners, set the portfolio strategy and credit policy they work to, and own the measures that say whether it's working - days sales outstanding, aging, days to pay, recovery rate and bad debt.. Rentals receivables have their own shape: high transaction volume, a payer base running from individual landlords to national property management companies, and account relationships that often matter more than any single invoice. This is a role for someone who can hold a commercial line with customers and a credible one with sales, and who would rather fix why accounts go delinquent than chase each one that does. About the role. Own Rentals collections performance end to end - days sales outstanding, aging distribution, days to pay, recovery rate, bad debt and write-off levels - and drive quarterly reduction in past-due balances. Lead, coach and develop a team of specialists and senior specialists alongside offshore partner supervisors, including hiring, performance management and career development, and own the headcount model that forecasts and scales staffing to the portfolio. Set portfolio strategy and segmentation across a payer base ranging from individual landlords to national property management groups - deciding which accounts get treated how, at what point, and by whom. Own the outsourced delivery relationship - onboarding, training, service levels, quality audits across onshore and offshore work, and the division of work between them. Run monthly collections reviews with each Rentals product team, and partner with sales and customer support on at-risk and high-value accounts, holding a commercial line while protecting the relationship. title: Director, Application Security
description:
. About the team. Zillow's Information Security team is the engineering-first security organization at the heart of one of the most-visited real estate platforms in the United States. We protect a product ecosystem that drives real estate transactions, safeguards the personal and financial data of millions of customers, and powers a marketplace that is reimagining what it means to come home.. We operate like a product engineering team- we build, automate, and ship. Our security engineers are embedded partners to the product and platform organizations, not gatekeepers. We move fast, we prefer paved roads over guard rails, and we treat security as a feature of the product rather than a tax on it. Our work spans cloud-native infrastructure at scale, a high-velocity application development lifecycle, real-time threat detection and response, and a threat intelligence program that informs both defensive and product risk decisions across the company.. This is a team where technical credibility matters. Our leaders write strategy documents and review detection logic and SDLC security controls. If you've spent your career building things - secure software, detection pipelines, AppSec programs, zero trust architectures -this is the kind of organization you've been building toward. About the role. As Director of Information Security, drive the strategy, execution, and maturity Application Security, and Security Architecture and our India Security Team. This is an M5 leadership role that reports directly to the VP, Information Security , and carries significant accountability for the security posture, talent, and engineering culture of a large, multi-function organization. . We are looking for a builder, someone who has led application security organizations inside high-growth technology companies where engineering velocity is a first-class value. You have a background that started in software engineering or security engineering, and you've never fully left it behind. You are the leader who can earn trust with a senior engineers and peers, recruit principal-level security engineers, and then go present business risk. . You will manage a team of managers and senior individual contributors across your four domains, partnering deeply with Platform Engineering, Product, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance. You will set multi-year technical roadmaps, own the operational budget and tooling strategy for your org, and serve as a key voice in defining the company's overall security risk posture and investment priorities. . Responsibilities. Leadership & Organizational Strategy. Lead and develop a multi-manager organization across Application Security, and Security Architecture, setting clear direction, healthy team culture, and high-performance expectations at every level. Establish and execute a 2-3-year strategic roadmap for your domains that is tightly coupled to Zillow's product and platform engineering priorities, not just industry compliance frameworks. Own workforce planning, org design, talent acquisition, and the development of a bench of future security leaders-with a specific focus on recruiting and retaining engineers who want to build, not just advise. Manage budget, tooling portfolio, and vendor relationships across your scope, with a bias toward consolidation, automation ROI, and eliminating tool sprawl. Represent Application Security at the executive and leadership level; translate complex technical risk into business impact for the VP. . Application Security. Lead an AppSec organization that partners with product engineering rather than policing it-building "paved road" security capabilities embedded in CI/CD pipelines, frameworks, and developer tooling. Drive a developer-first security culture: create security enablement programs, secure coding training, and internal tooling that make the secure path the easy path for Zillow's engineers. Ensure comprehensive coverage of Zillow's application portfolio including secure design review, DAST/SAST integration, dependency management, and API security. Own product security strategy, ensuring that security is a design-time consideration in new product features, not an audit checkpoint at the end of the SDLC. Build and maintain a vulnerability management program with clear SLAs, risk-based prioritization, and executive-facing reporting. . Security Architecture. Partner with the Security Architecture function to establish and maintain enterprise security patterns, reference architectures, and guardrails for Zillow's cloud-native, AWS-centric infrastructure. Drive Zero Trust principles and identity-driven access across the environment, working with Platform Engineering to embed security patterns into infrastructure-as-code and platform primitives. Ensure security architecture is a proactive partner in platform and product design reviews, providing clear, opinionated guidance that accelerates rather than slows engineering delivery. Maintain a forward-looking architecture posture: evaluate emerging threats and technology shifts (e.g., AI/ML-driven attack surfaces, cloud configuration risk) and evolve controls accordingly. . description: . About the team. This role is responsible for reviewing residential real estate appraisal reports for U.S. conventional mortgages and, over time, may support FHA appraisal reviews as well. You will provide a collateral risk opinion that supports sound underwriting decisions, ensures alignment with agency/investor guidelines, and helps streamline our end‑to‑end mortgage operations. This team sits tangential to underwriting and partners closely with processing, helping to reduce defects, rework, and cycle time while protecting ZHL from collateral risk. . This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. . Who you are. What you'll do:. . Collateral risk & appraisal review. Review residential appraisal reports for conventional and FHA loans, ensuring they meet ZHL standards and applicable investor/agency guidelines. Assess collateral risk by analyzing subject property characteristics, market conditions, comparable selection, adjustments, reconciliation of value, and property photos. Identify appraisal deficiencies, inconsistencies, or red flags (e.g., market anomalies, condition/quality mismatches, unsupported adjustments, data errors). Recommend appropriate actions, including appraisal clearance, revision requests, desk reviews, and escalations, to protect ZHL from collateral-related loss. Quality, efficiency, and risk management. Apply a defect-prevention mindset, focusing on clear, actionable feedback that reduces rework from appraisers and downstream teams. Balance quality and speed, consistently meeting or exceeding SLA expectations for turn times and review volume without compromising risk standards. Support implementation of appraisal review tools, checklists, job aids, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) that drive consistency across the team. Cross-functional collaboration. Partner closely with processing to surface collateral-related conditions and resolve issues quickly. Work tangentially with underwriting to help structure effective appraisal revision requests, escalation paths, and edge-case interpretations. Communicate clearly in writing and in meetings, documenting review outcomes, rationale, and recommendations in a way that's easy for non‑appraisal experts to understand. Continuous improvement in a new team. Share recurring defect patterns and risk themes with leadership to drive process, training, and policy updates. Contribute to a learning-oriented, collaborative culture, including participation in calibration sessions, quality huddles, and knowledge sharing within the team. . What you'll bring. 3+ years of recent experience reviewing residential appraisal reports for a U.S. mortgage lender, investor, or AMC, with direct accountability for collateral risk. Strong working knowledge of U.S. residential appraisal concepts, including:. Property types, highest and best use, neighborhood/market analysis. Sales comparison, cost, and/or income approaches (as applicable). Comparable selection, adjustments, and reconciliation of value. Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply U.S. agency/investor guidelines for collateral (e.g., conventional; exposure to FHA a plus). Proven track record of meeting production and quality targets in a high-volume environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to provide clear, structured feedback to processing and underwriting teams. . Get to know us. About the role. The Principal Product Manager, Directed Workflows drives the vision, strategy, and execution for how ZHL's sales and service process gets encoded as directed work. title: Sr. Director, Customer Identity and Access Management
description:
. About the team. The Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) team sits within Foundations Engineering and owns the authentication and authorization platform for one of the most-visited websites in the United States, as well as our associated brands. Every sign-in, AI chat, session and permission check across Zillow's brands runs through systems this team builds and operates. We ship services, SDKs, and components that let product teams move quickly on web, mobile and AI interfaces without each team reinventing identity and access management.. We operate like a platform product team, not a gatekeeper. Our customers are the engineers and product teams across Zillow Group, and we measure ourselves by how much faster and safer they can ship because our paved paths exist. Our work spans an authentication platform that securely adapts to users needs as they become more serious about their home buying journey, a fine-grained authorization service designed for high-volume policy evaluation, and a growing set of centralized Customer and Identity services in our Consumer Domain that is the canonical source of truth for who our customers are.. This is a team where technical credibility matters. Our leaders write strategy documents, sit in design reviews, and can reason about token lifetimes and authorization models without a translator. If you have spent your career building platforms that other engineers depend on, this is the kind of organization you have been building toward. About the role. As Sr. Director of Customer Identity and Access Management, you will own the strategy, execution, and maturity of Zillow's customer identity platform. You will lead three engineering teams through frontline Engineering Managers and directly support two Principal Engineers who anchor the technical direction of the platform. . Three programs define the next two years of this org's work:. Centralized Authentication Platform. Consolidating authentication across Zillow Group's brands and surfaces onto a single, well-instrumented platform built on a commercial IdP that we extend substantially to meet consumer scale and experience requirements. . Fine-Grained Authorization Platform. Building an authorization service that lets product teams express and evaluate permissions at the resource level, replacing the bespoke and duplicative access logic scattered across applications today. . Consumer Domain - Centralized Customer and Identity services. Filling out the domain with authoritative customer and identity services so that profile, account, and entitlement data have one owner and one contract rather than a dozen partial copies. . We are looking for a strong, experienced leader. You come from a high-volume software or platform engineering background and you have never fully left it behind. You can earn trust with Principal Engineers, recruit senior talent who could work anywhere, negotiate roadmaps with internal leadership, and then turn around and frame identity investment in business terms for executives to easily understand. You will set multi-year technical roadmaps, own the operational budget and vendor strategy for your organization, and serve as Zillow's senior voice on customer identity, authentication and authorization. . Responsibilities. Leadership and Organizational Strategy. Lead and develop a multi-team organization through frontline Engineering Managers, setting clear direction, healthy team culture, and high-performance expectations at every level. . Directly support Principal Engineers who help you understand complex systems, anchor architectural decisions, and identify opportunities to innovate and align. . Take broad strategy and focus areas from senior leadership and transform them into technical strategies, objectives, and tactical plans your teams can execute against. . Work hand-in-hand with internal and external AI teams and financial platforms to simplify authentication and authorization while adapting our technical solutions to rapidly evolving areas of our business. . Establish and execute a 2-3 year roadmap for customer identity that is tightly coupled to product and platform engineering priorities across Zillow Group. . Own workforce planning, org design, hiring, and the development of a bench of future engineering leaders. Maintain premeditated succession plans and growth pathways for managers and ICs alike. . Manage budget, tooling portfolio, and vendor relationships across your scope, with a clear view of your org's cost profile and its contribution to overall engineering spend. . Represent CIAM at the executive level. Translate identity architecture and risk into business impact for leadership. . Centralized Authentication Platform. Own the strategy for consolidating authentication across Zillow Group brands, surfaces, and acquisitions onto a single platform, sequencing migrations so partner teams are never blocked. . Drive the extension of our commercial Identity Provider into a platform that meets Zillow-specific requirements for consumer experience, scale, and latency, deciding deliberately where to configure the vendor, where to build around it, and where to build our own solutions. . Ensure authentication is delivered as a first-class platform capability, with SDKs, reference implementations, and documentation that make correct integration the easy path for product engineers. . Set direction on account security capabilities including MFA, step-up and conditional access, session management, and account recovery, balancing security posture against consumer conversion and friction. . Partner with Information Security, Privacy, Legal, and Compliance on identity controls, fraud and abuse patterns, and regulatory obligations. . Fine-Grained Authorization Platform. Lead the design and delivery of a fine-grained authorization platform capable of high-volume, low-latency policy evaluation across Zillow's product surfaces. . Establish the authorization model, policy authoring experience, and migration path that lets product teams move off bespoke, application-embedded access logic. . Ensure the platform is instrumented for auditability, so that "who could access what, and when" is an answerable question. . Drive adoption across partner orgs. Treat integration count and retired bespoke logic as first-class measures of success, not the shipped service alone. . Consumer Domain: Customer and Identity Services. Grow our nascent Consumer Domain with centralized Customer and Identity services, establishing clear ownership, contracts, and canonical sources of truth for customer and identity data. . Drive alignment across the domain to eliminate duplicative and partial implementations, reaching across org boundaries where necessary to get the right outcome for Zillow Group. . Partner with Product, Data, and downstream consuming teams to define service boundaries that hold up as the business evolves. . Design for correctness in identity resolution, data lifecycle, and privacy obligations from the start rather than as a retrofit. . Quality, Reliability, and Operations. Remain accountable for execution and quality across your teams through mechanisms - rituals, processes, inspection, reports, metrics, feedback loops - rather than direct involvement in week-to-week delivery. . Set the quality bar for systems that are in the critical path of nearly every customer interaction. Authentication outages are company outages. . Own availability, latency, and cost targets for your platform. Ensure adequate investment in technical quality is prioritized alongside feature delivery. . Ensure sustainable, low-toil on-call practices and a culture of blameless post-incident review with systemic remediation. . . This role has been categorized as a Remote position. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. Who you are. 12+ years of high-volume engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading through managers in a technology organization where engineering velocity is a first-class value. . Roots in software or platform engineering. You have built platforms that dev teams rely on, and your technical instincts remain sharp enough to engage credibly with Principal Engineers and architects. . Deep knowledge and experience of identity and access management concepts and best practices: authentication, authorization, multi-factor authentication, conditional access, session and token management. . Strong working understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, and JWT, including the failure modes and tradeoffs, not just the specifications. . Hands-on background with commercial IAM platforms such as Auth0, Okta, or Ping Identity, including the realities of extending them well beyond out-of-the-box configuration. . Experience delivering platform capabilities consumed by many teams, with a track record of driving adoption and retiring the systems you replace. . Deep cloud experience (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, etc.) and experience with large-scale application architectures where performance, reliability, scalability, availability, and security are all binding constraints. . Demonstrated ability to drive alignment across multiple VP-level orgs and to identify and redress misalignment proactively, acting firmly even when the decision is unpopular. . Exceptional communication. You tailor your message from junior engineer to executive, you plan ahead for change management, and you own the message rather than relaying it. . A talent magnet. A reputation for hiring, coaching, and developing engineers and managers, with the credibility to attract senior ICs who have options. . BS in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. . Standout Experience:. Experience building or operating a fine-grained or relationship-based authorization system (Zanzibar-style or similar) at production scale. . Experience leading a migration or consolidation of authentication across multiple brands, acquisitions, or legacy systems. . Background in high-volume, consumer-scale B2C identity, where conversion and friction are measured alongside security outcomes. . Familiarity with domain-driven design and the practical work of establishing canonical services in a large, previously decentralized estate. . description:

The Platform Engineering team owns the infrastructure every engineer at Zillow builds on, spanning compute and runtime, networking and connectivity, databases, secrets and identity, and the delivery tooling that moves code to production. We are shifting from an infrastructure operations model to platform-as-a-product, replacing ticket queues and manual provisioning with golden paths, self-service, and API-first interfaces so that product teams can focus on business outcomes instead of operational complexity.. Increasingly, this platform serves AI agents alongside the engineers directing them. Our self-service paths are evolving to support agent-driven, pipeline-driven, and hybrid workflows, making Platform Engineering foundational to how quickly and safely Zillow can build with AI. About the role. . As a Principal Product Manager for Platform Engineering, you will own product strategy for the platform capabilities that every engineering team at Zillow depends on. You will define the golden paths teams follow by default, drive adoption and migration onto those paths across thousands of services, and establish the measurement and value model that makes the platform's impact visible to the business. . This is the first dedicated product role in the organization. Platform Engineering has already built many of the foundations of a product operating model - customer discovery, written product requirements, and outcome metrics are how these teams work today - with engineering leaders carrying that work alongside running their teams. As a Principal Product Manager, you will raise the ceiling on that practice, partnering with engineering leadership across six teams to deepen discovery, sharpen prioritization, and organize the roadmap around customer problems and value streams rather than infrastructure layers. . Your scope spans the full platform surface - though the areas you drive most directly will be shaped by where the leverage is greatest as near-term product needs across the teams stabilize. Establish how platform success is measured - adoption, onboarding time, satisfaction, and key customer outcomes - and build the underlying value model of what capabilities cost to serve and what they are worth. . description: . About the team. title: Principal Product Manager, Rental Listings
description:
. About the team. Zillow Rentals is building a best-in-class vertically integrated marketplace that connects renters with property owners and managers - from large-scale multifamily communities to single-family homes. We provide advertising solutions and a complete set of digital tools to help partners market their properties, identify prospective tenants, sign leases, and collect payments. This is a high-growth, high-focus area for Zillow and an opportunity to make an outsized impact. Our team includes applied scientists, engineers, designers, product managers, marketers, and researchers partnering across Zillow to deliver trusted experiences for millions of customers. About the role. . Every renter journey on Zillow starts with inventory. If the underlying listing data isn't complete, accurate, and rich, nothing downstream - messaging, touring, applications, leasing - performs the way it should. This role owns that foundation. . The Principal Product Manager for Listings will set the strategy for what makes Zillow's rental selection the deepest, richest, and most complete on the internet. You'll own how rental inventory is sourced, ingested, enriched, and scored for quality - ensuring consumer-facing teams have the best possible data to work with. This spans listing completeness and content quality, inventory coverage and growth, and the data and content partnerships that differentiate Zillow's selection. You'll partner closely with feed engineering on data quality and platform reliability, and represent listings strategy to senior leadership and external partners alike. . This is a high-visibility, strategic product role - not a narrow pipeline role. Get this right and you create a flywheel: richer inventory drives more renter engagement, which attracts more and better inventory. You're building the marketplace's core advantage. . What you'll tackle:. Listing completeness & quality: Raise the depth and quality of listing data across all inventory - pricing transparency, amenities, media richness, and the completeness scores that directly drive renter trust and conversion. You'll define what "great" looks like and build the system that gets inventory there at scale. . Coverage & inventory growth: Grow the breadth and depth of rental inventory on Zillow across property types and sourcing channels. . Data & content partnerships: Source new content partnerships (media, floor plans, review content) and optimize existing feed and aggregator relationships - negotiating, onboarding, and tuning third-party data sources so Zillow has the most comprehensive, highest-quality rental selection anywhere. . Platform reliability & syndication: Partner with engineering to keep the listings pipeline stable, performant, and trustworthy - balancing committed roadmap work against urgent partner escalations, and making disciplined tradeoffs when the two collide. . What success looks like:. Measurably better listings: A rising share of inventory delivered complete, accurate, and rich - backed by a completeness standard the whole ecosystem can rally around. . Broader, deeper coverage: Meaningful growth in rental inventory across channels and property types. . Partnerships that differentiate: New and optimized content partnerships that make Zillow's selection unmistakably the richest on the internet. . A reliable, scalable foundation: A listings platform that partners and renters trust - stable, performant, and ready for whatever the marketplace throws at it. . . description: . About the team. The business forecasting group at Zillow shapes planning across Zillow's businesses. Advanced degree (PhD or Masters) in Economics, Statistics, Operations Research, Data Science, Computer Science, Econometrics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline or a related quantitative discipline with 5+ years of experiences in professional applied scientist roles. . Strong experience with time-series forecasting, econometrics, or related quantitative modeling techniques. . title: Senior Manager, Incident Management
description:
. About the team. Zillow Group is seeking a Senior Manager, Incident Management (M4) to lead our incident and problem management function and elevate how we drive operational excellence across production systems. This role owns the strategy, process, and people behind incident response and problem management, ensuring we not only resolve incidents quickly but prevent recurrence and continuously raise the bar on reliability.. At the M4 level, success is anchored in four core areas: Program Leadership: building and scaling the incident and problem management practice across the organization; Problem Management: driving structured root cause analysis and systemic fixes that reduce repeat incidents; AI-Enabled Operations: leveraging AI workflows and tooling to increase the speed, quality, and actionability of incident and problem outputs for internal partners; and People Leadership: developing a high-performing team of incident managers and setting the standard for operational rigor. About the role. Responsibilities. Incident Management Leadership. Own the end-to-end incident management program, including process design, tooling, and governance across the organization. . Serve as executive escalation point and senior decision-maker for critical, high-severity, or cross-functional incidents. . Set and enforce standards for incident severity classification, escalation paths, and communication protocols. . Partner with Engineering, Product, and business leadership to align incident response with business priorities and risk tolerance. . Drive executive-level incident communications, ensuring leadership has clear, timely, and accurate visibility into impact and status. . Problem Management. Build and own a formal problem management practice that connects incident trends to systemic root causes. . Ensure every significant incident produces a rigorous, blameless root cause analysis (RCA) with clearly owned, tracked corrective actions. . Establish mechanisms to identify recurring issues, chronic risks, and process gaps across incident history. . Hold cross-functional partners accountable for closing problem records and remediation items on committed timelines. . Report on problem management outcomes and reliability trends to leadership, tying them to measurable risk reduction. . Leveraging AI Workflows for Speed & Quality. Champion the adoption of AI-powered tooling and workflows across incident detection, triage, summarization, and RCA drafting. . Design and continuously improve AI-assisted workflows that turn raw incident and problem data into clear, actionable insights for internal partners. . Ensure AI-generated call-outs, summaries, and reports meet a high bar for accuracy, relevance, and actionability before reaching stakeholders. . Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational tasks (documentation, status updates, trend analysis) to free the team to focus on higher-value judgment work. . Partner with Engineering and Data teams to pilot, evaluate, and scale new AI capabilities that improve mean-time-to-resolution and mean-time-to-detection. . People & Team Leadership. Hire, coach, and develop a team of incident managers, building depth and bench strength across severity levels. . Set clear performance expectations and career growth paths for the team. . Establish on-call structures, workload balance, and rotations that sustain team health and reliability coverage. . Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and blameless learning within the team. . Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement. Define and track key metrics (MTTR, MTTD, recurrence rate, action-item closure rate) to measure program health and impact. . Continuously refine runbooks, tooling, and workflows based on retrospectives and data trends. . Facilitate post-incident reviews for major incidents, ensuring lessons learned translate into concrete process or system changes. . Benchmark practices against industry standards and bring in outside best practices where relevant. . Scope & Impact. Owns the incident and problem management strategy and roadmap for the organization. . Accountable for outcomes across the full incident lifecycle, from detection through remediation and prevention. . Directly manages a team of incident managers and indirectly influences engineering and support teams during incident response. . Shapes how AI and automation are applied across operational workflows, with measurable impact on speed and quality of output. . Decisions and process changes influence reliability posture and stakeholder trust across the broader organization. . . This role has been categorized as a Remote position. description: . About the team. The Developer Experience (DevEx) Delivery Engineering team builds and operates Zillow's software delivery platform. description: . About the team. title: Senior Product Manager, Search & Evaluate - StreetEasy
description:
. About the team. StreetEasy is the most-used local real estate platform in New York City - the place where millions of buyers and renters begin, conduct, and ultimately make one of the highest-stakes decisions of their lives. Unlike when searching for everyday items, our users aren't just looking for quick, easy results. They're navigating a complex market defined by co-op boards, neighborhood nuance, and inventory that moves fast and unevenly. Search & Evaluate sits at the center of that experience, where users spend the most time and where the most critical intent signals are generated. This role owns the core shopping experience - search, browse, compare, evaluate - and the data and signals it produces that power personalization, agent matching, and growth across the platform. About the role. We're looking for a Senior PM who has managed search tools for a marketplace. You understand that searching for a home is a long, thoughtful process, which is very different from searching for simple, everyday products or just browsing general content.You've lived the tension between relevance and monetization, between exploration and conversion, and between what users say they want and what behavioral data tells you they actually do. This is a pivotal role where you'll elevate the product to the next level. There is massive potential to innovate through AI-assisted discovery, intent-aware personalization, and advanced agentic flows. You'll have the opportunity to define this roadmap and lead the team in building a more personalized decision-making journey for our users.. You Will Get To. Define and drive the search and shopping experience across web, iOS, and Android, from initial query through listing and building detail, saving and comparing. Rethink how we personalize the process of finding a home-a high-stakes, infrequent decision. User intent shifts over months, so our sparse signals have to do more heavy lifting than in typical search contexts. Partner with engineering and data science to lead the evolution of our search strategy, prioritizing high-impact AI-native opportunities that will transform how users navigate the market. Own the property evaluation pages and experience, helping users navigate NYC-specific nuances like co-op policies and pricing. Navigate the structural tension between organic relevance and advertising products that are core to the business model - not a side constraint, but a daily design problem. Set the measurement framework for search quality in a non-deterministic, AI-powered experience - defining what "good" looks like when you can't rely on clean A/B tests alone.. . title: Brand Designer
description: About Co-Star. Someone downloads Co-Star every 5 seconds. In the five years since we launched, 25% of young people 18-25 in the US have downloaded the app. Big Sean has rapped about us, Ariana Grande & Kevin Durant post screenshots to their IGs, and we've been App of the Day twice. We've been featured in the New York Times three times, this year on the cover of NYT Style. We have a global following, in 193 countries - missing just North Korea and Eritrea. We don't pay for marketing - we designed the app to go viral, and it did. Astrology has been popular for 4,000 years. Astrology is a tool for speaking about yourself, about who you are, what you're experiencing, and how you relate to other people - in other words, a language for the things that really matter. It's a structured system, based on the physical locations of the planets in the sky, developed over millennia 4,000 years of practice. Everyone has memories of reading a horoscope in the newspaper. You know your sign the same way you know the name of the street you grew up on. An average of 43% of Americans have believed in astrology since the 1970s. We're merging the resonance of the humanities with the precision of technology. Co-Star uses real-time NASA data and AI to bring this practice to the modern age. Every day, Co-Star generates millions of hyper-personalized horoscopes - a scale never previously possible. Every word of it is based on each person's unique astrology: where the stars physically were when they were born and where those same stars are now. Co-Star combines the art of ancient practice with cutting-edge artificial intelligence, creating the first synthetic text to be called "wildly beautiful.". We're a small, experienced team. Co-Star is a team of 30, with experience in big tech (Amazon, Google, Snapchat), entertainment (Frank Ocean, Adult Swim), and academia (Harvard, Stanford, NYU, Columbia). About the brand designer role. We're looking for a talented visual designer to shape how Co-Star shows up outside of the app, in the broader world. We are looking for someone with a fresh, opinionated, and high-quality design foundation who can create work that feels distinct, not what's now but what's next. You'll partner closely with the leadership on campaigns and visual storytelling across earned and owned channels. This is a freelance engagement with potential for a long-term partnership as the work (and team) grows. What you'll do. Design campaign visuals: ads, social, launches - from concept through finished assets. Bring editorial design sensibility to our owned channels: email/welcome series, blog, campaign imagery. Develop visual systems that are expressive rather than corporate. Partner with marketing on what earned and owned should look and feel like. Collaborate async with a small, fast-moving team. You might be a fit if. You're a senior IC - roughly 5-8 years in - with a portfolio of expressive, culturally fluent graphic design: editorial, campaigns, identities across print and digital. Typography and composition are your first language. You can direct as well as execute: you've shaped campaigns, not just produced assets for them. You're plugged into visual culture across art, fashion, publishing, music, and the internet. You work well remotely and independently. Nice to have. Editorial/publication experience (print or digital magazines). Motion or illustration. You already make things with generative tools. Logistics. Freelance/contract, part-time to start, with room to grow. Fully remote, anywhere. No travel required (though you're always welcome in NYC). To apply. Send your portfolio. We care about taste, range, and point of view..

title: Haskell Developer
description: In the late 1960s, Bell Labs was grappling with a large project: an unwieldy operating system called Multics. It was too complex, too slow, and ultimately Bell withdrew. A small group of researchers, led by Ken Thompson and Dennis Ritchie, decided to start over-not with grand designs, but with simplicity at the core. They aimed for function over perfection and were deliberate in their collaboration. Engineers shared ideas as rough drafts, circulated them early, and refined them through iteration. From this came Unix. It wasn't about working harder or sacrificing more - it was about getting ideas out quickly and leveraging collective intelligence early in the process. This is central to how we build at Co-Star: we start with simple solutions, share them early as written docs, and evolve them through real-world feedback. At Co-Star you'll help tens of millions of people connect with each other and themselves-through astrology-in real, meaningful ways. We're looking for a backend engineer who values feedback, who is both fast and deliberate, and who creates systems that let small teams deliver outsized results. What you'll do. Partner closely with product, design, and other engineers to deliver high-quality solutions that align with business priorities. You'll be a true collaborator who helps move the team forward as a unit. Break down complex problems to provide insight, technical guidance, and shape scope. You'll weigh tradeoffs to find the best solution for the business and articulate those points in writing. Own delivery and move quickly. We're looking for someone who eagerly seeks feedback and actively moves the ball forward - who genuinely enjoys getting their code into the world. What you'll bring. 3-7 years of backend development experience. Knowledge of or excitement to learn Haskell. You love good documentation and testing. You know well-documented, tested code sets your future-self up for success. A sense of ownership over work end-to-end, accountability for results, and supportiveness for your team. You're passionate and pragmatic when problem solving. You focus on outcomes and enjoy solving user problems. Strong technical judgment. You can articulate tradeoffs clearly, especially when working with incomplete information or in pre-decision situations. You make informed decisions that balance speed with quality and see around corners to anticipate potential challenges. Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and databases (we use PostgreSQL). What we offer. Fully covered $0 deductible healthcare + vision, dental, and therapy. 401(k) + 5% matching. Unlimited vacation + 2 week company-wide recharge at the end of each year. Equipment budget. 12 weeks 100% paid parental leave. Readings with in-house astrologers. A competitive total rewards package, including base salary, equity (stock options), and benefits. Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the tech industry and are regularly updated using the most reliable compensation survey data. Offers are crafted based on a candidate's experience, expertise, location, and internal equity relative to peers. Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role is $159,000-$205,000..

title: Junior Operations Associate
description: Co-Star is looking for a Junior Operations Associate to take care of our users and our SoHo office. You'll be the person behind the scenes making sure things work as they should. You'll answer questions from the millions of people who use Co-Star, identify problems before they become patterns, and help translate what we hear from users back to the team. You'll also keep our office stocked, organized, and running beautifully, and help bring Co-Star events to life. This is a junior role for someone with good taste, excellent instincts, and a habit of noticing what needs to happen before anyone asks. What you'll do. Manage customer support through Zendesk, helping users with accounts, purchases, natal charts, and more. Improve macros and automated responses so support feels efficient without feeling impersonal. Identify recurring issues, escalate edge cases, and share useful patterns with the product team. Use AI tools and Claude Code regularly to automate repetitive work, analyze support data, and make our customer experience workflows more efficient. Support Co-Star events and daily office operations, from coordinating with vendors and creating a welcoming office environment to managing office equipment and ordering daily lunch. Notice what needs to be done, take ownership, and follow it through without waiting to be asked for a wide variety of tasks. You might be a fit if. You write clearly, warmly, and like a person. You're observant, organized, and unusually good at following through: you naturally anticipate what people will need and take care of it. You have strong judgment and know when to solve something yourself and when to escalate it. You already use AI tools in your work and are excited to use Claude Code, even if you don't consider yourself a programmer. You have experience in customer support, hospitality, events, retail, or office operations. Logistics. Full-time in New York City. You'll work from our SoHo office daily. Compensation: $65,000-83,000, plus benefits..

title: Product Designer
location: Hybrid: New York or San Francisco
description: Product Designer. In the 1960s, the Italian artist and inventor Bruno Munari was studying spontaneous forms: shapes that emerge from the interaction of material, function, and environment. When Danese Milano commissioned him to design a lamp that was practical, durable, affordable, and easy to transport, Munari was reminded of the traditional rice paper lanterns he had encountered when traveling in Japan. But rice paper lanterns are fragile, hard to clean, and tend to yellow over time. Looking for an industrial alternative, he discovered filanca-a synthetic stretch nylon used exclusively for women's stockings at the time. Munari visited hosiery factories to test the material and see what forms it could take. "We do not make lamps, sir. Only stockings," one factory told him. Munari replied, "You'll see.". The result was the Falkland lamp: only a few centimeters thick when packaged, as tall as a human when hung, its spontaneous form emerging from the elasticity of the nylon and metal rings of different diameters inserted at regular intervals, enlarged by gravity when suspended from above. Munari didn't begin with the form of a lamp. He began with the qualities it needed, then looked outside the conventions of lighting to find the right materials and methods. We're looking for a designer who works the same way: someone who studies the systems and materials at hand, then finds a way of putting them together that feels both unexpected and inevitable. At Co-Star, the materials are a 4,000-year-old system of astrology, planetary data from NASA, and a corpus written by astrologers and poets. The qualities we're designing for: astrology made accessible without asking anyone to learn a complex system, and a language that lets people share something intimate with their friends. We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to continue cultivating those qualities across Co-Star and new experiments. You'll move between product architecture, interaction design, prototyping, and visual design. Ideas rarely arrive as polished specs. You'll help decide what we make next and how it works.. What you'll do. Design and build products from concept through launch. Work closely with design and engineering on new features and launches. You care about the details-typography, layout, motion, responsiveness, loading states, and performance-that make an experience great. Contribute visual assets for marketing. Prototype ideas quickly using Figma, Claude, Cursor, and whatever tools helps move the work forward. You might be a fit if. You have 2-5 years of experience designing and building for the web. You move fluidly across the full design process, from early concept through final production. You have an instinct for the details that make interfaces feel considered: type, spacing, motion, and how they all work together. You know enough HTML and CSS to work effectively with engineers-or to build parts of the experience yourself. You're comfortable using tools like Claude Code and Cursor as part of your workflow. You'd rather prototype than make a presentation. Work > ego. Logistics. Full-time. Hybrid in San Francisco or New York. Compensation: $150,500-$185,000 + benefits. To apply. A portfolio is required. We care much more about what you've made than where you've worked; if this sounds like you, apply even if you don't check every box..

title: Social Media and Brand Creative
description: Have you made an Instagram carousel as part of your art or writing practice? Do you reference Simone Weil and Sex and the City with equal weight? Are you bonded deeply with a sister, friend, cousin or mother who drinks out of a Stanley Cup? Conceptually, what astrological sign answers yes to all three of these questions?. We are expanding our social media department creatively and in headcount. This role includes work on new branding projects as well. To write for our social media and brand, we must be a responsive team that listens to the world's cues, processes them with sensitivity, and turns out timely interpretations that thrill a Co-Star-specific spectrum of people who read their horoscope daily. Please have a lifetime of experience consuming the internet, media and references that make you feel seen in this world, and hold reverence for the basic, the branded and the popular. What you'll do:. Concept funny, smart, ownable insights for astrological signs. Go for weird, but be able to pull back to test for different angles. Work with and punch other creatives' work live in meetings as well as collaborate with team on yours. Mock up your ideas visually. What you'll bring:. A sharp sense of how the internet talks, pop culture narrative past, present and future, and how to respond with humor, insight, and astrological interpretation. Knowledge of astrology isn't necessary, but piercing insight into human behavior is, whether through academia, astrology, therapy, or a lifetime of careful observation. Ability to address and incorporate feedback on writing and concepts. Hit deadlines consistently. Confident knowledge of IG, X and TikTok communities appreciated. Knowledge of Google Docs and Figma a plus. Logistics:. Remote, but local to NYC preferred. Part-time, 15-20 hours per week with potential to move to full-time. Compensation: $25,000-38,000. .

title: Writer
location: Remote, but local to NYC preferred.
description: In the 1940s a wealthy American businessman, known simply as "Collector," commissioned Anïs Nin, Henry Miller, and other famous writers to produce erotic fiction for his private consumption, at a rate of one dollar per page. "This started an epidemic of erotic journals. Everyone was writing up their sexual experiences. Invented, overheard, researched from Krafft-Ebing and medical books. We had comical conversations. We told a story and the rest of us had to decide whether it was true or false. Or plausible. Was this plausible? Robert Duncan would offer to experiment, to test our inventions, to confirm or negate our fantasies.". Nin never met the collector herself. But occasionally she received a phone call. "Less poetry," said the voice over the telephone. "Be specific.". Writing horoscopes is a little like writing erotica. You must write about your own life and everyone you have ever known. You must look directly at the most uncomfortable bits of life: our perversions, shadows, embarrassing insecurities, and describe them as plainly as possible, with generosity and care for our tender hearts and fragile dreams. Doing it well is arduous but can also be pleasurable. A practice for all the other types of writing you will do. We're looking for this kind of writer to join the Co-Star Content team. You'll help tens of millions of people connect with each other and themselves-through astrology-in real, meaningful ways. What you'll do. Express complex human experience with simplicity and nuance, compassion and objectivity. Wield the horoscope to find new ways to make people feel seen. "Recover the sensation of life; make us feel things, make the stone stony .". Rewrite what feels tired and trite. Cut everything unnecessary. Internalize the brand, and make it come alive in your own words. What you'll bring. A strong voice and internal compass. Keen observational skills. You perform psychological brain surgery on yourself and others. Piercing knowledge of human behavior-whether through academia, astrology, therapy, or a lifetime of careful observation. You're emotionally intelligent and generally give good advice. Excellent communication skills and confidence presenting your work. Precise writing. Your metaphors are unvarnished and your style is deep without being pretentious..

title: Sales Engineer
description: ABOUT REPAY. REPAY ("Realtime Electronic Payments" / NASDAQ TICKER: RPAY) is an established and fast-growing publicly traded financial technology and payment processing company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with offices across the country. REPAY enables its customers to accept payments anytime, anywhere, and through any channel while providing a secure, seamless, and enjoyable payment experience for the end consumers. REPAY offers a comprehensive suite of electronic payment and funding solutions, including debit and credit card processing, ACH processing, Instant Funding, and electronic bill payment systems with full IVR, text, and mobile capabilities. The scalability of its products allows merchants of all sizes to add an instant arsenal of intelligent payment technology solutions to their businesses without significant development costs or infrastructure investments.. . ABOUT THE ROLE. The Sales Engineer is responsible for providing technical leadership and guidance to new and existing clients throughout REPAY's pre-sales and client implementation lifecycle experience. The Sales Engineer partners with Sales Executives and Account Management to understand prospects' and customers' strategic initiatives, serves as the subject matter expert on REPAY's technology platform and services model, and works cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Solution Engineering, and Implementations to propose and scope solutions that transform the merchant's payment experience.. RESPONSIBILITIES. . Partner with Sales Executives and Account Management to understand potential business opportunities at customers and prospects, including researching and understanding prospects' strategic initiatives and identifying potential solutions for the prospect's organization. Serve as the sales team subject matter expert on REPAY's technology platform and services model in both internal and customer-facing aspects. Develop and deliver demos of REPAY technology solutions for prospects and customers. Prepare and develop technical presentations to explain our company's products or services to customers. Propose and scope solutions that transform the merchant's payment experience. Collaborate with the marketing and product teams to guide key functionality and benefits into core business value messages. Solicit and log client feedback and evaluate the data to create new sales and marketing strategies to target customers. Provide feedback to the Product team about what the market is talking about. Work with the sales executive to create relationships with customer contacts in technical and operational roles and build credibility with all decision makers. Work closely with the Solution Engineering and Implementations teams to kick off new implementations and ensure all relevant solution design is documented and complete. Assist the sales team with answering RFP technical questions. Work with the sales team to document product gaps during the sales process and communicate gaps to PNM product and engineering prior to contract signature.. SKILLS & EXPERIENCE NEEDED. 4+ years of technical sales position such as Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Systems Engineering, Solutions Consultant. Strong technical background and ability to understand technical concepts and effectively communicate them to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify customer needs and propose innovative solutions. Experience managing workflows, status reporting and client ticketing, with JIRA, Salesforce, or other similar applications. A team player that is capable of high performance and flexibility working in a dynamic and metrics driven environment. Must be willing to work in a fast-paced environment. API technology. A strong customer centric advocate and technical generalist. Empathetic, collaborative, communicative, consultative, and intellectually curious. Confident and comfortable with customers and being in a client facing role. . WHY JOIN REPAY.… BECAUSE CULTURE IS EVERYTHING. GROWTH & PEOPLE-CENTERED LEADERSHIP. As the industry-leading financial technology provider in the Consumer Finance and Business to Business spaces, we continue to set the standard for application development and delivery. In 2019, REPAY became a public company listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market (RPAY). For the past three consecutive years, we have placed on the ACG® Atlanta Georgia Fast 40, a list recognizing the top 40 fastest-growing middle-market companies in Georgia. REPAY's leadership empowers each team member to make a difference and stretch to their fullest potential. Our dedication to frequent, transparent communication is shown with companywide meetings where our leaders share company vision and encourage employees to ask questions. . FUN WORK ENVIRONMENT & GREAT TEAMS. We offer it all: business to casual dress, great snacks & beverages, and open-air collaborative team settings. REPAY has been certified as a Great Place to Work® company for 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, and 2022. The REPAY team is fun, smart, collaborative, and truly enjoys working together. Making a difference in our local communities - we support several philanthropic initiatives every year to give back to our local communities. We are self-driven, motivated professionals who do not require micro-management to ensure we produce high quality and timely work.. INNOVATION & EDUCATION. We create highly sophisticated payment processing applications and are always pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are constantly revolutionizing the industry by building on new ideas from clients and employees. We provide the resources necessary to ensure new innovations can develop quickly and with quality. We encourage continuing education, including professional conferences and events. . PUTTING OUR PEOPLE FIRST. We believe our people are the best, and we care immensely about their success. We offer a comprehensive benefits package which includes 100% coverage of employee healthcare premiums and several free benefits, including life insurance, disability insurance, and work-life balance resources. All benefits go into effect day one. Our employees' futures are important to us, which is why we have a 401(k)-employer match and and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. REPAY employees are eligible to participate in our Annual Bonus Program. This bonus award reflects excellent performance of individual contributions and goals achieved during the past year.. REPAY's core values are Excellence, Passion, Innovation, Respect, and Integrity.. REPAY is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we promote a company culture where diversity, equity and inclusion are central. We are committed to build our teams and grow a company in which employees can succeed, regardless of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, transgender status, pregnancy, religion, age (40 and over), disability, service in the uniformed services, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other classification protected by federal, state or local law. Celebrating our diverse backgrounds, views and beliefs allows us to embrace what makes us unique and continue to innovate and push the boundaries of what is possible.. We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for hire in California. Additionally, we are not able to sponsor visas..

description: ABOUT REPAY.
