ABOUT THE ROLE. REPAY is seeking a highly motivated, self-driven Senior Security Engineer to join our Security Operations team. This role sits at the center of our Security Operations Center (SOC) - monitoring and triaging security event queues, conducting proactive threat hunting, and driving incidents from detection through containment and remediation. You will partially own and continuously improve our response playbooks and procedures, build and maintain the automation and integrations that reduce repetitive operational work, operationalize new detections, and assist with vulnerability management as needed. . You will also use and train our agentic SOC platform, applying AI-driven workflows to improve triage quality and reduce time to detect and respond. This role participates in the 24/7 weekly on call rotation and partners closely with IT, cloud engineering, network, and application teams to coordinate response actions and remediations. The ideal candidate is a curious, hands-on investigator who is comfortable making decisions under pressure, communicates clearly during active incidents, and turns every incident into a lasting improvement. . RESPONSIBILITIES. Security Monitoring and Triage. Monitor and triage security event and alert queues across SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, email, cloud, and network telemetry, ensuring timely and accurate disposition. Investigate alerts to determine scope, impact, and root cause, escalating confirmed incidents according to defined severity criteria. Participate in the 24/7 weekly Security Operations on call rotation, providing timely response to high priority security alerts, incidents, and escalations. Document investigative findings, decisions, and evidence to a standard that supports audit, legal, and post-incident review needs. Threat Hunting. Conduct proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunts across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and SaaS environments. Leverage threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK, and adversary tradecraft to surface activity that evades existing detections. Produce hunt reports covering findings, detection gaps, and recommended improvements. Incident Response, Playbooks, and Procedures. Execute incident response activities including triage, investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery. Own the development, maintenance, and testing of response playbooks, runbooks, and standard operating procedures. Lead or contribute to post-incident reviews, tracking corrective actions to closure and updating playbooks based on lessons learned. Support tabletop exercises and purple team activities to validate detection and response readiness. Response Actions Using Security Tooling. Take containment and remediation actions using enterprise security tooling, including EDR/XDR host isolation and response, SASE/SSE policy enforcement, secure email gateway (SEG) and DLP rule tuning. Request, review, and implement firewall and network access rule changes to block malicious activity and reduce exposure. Agentic SOC Enablement. Use the agentic SOC platform in daily operations to accelerate alert triage, enrichment, and investigation. Validate AI-generated conclusions and recommended actions, ensuring appropriate human oversight and governance of automated response. Train, tune, and provide structured feedback on agent workflows, prompts, and knowledge sources to improve accuracy and reduce false positives. Security Engineering. Design and implement automation for repetitive operational tasks such as enrichment, ticket creation, evidence collection, triaging, and response actions (containment and remediation). Build and maintain automated playbooks and integrations across security and IT platforms using APIs and scripting. Track operational metrics such as time to detect, time to respond, and false positive rate, and use them to prioritize automation work. Update or configure security platforms or infrastructure hosting them using IaC. Operationalize new detections identified through threat hunting. Design and implement security control improvements to address risks and gaps in security monitoring and defense. Vulnerability Management Support. Assist with vulnerability management activities including scan review, validation, risk-based prioritization, and remediation tracking. Correlate vulnerability data with threat intelligence and evidence of active exploitation to inform remediation urgency. Partner with IT, infrastructure, and development teams to drive remediation and verify closure. Cross-Team Coordination. Coordinate response actions and remediations with IT, cloud engineering, network, application development, and business teams. Communicate incident status, impact, and required actions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Work collaboratively with end users to assist with and resolve security events or concerns they report. Mentor junior engineers and strengthen shift handoff quality, documentation, and knowledge sharing across the team. . SKILLS & EXPERIENCE NEEDED. Qualifications:. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 4-7+ years of experience in a SOC, incident response, threat hunting, security engineering, or security operations roles. Hands-on experience investigating alerts in a SIEM (Splunk Enterprise Security preferred) and working within EDR/XDR platforms. Strong understanding of attacker techniques, MITRE ATT&CK, malware behavior, phishing, identity-based attacks, and cloud abuse patterns. Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, operating system internals (Windows, Linux, macOS), and cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure). Familiarity with firewall rules, proxy and SASE/SSE policies, and DLP concepts in the context of incident response. Experience with Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages for automation and API integration. Ability to write and maintain clear playbooks, procedures, and incident documentation. Willingness and ability to participate in a 24/7 weekly on call rotation. Sound judgment under pressure, strong written and verbal communication skills, and a bias toward continuous improvement. Preferred Skills:. Experience using or tuning agentic AI or LLM-based tooling to support SOC triage, investigation, and response. Experience with automation (SOAR, Agentic) platforms and detection-as-code or automation-as-code practices. Experience using IaC (i.e. Terraform or CloudFormation) to manage and deploy infrastructure or security tools. Exposure to vulnerability management tooling and risk-based prioritization frameworks such as CVSS, EPSS, and the CISA KEV catalog. Experience in a regulated environment such as payments, financial services, or fintech, with exposure to PCI DSS, SOC 2, or similar frameworks. Experience with digital forensics, log and memory analysis, or malware triage. Relevant certifications (e.g., GIAC GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GCTI, GDAT, Splunk Core/Power User, CompTIA CySA+, AWS/Azure Security). . WHY JOIN REPAY.… BECAUSE CULTURE IS EVERYTHING. description: . Job Title:. Capacity Manager. Job Description. Capacity Manager bij Concentrix. . Als Capacity Manager ben jij de strategische en tactische regisseur van onze personele capaciteit. Je bent de functionele spil in de WFM-keten: van de langetermijnforecast tot de overdracht naar planning en real-time sturing. Jij zorgt dat onze klantteams op ieder moment over precies de juiste bezetting en vaardigheden beschikken.. In deze rol opereer je als een taakvolwassen, zelfstandig adviseur en sparringpartner voor Operations, Klantteam Management en onze opdrachtgevers. Je levert niet alleen analyses en scenario's op, maar neemt proactief stelling, daagt stakeholders inhoudelijk uit en stuurt het WFM-proces functioneel aan om afspraken te borgen.. Wat ga je doen?. . Met een vooruitziende blik (van circa 2 weken tot 15 maanden vooruit) vertaal je klantverwachtingen, volumeprognoses en historische trends naar een sluitend capaciteitsplan. Je overziet de hele keten: poolbeheer, in- en uitstroom, verzuim, verlof en werkplekbehoefte.. Je wacht niet af, maar signaleert knelpunten vroegtijdig en regisseert de oplossing. Zie je overschotten, tekorten of schommelingen in verzuim ontstaan? Dan reken je direct 'what-if'-scenario's door en presenteer je voldragen adviezen op tactisch en strategisch niveau. . Daarnaast geef je functionele sturing aan Schedulers en (Senior) Real Time Managers, zodat de uitgangspunten van het capaciteitsplan naadloos worden vertaald naar de dagelijkse operatie.. Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:. . Regie op het capaciteitsplan: zelfstandig opstellen en beheren van het capaciteitsplan voor meerdere accounts/klantteams over de middellange en lange termijn. Functionele aansturing WFM-keten: locatieoverstijgend sturen op de aansluiting tussen capaciteitsplanning, roosterplanning (Scheduling) en dagelijkse bijsturing (Real Time Management). Proactief & zelfstandig adviseren: Het management, Operations en externe opdrachtgevers gevraagd en ongevraagd adviseren over dienstinrichting, blenden van skills/kanalen en efficiencyverhoging. Scenario- en 'what-if'-analyses: Doorrekenen van beleidswijzigingen, acties, afwijkend verkeer en seizoenspieken, inclusief impact op kosten, FTE en servicelevels. Grip op de pool: Bewaken en forecasten van verzuim, verloop, shrinkage en contracturen; tijdig concrete wervingsopdrachten uitzetten richting Recruitment. Balans bewaken: Zorgen voor een gezonde balans tussen klantdoelstellingen, operationele kosten en een evenwichtig verlof- en beschikbaarheidsbeleid voor de medewerkers.. Wie ben jij?. . Jij bent een stevige persoonlijkheid die zelfstandig opereert en van nature eigenaarschap toont. Cijfers en complexe datasets zijn voor jou gesneden koek, maar jouw echte kracht ligt in de vertaling naar de business. Je hebt een hoge mate van organisatiesensitiviteit: je weet belangen te verbinden, maar durft ook een kritische spiegel voor te houden en tegendruk te geven wanneer de operatie dreigt vast te lopen.. Wat breng je mee?. . Werk- en denkniveau: Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau. Ervaring: aantoonbare ervaring binnen capaciteitsmanagement, tactische workforce management of strategische personeelsplanning (bij voorkeur binnen klantcontact of een dynamische service-omgeving). Zelfstandigheid & advieskracht: ervaring met het zelfstandig adviseren en beïnvloeden van management en externe stakeholders op tactisch/strategisch niveau. Tooling & Data: specialistische kennis van dataverwerking en modellering in Excel en sterke presentatievaardigheden in PowerPoint. Ervaring met toonaangevende WFM-software (zoals Verint, Genesys, Teleopti of vergelijkbaar). Talen: Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels .. Hybride werken met échte verbinding:. . We geloven in de flexibiliteit van thuiswerken, maar vinden persoonlijk contact en een sterke teamdynamiek minstens zo belangrijk. Daarom ontmoeten we elkaar minimaal 2 dagen per week op kantoor. Zo sparren we makkelijker, houden we de lijnen kort en bouwen we samen aan een hechte organisatie.. Wat bieden wij jou?. . Een sleutelpositie met veel autonomie, waarin jouw visie en besluiten direct merkbaar zijn in onze operatie en resultaten. Je krijgt volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap binnen een informele, resultaatgerichte en internationale organisatie.. Een passend salaris van €3.850,- tot €5.000, bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en expertise. Een contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week . Een modern hybride werkmodel (flexibel werken vanuit huis en op kantoor). Goede secundaire voorwaarden, waaronder 25 vakantiedagen , pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding. Ruime mogelijkheden voor professionele ontwikkeling, WFM-certificeringen en doorgroeikansen.. Waarom Concentrix?. . Bij Concentrix geloven we in taakvolwassenheid: wij geven je het vertrouwen, de kaders en de vrijheid om jouw stempel te drukken op onze WFM-dienstverlening. Geen micro-management, maar een rol waarin jij als vakexpert aan het roer staat van een optimale balans tussen mensen, middelen en resultaat.. Klaar om de regie te pakken?. . Solliciteer direct via de button of neem contact op met Patrick Buitendam (Senior Recruiter) via patrick.buitendam@concentrix.com of 06 13 79 08 69 voor meer informatie over de functie.. Location:. NLD Rotterdam - Weena 505. Language Requirements:. Dutch (Required), English. Time Type:. Full time

Design, build, and integrate the patient, clinic staff, and doctor applications on a cloud-native, AI-enabled healthcare platform running on GCP and Azure. You will work across all Experience and Care apps and their integrations with external healthcare systems, and you'll extend the existing .NET clinic app rather than start over.. Responsibilities. . Build features end to end: React/Next.js web screens, React Native mobile screens, .NET (ASP.NET Core) APIs, and the PostgreSQL data behind them. Deliver Phase 2 features: the mobile app, teleconsultation, medication management, the feedback/survey platform, and AI assistants for patients, clinic staff, and doctors/specialists. Map partner data to FHIR resources and validate it. Match patients and orders, quarantine records that don't match, and support reconciliation and replay. Build long-running clinical workflows in Temporal (.NET SDK), such as lab orders, result review, critical result alerts, and medication change approvals. Use idempotency, the outbox pattern, and event messaging (Kafka, Pub/Sub, or Service Bus) so no clinical action is lost or duplicated. Connect AI assistant features to care services through secure, permission-scoped tools, and require clinician approval before AI output affects clinical records. Build secure login, consent, and access rules by tenant, patient, and purpose of use (OIDC, OPA). Secure partner connections with mTLS/OAuth. Package and deploy services as containers on Kubernetes (GKE/AKS) through CI/CD and GitOps, with health checks and autoscaling. Keep patient data out of logs, caches, and the browser. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes (GKE or AKS), and CI/CD pipelines. Experience integrating LLM/AI features into applications, such as calling model APIs, retrieval (RAG), or tool calling. Strong plus: Temporal or another workflow engine, Mirth Connect, HAPI FHIR, WebRTC/LiveKit, OPA, and HIPAA or data privacy experience. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.. We are looking for a Cloud Solution Architect with strong expertise in Azure Local (Azure Stack HCI) to support enterprise and regulated customers in designing and delivering hybrid cloud solutions. Delivering secure, resilient, and scalable infrastructure solutions. While Azure Local is the primary focus, the role requires flexibility to support broader Azure infrastructure and hybrid scenarios, ensuring effective utilization across multiple customer engagements. Key Responsibilities:. Azure Local & Hybrid Architecture:. Design and implement Azure Local / Azure Stack HCI solutions. Architect hybrid environments integrating: Azure Arc. Virtual Machines and Kubernetes. Networking and storage. Enable cloud-consistent operations across on-premises and Azure. Customer Delivery & Execution:. Deliver high-quality, repeatable technical engagements. Trusted Advisor & Stakeholder Management. Act as the primary technical contact for customers. Build strong relationships from technical teams to executive stakeholders. Translate business requirements into technical architecture. Operations, Resilience & Optimization. Support customers in: Monitoring and operational stability. Performance optimization. Disaster recovery and business continuity. Improve overall operational maturity and reliability. Security & Governance. Guide customers on: Identity (Microsoft Entra ID + Active Directory). Access control, governance, and compliance. Contribute to secure-by-design hybrid architectures. Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing. Collaborate with: CSAMs, partners, and engineering teams. Contribute to reusable assets, IP, and best practices. Required Technical Skills:. Core (Must-have). Deep expertise in Azure Local / Azure Stack HC I. Strong Azure infrastructure knowledge: Compute (VMs). Networking. Storage. Experience with: Azure Arc. Hybrid and multi-cloud architectures. . Hybrid / On-Prem (Critical Requirement). Strong understanding of: Windows Server administration. Active Directory (AD DS). Microsoft Entra ID and Entra Connect. Virtualization: Hyper‑V. Clustering and high availability. Infrastructure fundamentals: Storage (S2D, SAN concepts). Networking (segmentation, connectivity). . ★The candidate must be able to operate confidently across both cloud and on-prem environments. Security (Expected). Identity and access management fundamentals. Certificate usage (PKI awareness; deep expertise not required). Infrastructure hardening and compliance fundamentals. Additional Skills (Strongly Preferred). Disaster recovery and backup solutions. Proven experience working in environments with very high security requirements. Strong awareness of classified, regulated, or sovereign IT environments. Experience operating in complex enterprise IT landscapes. Demonstrates professionalism, integrity, and strong adherence to confidentiality expectations. Ability to work effectively in: Fast-moving, changing organizations. Defense, government, or public sector environments. Personal suitability and trustworthiness are critical, with strong emphasis on reliability and accountability. Language & Location Requirements:. . Fluent Finnish (spoken and written) - mandatory. Fluent English (spoken and written) - mandatory. Ability to work onsite as required. Flexibility to travel as needed. Additional Nordic languages are considered a plus. Core Qualifications & Capabilities:. Experience working with enterprise customers. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Ability to handle critical customer situations under pressure. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills. Strong balance between technical depth and business understanding. Ability to adapt quickly in changing environments. What Makes This Role Unique:. Focus on Azure Local and hybrid infrastructure scenarios. Combines: Architecture design. Hands-on delivery. Customer engagement. Requires understanding of end-to-end infrastructure across cloud and on-premises. Strong exposure to regulated and high-security environments. Location:. FIN -Work-at-Home. Language Requirements:. Time Type:.

title: Capacity Manager
description: . Job Title:. Capacity Manager. Job Description. Capacity Manager bij Concentrix. . Als Capacity Manager ben jij de strategische en tactische regisseur van onze personele capaciteit. Je bent de functionele spil in de WFM-keten: van de langetermijnforecast tot de overdracht naar planning en real-time sturing. Jij zorgt dat onze klantteams op ieder moment over precies de juiste bezetting en vaardigheden beschikken.. In deze rol opereer je als een taakvolwassen, zelfstandig adviseur en sparringpartner voor Operations, Klantteam Management en onze opdrachtgevers. Je levert niet alleen analyses en scenario's op, maar neemt proactief stelling, daagt stakeholders inhoudelijk uit en stuurt het WFM-proces functioneel aan om afspraken te borgen.. Wat ga je doen?. . Met een vooruitziende blik (van circa 2 weken tot 15 maanden vooruit) vertaal je klantverwachtingen, volumeprognoses en historische trends naar een sluitend capaciteitsplan. Je overziet de hele keten: poolbeheer, in- en uitstroom, verzuim, verlof en werkplekbehoefte.. Je wacht niet af, maar signaleert knelpunten vroegtijdig en regisseert de oplossing. Zie je overschotten, tekorten of schommelingen in verzuim ontstaan? Dan reken je direct 'what-if'-scenario's door en presenteer je voldragen adviezen op tactisch en strategisch niveau. . Daarnaast geef je functionele sturing aan Schedulers en (Senior) Real Time Managers, zodat de uitgangspunten van het capaciteitsplan naadloos worden vertaald naar de dagelijkse operatie.. Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:. . Regie op het capaciteitsplan: zelfstandig opstellen en beheren van het capaciteitsplan voor meerdere accounts/klantteams over de middellange en lange termijn. Functionele aansturing WFM-keten: locatieoverstijgend sturen op de aansluiting tussen capaciteitsplanning, roosterplanning (Scheduling) en dagelijkse bijsturing (Real Time Management). Proactief & zelfstandig adviseren: Het management, Operations en externe opdrachtgevers gevraagd en ongevraagd adviseren over dienstinrichting, blenden van skills/kanalen en efficiencyverhoging. Scenario- en 'what-if'-analyses: Doorrekenen van beleidswijzigingen, acties, afwijkend verkeer en seizoenspieken, inclusief impact op kosten, FTE en servicelevels. Jij bent een stevige persoonlijkheid die zelfstandig opereert en van nature eigenaarschap toont. Cijfers en complexe datasets zijn voor jou gesneden koek, maar jouw echte kracht ligt in de vertaling naar de business. Je hebt een hoge mate van organisatiesensitiviteit: je weet belangen te verbinden, maar durft ook een kritische spiegel voor te houden en tegendruk te geven wanneer de operatie dreigt vast te lopen.. Wat breng je mee?. . Werk- en denkniveau: Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau. Ervaring: aantoonbare ervaring binnen capaciteitsmanagement, tactische workforce management of strategische personeelsplanning (bij voorkeur binnen klantcontact of een dynamische service-omgeving). Zelfstandigheid & advieskracht: ervaring met het zelfstandig adviseren en beïnvloeden van management en externe stakeholders op tactisch/strategisch niveau. Tooling & Data: specialistische kennis van dataverwerking en modellering in Excel en sterke presentatievaardigheden in PowerPoint. Ervaring met toonaangevende WFM-software (zoals Verint, Genesys, Teleopti of vergelijkbaar). Talen: Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels .. Hybride werken met échte verbinding:. . We geloven in de flexibiliteit van thuiswerken, maar vinden persoonlijk contact en een sterke teamdynamiek minstens zo belangrijk. Daarom ontmoeten we elkaar minimaal 2 dagen per week op kantoor. Zo sparren we makkelijker, houden we de lijnen kort en bouwen we samen aan een hechte organisatie.. Wat bieden wij jou?. . Een sleutelpositie met veel autonomie, waarin jouw visie en besluiten direct merkbaar zijn in onze operatie en resultaten. Je krijgt volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap binnen een informele, resultaatgerichte en internationale organisatie.. description: . Job Title:. Professional, BI Analyst (TCF). Job Description. We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to be the analytics partner for our local business - the person the team turns to when they need to know what happened, what is about to happen, and what to do about it.. This is a hybrid position by design. Day to day, you sit with the local business: building and maintaining the dashboards they rely on, surfacing trends before they become surprises, and translating numbers into recommended actions. At the same time, you work as part of the Global BI team, which owns the data platform, the shared data models, and the reporting standards. Your job is to keep those two worlds connected - so that when the business changes, the data infrastructure changes with it, and when the global platform changes, local reporting keeps running without disruption.. Success in this role is not measured by the number of dashboards produced. It is measured by whether the business makes better and faster decisions because you are here. Turn data into insight. Monitor performance against targets and highlight trends, anomalies, and inflection points proactively, rather than waiting to be asked. Perform root-cause and driver analysis to explain why a metric moved, not just that it moved. Identify emerging risks - pipeline gaps, margin erosion, demand shifts, service or cost outliers - early enough for the business to act. Translate findings into clear, specific, prioritized recommendations, with an honest read on confidence and what further data would sharpen the answer. Present to local leadership in plain business language; tailor depth to the audience.. Build and maintain reporting the business trusts. Design, build, and maintain dashboards and self-service reports covering core commercial and operational KPIs. Own the full lifecycle of local reporting assets: requirements gathering, build, testing, documentation, rollout, and retirement of what is no longer used. Maintain data quality and reconciliation checks so reported numbers match the source of truth; investigate and resolve discrepancies at the root cause rather than patching the output. Keep documentation current - metric definitions, calculation logic, refresh schedules, and known limitations.. Partner with the business. Act as the first point of contact for local analytics and reporting requests; triage, scope, and prioritize them against business impact. Sit close to the commercial, operations, and finance teams to understand how the business actually works, not only how it is represented in the data. Challenge requests constructively - clarify the decision behind the ask, and propose a better route when a requested report will not answer the real question. Coach business users toward self-service so routine questions do not require a ticket. Design, build, and maintain dashboards and self-service reports covering core commercial and operational KPIs. Own the full lifecycle of local reporting assets: requirements gathering, build, testing, documentation, rollout, and retirement of what is no longer used. Maintain data quality and reconciliation checks so reported numbers match the source of truth; investigate and resolve discrepancies at the root cause rather than patching the output. Keep documentation current - metric definitions, calculation logic, refresh schedules, and known limitations.. Connect local and global. Represent local business requirements to the Global BI team: new data sources, metric changes, market-specific logic, and reporting gaps. Track upstream changes - data model updates, platform migrations, definition changes, release schedules - and assess the local impact before they land. Plan and execute the local side of migrations, upgrades, and refactors so that reporting continuity is maintained and users experience no unplanned downtime or silent breakage. Adopt and apply global standards for data modelling, naming, security, and visualization; flag where a genuine local exception is warranted and make the case for it. Contribute local solutions back to the global team where they can be reused in other markets.. Manage change and continuity. Maintain a clear inventory of local reporting assets, their owners, dependencies, and business criticality. Update reporting logic when the business changes - new products, new structures, restatements, reorganizations - and communicate the impact on historical comparability. Document handover-ready runbooks so critical reporting is not dependent on any single person. Communicate proactively about outages, delays, and known data issues, including what is being done and by when.. Required. 3+ years in a BI, data analyst, or reporting role, ideally supporting commercial or operational functions. Strong SQL - able to write, read, and optimize queries against large, imperfect datasets independently. Hands-on expertise in at least one enterprise BI tool (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or Qlik), including data modelling and performance tuning, not just chart building. Solid grasp of data modelling concepts (dimensional modelling, fact/dimension design, granularity, slowly changing dimensions). Demonstrated ability to move from a raw business question to a defensible answer with a clear recommendation. Excellent communication skills: you can explain a technical constraint to a business stakeholder and a business nuance to an engineer, and be understood by both. Comfortable working across time zones with a distributed team, and self-directed enough to make progress without daily supervision. Business fluency in English. . Nice to have. Experience in a matrixed or multi-country organization with central/local reporting structures. . Python or R for analysis and automation. Familiarity with a modern cloud data stack (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift) and transformation tooling such as dbt. Version control (Git) and experience working within a release or change-management process. Exposure to forecasting, cohort, or statistical analysis. . Location:. MYS Kuala Lumpur Nu Tower 2. Strong knowledge of AI/ML/LLM frameworks, data processing tools, and modern programming languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and React.. Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, excellent problem-solving abilities, and the communication skills needed to influence and collaborate across teams.. The Supervisor, Talent Acquisition ensures that staffing requirements are met to identify, attract and onboard top talent to efficiently and effectively meet dynamic business needs. This position is responsible assisting with development of recruiting strategy and managing a team who assess hiring needs and interview candidates for positions. . Essential Functions/Core Responsibilities. Responsible for development, implementation and administration of recruitment programs. Direct the activities of a team who assist with development of innovative, creative, and proactive recruitment strategies to meet the business needs of each client, internal department, and appropriate stakeholders. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Ability to lead team in multi-tasking, prioritization, and meeting timelines on deliverable. Proficient in Microsoft Office. Strong attention to detail. Ability to foster a sense of professionalism and relationship building for self and team. Ability to handle and maintain confidential information. . description: . Job Title:. Business Advisor (Spanish & English - speaking) - Hybrid MA04. Job Description. Experience the power of a game-changing career. . Want to be part of an innovative and growing team? We're a global technology and services leader that powers the brands of the future. We help well-known brands - the ones you use every day - improve their businesses with technology and integrated solutions, in over 70 countries. . If you're looking to grow and be inspired, as a Business Advisor in Malaga (Hybrid) , you will be part of our team of game-changers who are powering the brands of the future in the sport industry. . Career growth and personal development. . This is a great opportunity to experience the power of what's next and develop "friends for life" at the same time. We'll give you all the training, cutting-edge technologies, and the continuing support you'll need to succeed. . What you will do in this role. . In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people - our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet. . As an Business Advisor on our team, you will:. - Gather information quickly by understanding the customer needs and uncovering sales opportunities. - Guide the customer through the next steps of their journey while inspiring confidence and being perceived as a trusted advisor - Develop an understanding Modern Work services and its cost and monitoring capabilities with a technical aptitude. - This includes the ability to become a trusted technical advisor for our customers by clarifying their questions and handling their objections. - Understand the Modern Work sales lifecycle and stage our customer is at. - This includes the ability to uncover sales opportunities that might not always seem obvious (example: future upcoming projects, follow-up to test phases, etc.). - Be able to provide critical product and program feedback to operations, business groups, product groups, and engineering. . Your qualifications. . We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are. . Concentrix is a great match if you:. - Are bilingual or proficient in Spanish with advanced English level. - Have an Associate / Bachelor's Degree. - Have 5 years minimum of sales experience, 2 years minimum Account Management and IT industry experience and 1 year minimum Customer Relationship Management experience. - Have experience working with or selling Modern Work. - Are Minimum MS900 Certified. - Recognized and verifiable experience with CRM/ERP system and (IT) sales processes. - Are able to approach and engage a new customer quickly with negotiation capabilities. - Are a Trusted Advisor - Ability to consult on high-level strategy and overall IT spend. - Have solid time management skills and ability to work independently or under supervision with a high level of integrity. - Are confident and articulate with the ability to communicate program with Senior Management. - Are able to provide product and program insights to stakeholders. . Don't meet every requirement? No worries. We're dedicated to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace for everyone. If you feel you don't check every box, we still encourage you to apply. We'll do our best to match you with the right job, whether it's this one or another role. . What's in it for you. . We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW. That's why we significantly invest in our people, our infrastructure, and our capabilities to ensure long-term success for our teams, our customers, and YOU. . In this role, we offer benefits that help support your unique lifestyle:. - Full-time 39 hours/week permanent contract: Monday to Friday 9:00 to 18:00. - Salary: 24,000 euros gross/year + up to 4,000 euros gross/year in bonus and private medical insurance. - A modern centrally placed office in Benalmadena, right next to the beach area with a possibility to work some days from home. - Full paid training on the company and the project you'll be working on. - Career development programs, specialized courses. . description: . Job Title:. Wellbeing Associate - Riyadh. Job Description. Our psychological health team is a diverse group of specialists dedicated to developing, delivering, and evaluating employee health and wellbeing strategies for Trust & Safety teams at Concentrix. Our initiatives are crafted to enhance and support positive mental and physical health, while fostering a healthy culture and work environment across the organization. The Onsite Wellbeing Counsellor will provide onsite mental health and wellbeing support to employees working in content moderation roles. As a qualified counsellor or psychotherapist, you'll conduct sessions using interventions such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) and Mindfulness Based Therapies (MBT). You'll routinely assess cases for risk, follow strict safety protocols and escalate complex cases to clinical leadership. Your role also includes collaborating with your colleagues to design and deliver group sessions that improve resilience, healthy coping, and distress management skills. As this role falls into the category of Trust & Safety, you'll be working with people exposed to harmful content. This may occur in the form of images, video, and text related to hate speech, violence, child safety, depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. The primary responsibilities of this role include:. • Deliver one to one onsite counselling sessions, addressing a range of psychological health issues using short-term therapeutic interventions such as CBT, ACT and MBT. • Deliver one to one onsite coaching sessions, and develop resilience plans for maintaining employee health and wellbeing. • Deliver onsite group and peer support sessions aimed at building resilience, developing healthy coping strategies and building positive working relationships. • Facilitate onsite creative sessions such as creative therapies, music therapies, and mindfulness-based activities. • Assess cases for trauma related to exposure to graphic content and follow escalation protocols. • Evaluate and appropriately manage risks of harm to self or others in a timely manner • Manage confidential case records and reports safely, and in line with privacy protocols. • Deliver psychometric assessments to employees in the region. • Review assessment data for trends that require intervention, and contribute to insight reports. • Complete administrative duties, including tracking session data and completion of individual case notes in a timely manner. • Respond promptly to emails and messages from employees seeking support, ensuring clear and timely communication. • Communicate with the clinical leadership team on a regular basis to discuss observations, insights risks and areas for improvement. • Contribute towards safe working practices across the Psychological Health team. • Attend monthly peer support sessions with your Clinical Manager and regional colleagues. • Adhere to professional and ethical guidelines set by discipline specific governing and licensing bodies. Minium qualifications:. • Master's degree in clinical psychology, counselling psychology, or psychotherapy. • Current unrestricted license to practice in the country where the site is based. • Minimum 3 years of experience in wellbeing or psychotherapy field. • Proven experience in cross-cultural counselling, demonstrating sensitivity and competence with diverse client backgrounds. • Able to build trust and rapport with employees, managers and team members. • Proven experience designing and delivering wellbeing/mental health training, workshops and webinars. • Strong data management skills, ensuring accurate handling of sensitive information and session records. • Excellent time management and prioritization skills, effectively handling multiple tasks and responsibilities in a dynamic setting. • Proven ability to maintain professionalism and ethical standards in a business environment. • Excellent communication skills. • Fluent in written and spoken Arabic. • English B1 as a plus Desired qualifications:. • Experience working in Trust and Safety or a content moderation environment. description: . Job Title:. Renewal Specialist (Dutch-Speaking) - Hybrid - Cloud Solutions -MV02. Job Description. Experience the power of a game-changing career. . Are you looking for what's next? We're a global technology and services leader that powers the brands of the future. We help well-known brands - the ones you use every day - improve their businesses with technology and integrated solutions, in over 70 countries. . If you're looking to grow and be inspired, as a Renewal Specialist in Malaga (Hybrid), you will be part of our team of game-changers who are powering the brands of the future in tech where you will drive the sales cycle, nurture client relationships and showcase your expertise in advanced cloud technologies. . Career growth and personal development. . This is a great opportunity to experience the power of what's next and develop "friends for life" at the same time. We'll give you all the training, cutting-edge technologies, and the continuing support you'll need to succeed. . What you will do in this role. . In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people - our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet. . As a Renewal Specialist in our team, you will:. -Act as Primary point of contact for the customer during the renewals process, building trust & setting the foundation for long term Microsoft relationship. -Effectively turn renewals leads into opportunities and revenue pipeline by filtering them through different criteria, e.g. BANT (budget, authority, need and timeline). -Engage with small and medium businesses across industries, company sizes and types to determine their needs and identify upsell/cross sell opportunities. -Understand customers current Microsoft license position, leading with Microsoft's cloud technologies to secure customer wins, maximizing up-sell and cross-sell opportunities collaborating with Solution Specialists and other stakeholders as needed. -Support renewal process by engaging & co-ordinating multiple stakeholders (PCM, TCM, CE) aligned to customer needs, ensuring renewal closes on time. Your qualifications. . We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are. . Concentrix is a great match if you:. -Are native or proficient in Dutch with advanced English. -Have 2+ years sales experience with a proven track record of success. -Have experience using Microsoft Office Suite applications and passion for cloud technologies. -Possess general knowledge of the IT industry, with the capacity to learn and retain knowledge about individual products and business solutions quickly and accurately. -Demonstrate your ability to understand customer needs, create and deliver customized, customer-focused pitches and solutions. -Have an achievement and success-driven personality. -Have experience selling Azure, Office 365, Dynamics 365 or similar solutions (preferred). . We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW. That's why we significantly invest in our people, our infrastructure, and our capabilities to ensure long-term success for our teams, our customers, and YOU.. Support for skill development.. . Meetings on sensitive points with our clients and their partners:. description: . Job Title:. Sr. Specialist, Sales Development. Job Description. Imagine being able to partner with global technology leaders in a company that cares about YOU - your professional growth, your success, and your community.. We are looking for a Sales Development Specialist to join our team. Today.. The future team member that will love this job will demonstrate the value and benefits of our client's services through customer engagement, with a primary focus on selling or renewing contracts. Reporting to a sales manager, You will have an assigned territory and develop an excellent level of product or service knowledge to support customer questions and promote offerings. Along the way you will have access to world-class training opportunities to grow and enhance your skills and career. At Concentrix, you can Own Your Future! You Have:. . At least 5+ years of experience in a metrics-driven sales or customer-facing role. Experience with SaaS opportunities Experience in prospecting, outreach, lead qualification and lead generation Experience selling IT or recruiting solutions. For the Philippines market, fluency in Tagalog and English to service customers. Excellent communication, interpersonal, organizational and telephone skills. Ability to effectively manage time, prioritize tasks and work within deadlines with little supervision. Ability to analyze business opportunities and read situations well. Ability to gather and use data to inform decision making and persuade others. Ability to develop compelling strategies that deliver results with strong attention to detail. . You will:. Follow outbound contact schedule to reach targeted potential customers identified. through prospecting. Assess and prioritize lead from sales, trials, partners and other sources. Qualify the BANT (budget, authority, need and timeline) of leads. Help Sales and Marketing reach Market Development related goals. Help identify the best solutions for customers and how to implement those solutions. Foster trust between customers and clients. Reach mastery of product knowledge and technical understanding of services to assess. client requirements. Initiate steps to help customer concerns/roadblocks prohibiting satisfaction or product. usage. Manage high volume of customer contacts through phone and email each day - majority of. communication is outbound. Work with your team and management to provide a professional experience during all. interactions with customers and prospects. Maintain the customer management system (CRM) to ensure all relevant data is captured. . Our Benefits/Perks:. Health Insurance with Dental Coverage for Employees. Paid Time off. Bereavement Leave. Life Insurance Group Personal Accident Program. Employee Assistance Program. Recognition programs. Wellness Incentive Program. Learning and Development Programs. . Virtual First. Concentrix is a Virtual First company, which means working outside of an office will be the primary experience for most employees for the foreseeable future. Equipment will be provided, but an Internet connection and a space at home to work is required. While you can work from your home, we do require that you are within a commutable distance (NCR, Cavite, Rizal, Laguna, and Bulacan), of the local office to ensure you can attend when/if required by the company. Also, per PEZA regulations, we are mandated to keep track and record the movement of all company-owned work equipment, thus any movement of this working equipment is prohibited without any prior approval by the management team, including our PH Site Director. . description: . Job Title:. Associate Technical Sales (Hong Kong). Job Description. Are you enthusiastic about creating memorable experiences? Then come join us at Concentrix and work with energetic people who strive to enjoy every day.. We are looking for a Cantonese & English speaking Technical Sales Representative (On-site) to join one of our exciting, expansion projects.. As the Technical Sales Specialist, you will prepare technical insights and presentations to align with customers' needs and IT initiatives in SaaS solution adoption. You will support the inside sales team in generating new business and growing existing accounts by assessing advanced application needs and offering tailored solutions. Your goal is to secure more customer wins by demonstrating how our solutions meet their requirements, addressing pain points, and explaining technical architectures and end-user scenarios. As a Technical Sales Representative in our team, you will:. Technical Solution Development & Customer Engagement. . Serve as the primary technical resource for the sales team, provide technical expertise on products, services, and technologies. Attend customer meetings, engage with potential and existing customers to understand their technical needs and business objectives. Collaborate with the sales team to develop customized solutions that meet customer requirements. Demonstrate product features and benefits through presentations, demos, and technical discussions, both in person and via video conference. Address technical queries and provide timely, accurate responses. Confirm implementation requirements and pricing to provide customers with accurate cost projections. Act as a customer advocate for pre-sales and post-sales discussion, offering consultative support and consistent follow-up. Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including IT managers and decision-makers.. Market and Product Knowledge. Stay up-to-date with industry trends, competitive landscape, and technological advancements to position SaaS solution adoption effectively. Provide feedback to the inside sales and channel partner team based on customer insights and market demands. Identify opportunities to streamline and enhance sales processes, including recommending improvements, and develop and implement comprehensive training programs.. Training and Reporting. Train and support the sales team on technical aspects of products and solutions. Conduct workshops and training sessions for internal teams and external customers/partners to enhance product knowledge. Track and report on solution adoption rates and customer feedback. Create high-quality technical documentation and solution blueprints that are comprehensive, accurate, and easy to understand.. We'll be a great match if you have:. Bachelor's Degree is preferred. 2-3 years of experience in pre-sales or technical consulting role with customer-facing approach. Strong familiarity in software or hardware solution selling/ service industry . Excellent command of English and Canto nese language proficiency (verbal and written). Experience managing the Hong Kong market is encouraged to apply for this role. Experience working with or selling Cloud Computing such as Software as a Service (SaaS) / Platform as a Service (PaaS) / Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) would be highly advantageous. Have experience or exposure to Open Source Software (OSS) including but not limited to Microsoft Azure, Office 365, Dynamics 365, Google Workspace or similar solutions. Consultative capability to influence customers in an interactive approach with demonstrated ability to extract hidden or unrealized requirements from customer. Problem solver and able to identify pain points and share best practices in open-source software management. Demonstrated ability to focus and manage ambiguous customer needs into specific, deliverable requirements. Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional service and support on time. Advanced written and verbal communication skills - proactive communication style ensuring timely status of projects. description: . Job Title:. Trainer II. Job Description. The Trainer II is responsible for delivering client focused training to address the new hire, product update and recursive training requirement of Concentrix in support of client programs to ensure superior workforce preparation with best in class service and delivery. This position requires attaining and maintaining certification in the Trainer Certification Program (101/102), provides mentoring to Program Ready Trainers, curriculum review and modification as needed, and evaluation of training programs using various feedback methods. Essential Functions/Core Responsibilities. Responsible for day-to-day functional direction of agents within the program training classroom environment, including student progress monitoring for the duration of training, providing coaching and developmental feedback and readiness recommendations. Utilize effective presentation and facilitation skills including creative training techniques and adult/accelerated learning techniques using a variety of training delivery modalities in a classroom environment. Prepare and present training materials through classroom learning, hands on demonstrations, and supporting activities. Accountable for achieving individual training performance metrics. Support and partner with Operations to transition of agents from training to production environment, ensuring competency levels meet business needs (where required). Maintain relevant product knowledge for each account by taking calls, attending client and cross functional meetings (as needed), and side by side observations. Ensure effective, consistent communication with managers, peers, and other resource groups, including day-to-day informal interaction with clients. May support Instructional Design team in designing and developing training materials for various instructional delivery methods including; computer-based training, interactive, classroom training, and written job aids. Measure the effectiveness of training programs using various feedback methods - focus groups, interviews, and surveys that will lead to enhancement of training resources and programs based on results of evaluation. Recommend curriculum modifications to Training Manager/Supervisor on the basis of internal customer feedback and/or Training Needs Analysis. Participate and contribute to continuous learning culture by maintaining engagement on change management, product and services releases, policies, processes, and procedures. . Candidate Profile. Bachelor's Degree in related field from a four-year college or university with two to four years of relevant experience preferred. title: Customer Service Advisor - Arabic speaker (Abu Dhabi)
Account Manager, Automotive Vertical
description: At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. Lyft Business is changing the way companies, brands, and organizations alike leverage the Lyft platform to redefine the way they operate. We are solving big problems and meeting the needs of our clients and their people, from employees to customers and students to patients, in a whole new way. We are committed to always delivering best in class customer service. Our work is fun, challenging, and rewarding, and we are looking for a customer-focused team member passionate about solving problems and delighting our customers. As an Account Manager, Automotive on the Lyft Business team, you'll help Automotive Dealerships get more out of Lyft and its solutions after the sale. You'll join a talented team focused on one thing: using technology and Lyft's network of drivers to improve transportation for a company's customers and employees. We're looking for smart, ambitious individuals with account management experience who want to transform the way people move around and succeed in a fast moving environment. Responsibilities:. Own a book of existing dealership accounts, with responsibility for retention, adoption, and revenue growth. Build and manage an expansion pipeline within your accounts by developing trusted client relationships from first renewal conversation to signed expansion. Accurately forecast, track, and manage revenue, renewals, and churn risk with multiple systems and tools (Salesforce, Claude, Gemini, Outreach, Google Suite, Mode, and Tableau). Achieve quarterly retention and net revenue growth targets. Running quarterly business reviews, monitoring account usage and health data, and re-engaging dormant users and accounts. Be the primary point of contact and build relationships with multiple decision makers across the dealership and dealer group. Establish collaborative relationships with Lyft Business customers and demonstrate Lyft value to client-focused initiatives. Facilitate training, account review, customer engagement, and customer success criteria. Liaise with internal stakeholders, including Operations, Support, and Product, to resolve client issues and drive the effectiveness of account initiatives. Represent Lyft at marketing and trade show events. Travel up to 20% of the time for meetings and visits to client locations. Reports directly to the Manager of Automotive Sales. Experience:. 2+ years of B2B account management, customer success, or renewals experience carrying a retention or growth number (SaaS API integration, ad-tech, or transportation a plus). Proficiency with Salesforce or similar CRM, AI tooling, and a knack for learning new sales tech. A passion for mobility, the auto industry, or simply making transportation and logistics easy. Experience owning the post-sale lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, renewal, objection-handling, and upsell. Comfort using usage and performance data to identify risk and surface growth opportunities. Demonstrated success in exceeding retention or growth targets. Excellent communication skills - A big part of the role is talking to clients on the phone and in-person. Possess a competitive spirit and are excited to prove not to others, but to yourself, what you are capable of. High energy, you like to get things done and make things happen. Self starter, loves to win, and grow professionally. Ambitious and not afraid of putting yourself out there. Benefits:. . Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled. Mental health benefits. Family building benefits. Child care and pet benefits. 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future. In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off. 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible. Subsidized commuter benefits. Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership. Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule - Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid. The expected base pay range for this position in the San Francisco area is $60,800-$76,000 not inclusive of potential equity offering, variable or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process. .

description: Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir. Nous avons créé le premier système de vélos en libre-service automatisé d'Amérique du Nord et restons à la pointe de la révolution de la micromobilité. The Airports team, within the Driver organization, focuses on the airport marketplace and the unique products designed for this use case. Airports are one of the most important, impactful, and complex parts of Lyft's Rideshare business, as they are a key part of both the rider and driver Lyft experience and have unique dynamics. As an Analytics Lead on the Airport team, you will collaborate with our team of engineers, product managers, and designers to conduct thorough data deep dives on airport performance, challenge our current strategy, and recommend enhancements to facilitate market growth. title: Applied Scientist Intern, PhD (Summer 2027)
description: At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. The Lyft Rider Science team is seeking an Applied Scientist intern to develop next-generation user simulation methods using state of the art AI methods. The goal of this project is to develop and validate LLM-based Rider Agents that can serve as behavioral proxies for real riders, and study when agent simulations can provide reliable signal about rider responses to product interventions before online experimentation. You will build agent-based simulation systems grounded in real rider context and behavioral data, evaluate their fidelity against observed rider behavior and historical experiments, and study where these simulations can accelerate product iteration and experimentation. This role combines LLM engineering, agent-based modeling, machine learning, and causal inference with direct applications to real-world rider products. The expected outcome is to build a working Rider Agent simulation prototype, establish an evaluation framework for measuring simulation fidelity and validate the framework using historical rider experiments. Responsibilities:. Develop LLM-based Rider Agents that represent heterogeneous rider contexts, preferences, histories, and behaviors. Build agent-based simulation environments for evaluating rider interactions with different product experiences and interventions. Build evaluation pipelines to assess realism, robustness, and mechanism plausibility of simulated behavior against human data or established theory. Analyze emergent behaviors and interaction dynamics in simulated populations under different user segment and marketplace conditions. Conduct experiments and ablation studies on agent behavior, interaction dynamics, and simulation validity. Apply the simulation framework to real Rider product problems and assess its usefulness for hypothesis generation, product iteration, and pre-experiment evaluation. Communicate technical findings and recommendations to science, engineering, and product partners. Experience:. Currently pursuing a PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related technical field, with a graduation date between December 2027 and Summer 2028 (required). Proficiency with Python and working in a production coding environment. Hands-on experience with large language models or agent-based systems. Strong foundation in machine learning and empirical model evaluation. Ability to independently develop prototypes and work through open-ended technical problems. Strong verbal and written communication skills, and ability to collaborate and communicate with others to solve a problem. Familiarity with A/B testing, causal inference, or experimental design. Bonus Points: Experience building production level ML inference, simulation, or evaluation pipelines. Prior research experience with LLM agents, generative user simulation, or agent-based modeling. Background in computational social science or behavioral modeling. Experience evaluating AI systems against human behavioral data, qualitative studies, or controlled experiments. Familiarity with prompting, tool use, memory, planning, or coordination in LLM-based agents. Publication record in relevant venues such as NeurIPS, ICLR, AAAI, ICML or ACL/EMNLP. title: Associate Counsel, Employment
description: At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. Lyft is looking for a bright, pragmatic, and self-motivated employment attorney with 4+ years of employment counseling and litigation experience to join our growing global Legal team. The ideal candidate will leverage their prior law firm and/or in-house experience to provide thoughtful, timely, practical and business-minded legal advice primarily to the professionals on Lyft's Employee Relations and People teams across the globe. You must have experience litigating and/or counseling on compliance with federal and state anti-discrimination/harassment/retaliation laws, preferably including analysis of issues under California law. Prior in-house or seconded technology company experience is preferred but not required. The successful candidate will be an entrepreneurial and resourceful self-starter, comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, excellent at building strong relationships and interested in learning more about supporting a global workforce. Provide pragmatic day-to-day employment advice and counseling on a broad range of employment issues in order to balance business impact and legal risk including HR practices, performance management, terminations, leaves of absence, investigations, and employee accommodations. Investigate pre-litigation and litigation matters. Develop and implement strategies for early resolution (as appropriate) and work with outside counsel as appropriate. Provide guidance and Interpret policies and procedures, incorporating knowledge of state and federal employment laws (e.g., FMLA, ADA, FLSA, NLRA, and Title VII and equivalent state and international laws). Provide legal counsel and support to a global workforce. Partner closely with Lyft's Employee Relations and People team professionals on employee complaints and investigations, performance management, and accommodations. Collaborate with other members of the Employment Legal Team and People Team to develop strong processes to ensure compliance with applicable state, federal and local laws. Develop and deliver training to managers and employees -- candidates must be comfortable with public speaking. Monitor important developments in employment law in jurisdictions across the country and internationally, striving to spot trends in their infancy. Work and build trust with cross-functional partners from teams across the Legal Department and the Company. Travel from time-to-time as necessary to service internal clients; develop cross-office relationships; and attend legal proceedings/negotiations.\. Experience:. 4+ years practicing employment law at a leading law firm and/or in-house, with experience and/or interest in advice and counseling. Prior in-house experience and expertise supporting a global workforce is a plus but not required. Active and in good standing with a State Bar and eligible to practice in the relevant jurisdiction where you are located. J.D. from a top-tier law school. Excellent problem-solving capabilities, judgment, communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills. Adept at thinking creatively (and strategically!) on your feet, conveying grace under pressure, and simultaneously managing complex workloads, multiple client demands, and shifting priorities all while instilling confidence. title: Associate Operations Manager
description: At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. Flexdrive is a subsidiary of Lyft that works together with Lyft teams to realize our shared mission. Flexdrive builds the operational backbone for the future of mobility. As a fleet management leader and Lyft subsidiary, the company extends its expertise into autonomous vehicle infrastructure - managing the physical operations that keep fleets safe, available, and performing at scale. The Nashville depot is the first proof point in a multi-market expansion. The Opportunity. Reporting to the Operations Manager, AV Depot, the Associate Operations Manager is the second leadership layer at the Nashville AV depot. This role exists because one Operations Manager cannot provide the people leadership, floor coverage, and operational bandwidth a 24/7 depot of this scale requires. The Associate Operations Manager carries ownership across two critical business workstreams: workforce scheduling support and process standards compliance. Fleet Operations Leads report to the Operations Manager - but during mid shifts, the Associate Operations Manager is the operational authority on the floor, directing their work, setting the quality standard, and serving as their most experienced resource and mentor. This is a management role with a floor orientation. The Associate Operations Manager is present, coaching, directing, and executing alongside the team - while simultaneously carrying business responsibilities that directly impact depot readiness and partner compliance. This role is the bridge between the Fleet Operations Lead layer and the Operations Manager. Responsibilities:. Scheduling & Workforce Planning Support Owns the depot schedule - building, maintaining, and adjusting shift coverage across all teams to ensure the depot is consistently staffed and operationally ready. Monitors attendance, manages real-time coverage gaps, and proactively addresses workforce trends before they become operational problems. Partners with the Operations Manager on workforce planning, surfacing scheduling risks and recommendations with enough lead time to act.. Training Program Execution & Certification Compliance Owns the planning and coordination of training program execution across all shift teams - ensuring Fleet Operations Associates and Fleet Operations Leads are scheduled, prepared, and on track to complete required partner certifications, safety refreshers, and qualification renewals. Maintains certification and qualification records for the team, flagging upcoming renewals and escalating compliance risks to the Operations Manager before they become audit findings. Partners with the Program Lead Trainer to ensure qualified trainers are in place, training resources are available, and delivery stays consistent across shift teams.. Floor Execution & Quality Standards Lead the day-to-day execution of critical operational systems and processes for our 24/7 AV fleet management operations, including depot layout adherence, vehicle flow (charging, cleaning, maintenance, staging, diagnostics), parts management, and data handling. Serves as the operational authority during mid shifts - directing Fleet Operations Leads and Fleet Operations Associates on task execution, resolving workflow conflicts, and holding the floor accountable to depot performance targets. Owns quality on shift: vehicle readiness, safety inspections, and quality standards - inspecting, enforcing, and setting the standard by working alongside the team. Maintains accurate shift documentation and manages shift handoffs with discipline, ensuring the incoming Fleet Operations Lead has full situational awareness and no items fall through the gap.. Fleet Operations Lead Mentorship & Operational Direction Directs Fleet Operations Leads operationally on shift - task priorities, execution decisions, real-time escalations. Serves as the most experienced senior leader in the building in absence of the Operations Manager, providing in-the-moment coaching and surfacing structured performance observations to the Operations Manager.. Experience:. 5+ years of progressive experience in operational leadership, with a strong understanding of autonomous vehicle (AV) or complex fleet operational environments. Proven track record of launching and scaling new operational sites or programs, including accountability for facilities, team performance, and operational outcomes. Demonstrated expertise in safety management and regulatory compliance within transportation, automotive, or similar regulated industries. Experience executing incident response and coordinating multi-vendor support in complex operational environments. Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed, to effectively support and lead a 24/7 AV depot operation. Exceptional leadership in training execution and team development, with the ability to lead high-performing teams in safety-critical operations at scale. Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to translate operational data into actionable decisions and surface clear recommendations to leadership. Demonstrated leadership ability in fast-paced, high-accountability environments, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills to drive cross-functional alignment and lead on-site operations. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or a related field. Benefits:. Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled. Mental health benefits. Family building benefits. Child care and pet benefits. 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future. In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off. 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible. Subsidized commuter benefits. Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership. We are seeking an AV Program Manager to help drive the cross-functional operating plan that will prepare Flexdrive to receive, staff, and operate AV fleets at scale domestically and abroad. This role supports the operational backbone of Flexdrive's AV readiness initiative. Maintain the program timeline for Flexdrive AV Operating Readiness, tracking deliverables and dependencies across workstreams: Strategic Planning, Infrastructure, Analytics, People, Fleet Operations, Treasury, Finance, and Legal. Maintain the program's RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), surfacing cross-functional blockers with clear context for escalation. title: Business Sales Associate
description: At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. With Lyft Business, sales isn't a script you follow. It's a problem you solve in real time. As Business Associate for Lyft Business, you'll drive growth and expansion within your existing book of business in a market where transportation touches nearly every part of daily life. Success here isn't just about closing deals; it's about the judgment to identify where your time has the biggest return, and the strategic thinking to advise each client like a trusted partner as you grow their business with us. This job rewards people who think critically about where to focus their energy. Priorities will evolve, systems are still maturing, and you won't always have a playbook for every situation, but you'll have the experience and confidence to navigate ambiguity and make an impact as we figure it out. The people who thrive here are the ones who are resourceful, hard to rattle, and genuinely motivated by finding the right product fit for a client, especially when a conversation gets complex or unexpected. You'll focus on expanding and deepening relationships with small and mid-sized businesses, becoming a Lyft product expert who can efficiently resolve common support issues and guide clients through solutions that fit their needs. In this hybrid role, you will balance inbound and outbound outreach, but with a sharper eye toward prioritization: identifying key decision makers and influencers within your top accounts, and focusing your energy where it will drive the most growth. You're the hunter and the farmer, now with the experience to know which fields are worth tending. You'll be part of a driven, tight-knit sales team that's laser-focused on winning and growing business. We're looking for people who know how to apply critical thinking and strong judgment around ROI, work well with cross-functional partners, and help clients get the most out of what Lyft Business has to offer. Responsibilities:. Consistently demonstrate ownership of the expansion of your book of business, identifying key decision makers and influencers within top accounts to drive growth. Apply critical thinking to focus your time and identify new opportunities within your existing book of business. Build confidence and navigate slightly challenging client conversations as you grow into a Lyft product expert who can efficiently solve common support issues. Leverage AI to research inbound and outbound prospects' businesses, tailoring messaging and refining pitch delivery based on what you find. Run well-structured sales meetings with a predefined goal, thorough discovery, and alignment on next steps before ending the call with enough confidence in the content to veer off script and ask deeper discovery questions. Navigate sales meetings with confidence and grace, handling surprises and qualifying opportunities through advanced questioning. Keep Salesforce as your source of truth, and go a step further by creating your own data and reporting to track progress against your book of business. Maintain an advanced understanding of Lyft's internal systems and how to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Clearly articulate complex issues verbally and in writing, providing relevant context, recommendations, and outstanding questions to guide resolution with the ability to adjust your communication style across audiences and circumstances to achieve desired outcomes. Experience:. Minimum 3+ years of experience in sales, account management, or business development, with a track record of managing and growing an existing book of business. Proven experience in a quota-carrying role with a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets. You've moved past the basics and are learning how to assess opportunities and prioritize your time for maximum impact. Creative thinking to develop innovative solutions that overcome challenges and objections. Strong pipeline management skills with attention to detail and forecast accuracy. Excellent negotiation skills and ability to navigate complex deal structures.
